# 2010: current events archive

**Source-preservation edition.**

This chronological reference preserves 8,069 Wikipedia event assertions across 365 dates, including topic hierarchy, original citations and pinned revisions. SQLite is authoritative; this UTF-8 Markdown is its readable companion.

Source selection and wording are Wikipedia’s, and are not certified exhaustive, impartial or factually correct. Publication does not imply independent checking of every assertion. Original wording, errors and dated reporting figures remain visible. Editorial accounts are separately labeled and cited.

Database: [2010.sqlite](2010.sqlite). Edition SHA-256: `53feb113543c512fd3ca8835ec19f9578ce72bdf60eca0819bdb7bd9b6add119`. Publication: `preservation-release-1.1`. Extraction/Markdown profile: `annual-series-1.5`. Date: 2026-10-22.

Original entries without attached citations: 63. Separate editorial evidence: 0; explicitly unverified: 63. Unverified means no full-event verification is established; research may be incomplete or not attempted. An unsuccessful search does not establish that a claim is false. Full-event reviews complete: 0; partial: 0; without a full-event review: 8,069. Partial reviews leave unsupported details explicit.

Exact original daily files, Wikipedia payloads/metadata and prior extraction candidates are embedded losslessly, with hashes, an exact retirement manifest and Git checkpoint. Wikipedia attribution and CC BY-SA obligations remain applicable. Publisher URLs identify evidence; full publisher articles and images are not reproduced.

Template display uses explicit original arguments without calculated conversions, live expansion or inferred links. Unsupported template markup and source reliability tags remain visible. Orphan topics and malformed/unbulleted material are preserved with the handling notes below; no missing child or event is invented.

Commented-out source assertions remain labeled non-event material in the database and handling notes; they are excluded from ordinary event totals.

## January

### 2010-01-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1359660400](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2010%20January%201&oldid=1359660400>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2010-01-01-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 18 FARC rebels are killed while celebrating the New Year in an air raid by the Colombian Air Force in the south of the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Latin American Herald Tribune](<http://www.laht.com/article.asp?ArticleId=349672&amp;CategoryId=12393>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/americas/2010/01/201011235131565705.html>).

<a id="event-2010-01-01-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** 2010 Lakki Marwat suicide bombing: At least 95 people are killed, more than 100 more are injured and 20 houses are destroyed after a suicide bomber blows himself up at a volleyball game in Lakki Marwat, northwest Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times](<http://www.timesonline.co.uk/tol/news/world/asia/article6973227.ece>); [Express India](<https://web.archive.org/web/20121003051433/http://www.expressindia.com/latest-news/Several-killed-in-Pak-attack/562195/>); [BBC News](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/world/south_asia/8437114.stm>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2010-01-01-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Russians are surprised by a cartoon "gently lampooning" Dmitry Medvedev and Vladimir Putin who are portrayed dancing, singing and playing musical instruments.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/europe/8436959.stm>); [France 24](<https://web.archive.org/web/20101203190307/http://www.france24.com/en/node/4960262>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2010-01-01-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** China and the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) launch a Free Trade Area.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2010/01/01/business/global/01trade.html>); [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/2010-01/01/content_12739017.htm>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2010-01-01-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 19 people are dead and five are injured as mudslide hits an island resort near Angra dos Reis, Ilha Grande. Large numbers also killed elsewhere in Brazil.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/8437207.stm>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2010/01/01/AR2010010100605.html>).

#### Health

<a id="event-2010-01-01-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A study suggests that teenagers who go to bed late are more likely to develop depression and to have suicidal thoughts.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/health/8435955.stm>); [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/health/story/2009/12/31/sleep-teens-bedtime-depression.html>); [Sleep](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100106034143/http://www.journalsleep.org/ViewAbstract.aspx?pid=27679>).

<a id="event-2010-01-01-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Researchers announce that the likely origin of devil facial tumour disease, a transmissible cancer which has caused the population of Tasmanian devils to collapse by 60% in the past decade, is Schwann cells.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/science/nature/8433645.stm>); [Time](<http://www.time.com/time/health/article/0,8599,1950787,00.html?xid=rss-topstories>); [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2010/01/01/science/01devil.html>); [Science](<http://www.sciencemag.org/cgi/content/short/327/5961/84/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2010-01-01-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Cambodian court issues an arrest warrant for opposition leader Sam Rainsy, for failing to turn up at court over a border dispute with Vietnam. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/world/asia-pacific/8436851.stm>); [Phnom Penh Post](<http://www.phnompenhpost.com/index.php/2010010130589/National-news/opposition-leader-repudiates-political-charges-against-him.html>).

<a id="event-2010-01-01-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** North Korea calls for the end of hostilities with the United States and a nuclear free Korean Peninsula, to restart talks; in its annual New Year editorial.

Source citations (as archived): [Yonhap](<http://english.yonhapnews.co.kr/northkorea/2010/01/01/73/0401000000AEN20100101002100315F.HTML>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2010/WORLD/asiapcf/01/01/nkorea.nuclear/>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia-pacific/2010/01/20101101528552542.html>).

<a id="event-2010-01-01-5-2"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/world/europe/8435991.stm>); [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw-world.de/dw/article/0,,5075371,00.html>); [euronews](<http://www.euronews.net/2010/01/01/the-road-ahead-for-spain-s-eu-presidency/>).

**Archived source account.** Somali pirates seize an Indonesian chemical tanker with 24 crew in the Gulf of Aden and a British cargo ship with 26 cars 620 miles off the Horn of Africa.

#### Arts and culture

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE5BT17H20091230>); [TIME](<http://www.time.com/time/world/article/0,8599,1948809,00.html>); [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5g1QmAdxADzyQCWyLLzs2N63owZEA>); [Chessbase](<http://www.chessbase.com/newsdetail.asp?newsid=6027>).

#### Discoveries

<a id="event-2010-01-02-2-0"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE60104L20100102>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2010-01-02-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police in Denmark shoot a 28-year-old male Somali after he breaks into the Viby J home of Kurt Westergaard, the cartoonist at the centre of the Jyllands-Posten Muhammad cartoons controversy in 2005, and threatens his family with an axe.

#### The assassination of Mahmoud Al-Mabhouh

<a id="event-2010-01-19-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In a hotel room in Dubai on the night in question, Al-Mabhouh—a co-founder of the Izz ad-Din al-Qassam Brigades, the military wing of Hamas—was assassinated by a total of 33 perpetrators, most of whom had checked into the hotel using fraudulent names/IDs and left the country before the discovery of Al-Mabhouh's body.

Source citations (as archived): [GQ](<https://www.gq.com/story/the-dubai-job-mossad-assassination-hamas>).

<a id="event-2010-01-19-2-1"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/newstopics/politics/scotland/7396657/Bad-weather-blamed-for-Scotland-having-more-people-with-ginger-hair.html>).

<a id="event-2010-03-08-0-21"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tibet Governor Padma Choling announces to the National People's Congress that China will decide Tenzin Gyatso's reincarnation as Dalai Lama.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/asia/china/7397440/China-insists-it-will-choose-Dalai-Lamas-successor.html>).

<a id="event-2010-03-08-0-22"></a>

**Archived source account.** Plans by the Scottish Maritime Museum (SMM) to scrap City of Adelaide/HMS Carrick, one of the world's oldest clippers built in Sunderland in 1864, are postponed in the hope that enough money can be raised to send her to Australia.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/uk_news/england/wear/8555119.stm>).

### 2010-03-09

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076455308](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2010%20March%209&oldid=1076455308>).

#### None

<a id="event-2010-03-09-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Department of State issues an apology for Department spokesman P.J. Crowley's personal comments, which described Libyan leader Muammar al-Gaddafi's comments on the minaret controversy in Switzerland as "lots of words, not necessarily a lot of sense".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/africa/8558764.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-03-09-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Roman Catholic child sexual abuse investigation: The Dutch Catholic Church apologises and the country's religious leaders request an independent inquiry. A monastery head in Salzburg admits abuse of a boy more than four decades ago. The brother of Pope Benedict XVI admits physically disciplining students at a school in Germany before corporal punishment was banned in 1980.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/europe/8558311.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-03-09-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Prince Ernst August of Hanover, husband of Caroline, Princess of Hanover, is fined €200,000 by a court in Hildesheim for assaulting a hotelier on Lamu Island in 2000. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/europe/8557765.stm>); [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/europe/monaco/7407401/Princess-Caroline-of-Monacos-husband-fined-for-Kenya-hotel-assault.html>); [The Sydney Morning Herald](<http://news.smh.com.au/breaking-news-world/princess-carolines-husband-fined-20100310-pw36.html>); [IOL](<http://www.iol.co.za/index.php?from=rss_Europe&amp;set_id=1&amp;click_id=24&amp;art_id=nw20100309145741416C461121>); [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/Entertainment/wireStory?id=10049951>).

Source citations (as archived): [RNZI](<http://www.rnzi.com/pages/news.php?op=read&amp;id=52375>); [Solomon Times](<http://www.solomontimes.com/news.aspx?nwID=4982>).

<a id="event-2010-03-09-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Uyghur man is sentenced to 16 months imprisonment for spying on a Uyghur community in Sweden and passing information to China.

Source citations (as archived): [Malaysia Star](<http://thestar.com.my/news/story.asp?file=/2010/3/9/apworld/20100309191140&amp;sec=apworld>); [Press Trust of India](<http://www.ptinews.com/news/555407_China-denies-spying-on-dissident-groups-in-Sweden>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/world/asia-pacific/8557777.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-03-09-0-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** 186 members of the 245-seat Rajya Sabha of the Sansad in India vote in favour of a bill giving one third of available seats in the national parliament and state legislatures to women. One member votes against, several parties boycott the vote and seven MPs are suspended after expressing their disagreement.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/south_asia/8557237.stm>); [Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/Womens-Bill-passed-in-RS-as-Congress-refuses-to-be-cowed-down/articleshow/5665106.cms>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2010/WORLD/asiapcf/03/08/india.women.parliament/index.html>).

**Archived source account.** The Northern Ireland Assembly votes — 88 votes in favour to 17 Ulster Unionist Party against — in favour of the devolution of justice.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/uk_news/northern_ireland/8558466.stm>); [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2010/0309/northpolitics.html>).

**Archived source account.** Israel grants permission to United Nations Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon and European Union High Representative Catherine Ashton to visit Gaza after denying permission to other international politicians.

Source citations (as archived): [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2010/0309/gaza.html>).

Source citations (as archived): [Ha'aretz](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100311174023/http://www.haaretz.com/hasen/spages/1155171.html>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/middle_east/8558347.stm>); [The Irish Times](<http://www.irishtimes.com/newspaper/world/2010/0310/1224265976902.html>).

<a id="event-2010-03-09-0-17"></a>

Context: Middle East:.

**Archived source account.** Israel seals off the West Bank until midnight on Saturday, fearing repeats of riots which injured dozens of young Palestinians due to Israel preventing Palestinians under the age of 50 and without Israeli identity cards from attending their Jumu'ah (Friday prayers) at the Al-Aqsa Mosque in Jerusalem.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/middleeast/israel/7429027/Israel-seals-off-West-Bank-as-tensions-rise.html>).

<a id="event-2010-03-12-0-9"></a>

### 2010-04-06

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076453065](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2010%20April%206&oldid=1076453065>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2010-04-06-0-1"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** Palestinians fire another Qassam rocket at southern Israel, causing no harm, despite Gaza groups agreement to stop rockets attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Israel/Article.aspx?id=172485>).

<a id="event-2010-04-06-0-2"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** Teenager from the Gaza Strip who was alleged to have been killed by IDF soldiers last week, released from an Egyptian prison, after infiltrating the Egyptian border through an underground tunnel and saying that he and several Palestinian teenagers who were with him were tortured by Egyptian soldiers while in prison.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/MiddleEast/Article.aspx?id=172473>).

<a id="event-2010-04-06-0-3"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** The Israeli military criticises its own soldiers for killing four young Palestinian demonstrators near Nablus in the West Bank in March, with the Commander describing the killings as "an unnecessary operational occurrence with dire consequences".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/middle_east/8604764.stm>); [Arab News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110927150125/http://arabnews.com/middleeast/article39980.ece>).

<a id="event-2010-04-06-0-4"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** Israel's Nahalat Shimon settler group presents an eviction warrant to two further Palestinian families in East Jerusalem, bringing the current total number of Palestinian houses facing eviction in that neighbourhood to eight.

Source citations (as archived): [Arab News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110927150244/http://arabnews.com/middleeast/article39981.ece>).

<a id="event-2010-04-06-0-5"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** Israeli troops arrest for an unrevealed reason three Palestinian civilians in Beit Ommer village and later move them to a military detention centre, as the Israeli military also ransacks homes in Nablus and Hebron.

Source citations (as archived): [The Muslim News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110927213106/http://www.muslimnews.co.uk/news/news.php?article=17787>).

<a id="event-2010-04-06-0-6"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** Egypt allows a rare opening of the Rafah border to permit the first-known Palestinian conjoined twins, their family and a medical team to travel to the National Guard Hospital, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, for separation surgery 10 days after their birth. Abdullah of Saudi Arabia is to pay for the surgery.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100412012422/http://www.haaretz.com/hasen/spages/1161174.html>).

<a id="event-2010-04-06-0-7"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** 23-year-old Israeli Arab Rawi Fuad Sultani is imprisoned for nearly six years for passing on sensitive information about Israeli Army Chief Gabi Ashkenaz.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/middle_east/8605799.stm>); [France24](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100415213915/http://www.france24.com/en/20100406-israeli-arab-jailed-spying-army-chief>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Israel/Article.aspx?ID=172466>); [Haaretz](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100408003703/http://www.haaretz.com/hasen/spages/1161140.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2010-04-06-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Details of North Korea's own Red Star operating system emerge. \{\{Dead link\|date=May 2020 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/technology/8604912.stm>); [IOL](<http://www.ioltechnology.co.za/article_page.php?from=rss_IOLTechHome&amp;iSectionId=2883&amp;iArticleId=5417910>).

<a id="event-2010-04-06-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister of Turkey Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, speaking about 100,000 Armenian illegal immigrants currently living in Turkey, says "I may have to tell these 100,000 to go back to their country because they are not my citizens. I don't have to keep them in my country".

Source citations (as archived): [Ethiopian Review](<https://web.archive.org/web/20111001213613/http://www.ethiopianreview.com/news/55475>).

<a id="event-2010-04-06-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hackers based in China access classified Indian documents, emails of the Dalai Lama, offices of the United Nations and the Pakistani embassy in the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/technology/8605548.stm>); [Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/Chinese-hackers-steal-secret-Indian-documents/articleshow/5767793.cms>); [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/canada/story/2010/04/06/cyber-espionage-research.html>).

#### Law and crime

**Archived source account.** Turkish police arrest at least 14 military officers, including four generals, accused of a 2003 coup plot.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2010/04/20104673854889952.html>); [BBC News](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/europe/8604760.stm>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE63537V20100406?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=worldNews>).

**Archived source account.** Baton-wielding Egyptian police disperse a pro-democracy demonstration in Cairo.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/middle_east/8605565.stm>); [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/egyptNews/idAFLDE6351DU20100406?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=egyptNews>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2010/04/06/AR2010040600701.html>).

<a id="event-2010-04-06-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** South African police build a barricade from razor wire to curtail people scuffles outside Ventersdorp Magistrate's court where two farm workers, aged 15 and 28, are charged with Saturday's murder of white supremacist leader Eugène Terre'Blanche. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/africa/8604375.stm>); [IOL](<http://www.iol.co.za/general/news/newsprint.php?art_id=nw20100406074136492C719886&amp;sf=>).

Source citations (as archived): [Arab News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110927150508/http://arabnews.com/middleeast/article39984.ece>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2010-04-06-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Campaigning ahead of Sri Lanka's parliamentary election comes to an end.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia/2010/04/201045204313325510.html>).

<a id="event-2010-04-06-6-1"></a>

<a id="event-2010-04-06-6-2"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2010/0406/bloodysunday.html>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/uk/2010/apr/06/bloody-sunday-inquiry-delay>); [BBC News](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/uk_news/northern_ireland/foyle_and_west/8606048.stm>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2010-04-06-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Announcement of first animals that spent their entire lives without oxygen were discovered in depths of Mediterranean Sea. They belong to three new species from phylum Loricifera.

### 2010-04-07

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1227191155](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2010%20April%207&oldid=1227191155>).

#### None

<a id="event-2010-04-07-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** James Hansen wins the Sophie Prize.

Source citations (as archived): [350.org](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100703133915/http://www.350.org/about/blogs/james-hansen-wins-sophie-prize>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE63636N20100407>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/environment/us-scientist-hansen-awarded-for-climate-work-1938689.html>).

<a id="event-2010-04-07-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Gay &amp; Lesbian Alliance Against Defamation (GLAAD) announces that the number of LGBT characters on scripted programs in the United States has doubled since 2005.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2010/SHOWBIZ/TV/04/06/is.hollywood.gay.enough/index.html>).

<a id="event-2010-04-07-0-3"></a>

Context: 2010 Kyrgyzstan riots:.

**Archived source account.** President Kurmanbek Bakiyev reportedly flees the country, as the government steps down and protestors overrun the parliament building. The opposition announces the formation of a new provisional government headed by Roza Otunbayeva.

Source citations (as archived): [Russia Today](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100409075333/http://rt.com/Top_News/2010-04-07/kyrgyz-president-flees-country.html>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia/2010/04/201047164717764440.html>).

<a id="event-2010-04-07-0-4"></a>

Context: 2010 Kyrgyzstan riots:.

**Archived source account.** President Kurmanbek Bakiyev makes a last-ditch attempt to quell the riots by imposing a curfew as six people reportedly die. \{\{Dead link\|date=May 2020 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [RIA Novosti](<http://en.rian.ru/world/20100407/158466764.html>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/asia-pacific/8606504.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-04-07-0-5"></a>

Context: 2010 Kyrgyzstan riots:.

**Archived source account.** Protesters seize the state television channel building in the capital, Bishkek. Kyrgyz opposition representatives and human rights activists appear on the TV channel KTR which resumes broadcasting after one hour. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [RIA Novosti](<http://en.rian.ru/exsoviet/20100407/158466963.html>); [Kyrgyz National Informational Agency](<http://www.kabar.kg/en/news/2010/04/07/15501.html>).

<a id="event-2010-04-07-0-6"></a>

Context: 2010 Kyrgyzstan riots:.

**Archived source account.** Interior Minister Moldomussa Kongantiyev is reported to have been killed after being taken hostage by opposition protesters inside an interior department building in the northern city of Talas.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2010-04/07/c_13241258.htm>).

<a id="event-2010-04-07-0-8"></a>

Context: July 12, 2007 Baghdad airstrike WikiLeaks video controversy:.

**Archived source account.** Fox News alleges "many who have viewed the video" WikiLeaks released recently showing American forces killing civilians in a July 12, 2007 Baghdad airstrike have accused the website of "selectively editing" (by slowing down selected parts of it) after a report by The Pentagon was released claiming that several of those killed did have weapons.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/politics/2010/04/07/military-raises-questions-credibility-leaked-iraq-shooting-video/>).

<a id="event-2010-04-07-0-9"></a>

Context: July 12, 2007 Baghdad airstrike WikiLeaks video controversy:.

**Archived source account.** Families of the victims request that those responsible be taken to court as two young children who were injured ask why their dead father was targeted when he tried to bring an injured man to hospital.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2010/04/20104782857326667.html>).

<a id="event-2010-04-07-0-11"></a>

Context: Conjoined twins:.

**Archived source account.** The conjoined twins recently born in Gaza less than two weeks ago are reported as being in a critical condition in Saudi Arabia where surgery is taking place to separate them.

Source citations (as archived): [Arab News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100411222153/http://arabnews.com/saudiarabia/article40394.ece>).

<a id="event-2010-04-07-0-12"></a>

Context: Conjoined twins:.

**Archived source account.** The conjoined twins from Cork, Ireland, born four months ago, undergo separation surgery in London.

Source citations (as archived): [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2010/0407/benhaffaf.html>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/uk/2010/apr/07/conjoined-twins-separation>); [Irish Independent](<http://www.independent.ie/national-news/mother-prays-for-her-little-fighters-ahead-of-last-battle-2126279.html>); [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/health/healthnews/7561911/Conjoined-twins-to-be-separated-fact-file.html>).

<a id="event-2010-04-07-0-14"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** Campaigning organisations call for the lifting of an Israeli media ban on the "security case", the case of a 23-year-old former soldier who leaked details of extra-judicial killings of Palestinians.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/middle_east/8608227.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-04-07-0-15"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** Saudi cleric Sheik Mohammed al-Areefi cancels a visit to Jerusalem due to public anger at Israeli policy.

Source citations (as archived): [Saudi Gazette](<https://web.archive.org/web/20120302081235/http://www.saudigazette.com.sa/index.cfm?method=home.regcon&amp;contentID=2010040868747>); [Arab News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100410184737/http://arabnews.com/saudiarabia/article40389.ece>); [Ha'aetz](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100410090508/http://www.haaretz.com/hasen/spages/1161437.html>).

<a id="event-2010-04-07-0-16"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** An 18-year-old dies and six others escape with their lives in Rafah, Gaza, after the collapse of two tunnels used to smuggle goods through Egypt and around Egypt's and Israel's blockade.

Source citations (as archived): [Arab News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110927150203/http://arabnews.com/middleeast/article39978.ece>).

<a id="event-2010-04-07-0-17"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas fires the director of his bureau, Rafik Husseini, who was involved in ‘Fatahgate’ sex scandal.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/MiddleEast/Article.aspx?id=172540>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2010/WORLD/meast/04/07/mideast.sex.tape/index.html?hpt=T2>).

<a id="event-2010-04-07-0-18"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** Human Rights Watch tells Hamas to stop executions in Gaza after Hamas courts sentence 16 people to death in 2009 and this year, including eight convicted of alleged “treason”.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/MiddleEast/Article.aspx?id=172543>).

<a id="event-2010-04-07-0-19"></a>

**Archived source account.** Human Rights Watch requests that the Government of Peru investigate the deaths of six civilians after police opened fire on a mining demonstration last Sunday. At least 30 others were injured.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/americas/8606430.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-04-07-0-20"></a>

**Archived source account.** Brazil is hit by a second day of heavy rain.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/americas/2010/04/201047142835717833.html>).

<a id="event-2010-04-07-0-21"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least six people die and at least twelve others are injured after a boat sinks in Lake Kivu while carrying people to commemorations to mark the 16th anniversary of the Rwandan Genocide.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/africa/8608007.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-04-07-0-22"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 7.7-magnitude earthquake strikes northern Sumatra, Indonesia.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://news.blogs.cnn.com/2010/04/06/usgs-earthquake-strikes-northern-sumatra/?hpt=T2>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia-pacific/2010/04/201046223740492250.html>).

<a id="event-2010-04-07-0-23"></a>

**Archived source account.** Blacktown District Soccer Football Association's CEO says he will ignore a FIFA ruling to ban the hijab even if it is enforced by Football Federation Australia after the Iran girls' football team is disqualified from the Youth Olympic Games by FIFA for their view on the hijab.

Source citations (as archived): [The Sydney Morning Herald](<http://www.smh.com.au/sport/football/sydney-football-boss-to-ignore-hijab-rule-20100407-rqfi.html>).

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister of Thailand Abhisit Vejjajiva, declares a state of emergency after widespread anti-government protests and shortly after demonstrators stormed the country's parliament.

<a id="event-2010-04-07-0-25"></a>

**Archived source account.** Amnesty International’s Secretary-General sparks a furor by saying that “jihad in self-defense” is not “antithetical” to human rights.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/International/Article.aspx?id=172534>).

<a id="event-2010-04-07-0-26"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sixteen countries attend a two-day conference organised by the Supreme Council of Antiquities in Cairo to discuss the retrieval of old items which were pillaged by other nations, such as the Rosetta Stone (held by the British Museum, London) and Queen Nefertitti's bust (held by the Neues Museum, Berlin).

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/middle_east/8606458.stm>); [France24](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100410171911/http://www.france24.com/en/20100407-cairo-archaeology-meeting-recover-national-treasures-nefertiti-rosetta-stone>).

<a id="event-2010-04-07-0-27"></a>

**Archived source account.** A starving Grey Seal claiming to be from London Zoo is found in Skerries, Ireland. The Irish Seal Sanctuary asks the UK and Europe for help identifying it.

Source citations (as archived): [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2010/0407/seal.html>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/uk_news/northern_ireland/8608120.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-04-07-0-28"></a>

<a id="event-2010-04-07-0-29"></a>

**Archived source account.** FC Barcelona's Lionel Messi is widely hailed as the best footballer in the world after scoring four goals for the first time in his career in one UEFA Champions League game, including his fourth hat-trick of 2010. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/europe/8606391.stm>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/reuters/2010/04/07/sports/sports-uk-soccer-world-messi-maradona.html>); [AFP](<http://asia.news.yahoo.com/afp/20100407/tsp-fbl-eur-c1-esp-arg-messi-47c0590.html>); [BusinessWorld](<http://www.bworldonline.com/main/content.php?id=8580>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/football/2010/apr/07/lionel-messi>); [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/sport/football/lionel-messi/7564309/Lionel-Messis-brilliance-is-an-inspiration-and-antidote-to-the-modern-game.html>).

<a id="event-2010-04-07-0-30"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tennis player Martina Navratilova announces she has been diagnosed with breast cancer.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2010/apr/07/navratilova-breast-cancer-reaction>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/reuters/2010/04/07/sports/sports-uk-tennis-navratilova.html?_r=1&amp;partner=rss&amp;emc=rss>).

<a id="event-2010-04-07-0-32"></a>

**Archived source account.** Norway experiences its first Catholic child abuse scandal as it becomes known that a bishop, Georg Müller, was forced to resign in 2009 because of sexual abuse of an altar boy in the early 1990s.

#### 2010 Kyrgyzstan riots

**Archived source account.** The Kyrgyzstan government is ousted as the result of the popular revolt.

### 2010-04-10

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076452846](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2010%20April%2010&oldid=1076452846>).

#### 2010 Polish Air Force Tu-154 crash

<a id="event-2010-04-10-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Tu-154 from the 36th Special Aviation Regiment crashes while landing at military airport Severny in Smolensk Oblast, Russia; 96 persons onboard are reported dead. Pilot error is seen as a possible cause of the crash.

Source citations (as archived): [MSNBC](<http://www.msnbc.msn.com/id/36352097/ns/world_news-europe/>); [Вести; Russian](<http://www.vesti.ru/>); [lenta.ru; Russian](<http://lenta.ru/news/2010/04/10/cause/>).

<a id="event-2010-04-10-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The plane was flying from Warsaw to mark the 70th anniversary of the Katyn massacre.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/pilot-ignored-warnings-in-polish-crash-1.897456>).

<a id="event-2010-04-10-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The plane carried President of Poland Lech Kaczyński, his economist wife, army chief, central bank governor, MPs, leading historians, and many top Polish government officials to their deaths.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/europe/8612825.stm>); [The Hindu](<http://beta.thehindu.com/news/international/article393764.ece>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2010/04/11/world/europe/11kaczynski.html>).

<a id="event-2010-04-10-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** There are no survivors.

Source citations (as archived): [Passenger list](<http://in.reuters.com/article/worldNews/idINIndia-47592220100410>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2010/WORLD/europe/04/10/poland.president.plane.crash/?hpt=T1>); [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/news/nation-and-world/la-fgw-polish-president-crash11-2010apr11,0,3292908.story>).

<a id="event-2010-04-10-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Polish parliamentary speaker Bronisław Komorowski legally becomes Acting President of Poland.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/china/2010-04/10/c_13245614.htm>).

<a id="event-2010-04-10-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Lech Wałęsa calls it "the second disaster after Katyn... They wanted to cut off our head there, and here the flower of our nation has also perished".

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2010/04/11/world/europe/11poland.html?hp>).

<a id="event-2010-04-10-0-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Poland's Foreign Ministry spokesman Piotr Paszkowski says "Nothing like this has ever happened in Poland".

Source citations (as archived): [The Sydney Morning Herald](<http://www.smh.com.au/world/pilgrimage-ends-in-tragedy-20100410-rzwl.html>).

<a id="event-2010-04-10-0-7"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2010/0410/kaczynskil.html>); [The Star Malaysia](<http://thestar.com.my/news/story.asp?file=/2010/4/10/worldupdates/2010-04-10T182107Z_01_NOOTR_RTRMDNC_0_-475884-8&amp;sec=Worldupdates>).

<a id="event-2010-04-11-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The body of President Lech Kaczyński, who was killed in yesterday's plane crash just north of Smolensk, Russia, is flown back to Poland.

### 2010-04-13

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1217123908](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2010%20April%2013&oldid=1217123908>).

#### Nuclear Security Summit

<a id="event-2010-04-13-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** President of the United States Barack Obama opening the biggest international meeting hosted by the US since 1945, greets leaders from nearly 50 countries. World leaders at the summit hear dire warnings of the danger of nuclear material falling into the wrong hands.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/world/americas/8616855.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-04-13-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Georgian president, Mikheil Saakashvili, says that his government thwarted an attempt to sell highly enriched uranium on the black market last month.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/julian-borger-global-security-blog/2010/apr/13/georgia-nuclear-smuggling>).

<a id="event-2010-04-13-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hu Jintao, President of the People's Republic of China, meets with President Barack Obama to discuss Iran's nuclear program.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2010/POLITICS/04/13/obama.hu.nuclear.meeting/index.html?hpt=T2>).

<a id="event-2010-04-13-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A magnitude 6.9 earthquake strikes southeastern Qinghai, China, near the Yangtze River. There were no immediate reports of casualties. \{\{Dead link\|date=May 2020 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [The Associated Press](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5gdspdDB0WaMv_An4A-NvHB_DwmCwD9F2GOC00>); [Vancouver Sun](<https://vancouversun.com/magnitude+earthquake+hits+northwest+China/2903016/story.html>).

<a id="event-2010-04-13-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bar of radioactive cobalt-60 found in a New Delhi market causes life-threatening radiation sickness in one person and contingency measures from the authorities.

Source citations (as archived): ["The Faster Times"](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100417010722/http://thefastertimes.com/india/2010/04/13/forget-loose-nuclear-weapons-its-loose-nuclear-waste-that-is-the-real-worry/>).

<a id="event-2010-04-13-0-5"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/skynews/Home/World-News/Peru-Tsunami-After-Hualcan-Glacier-Breaks-Off-Into-513-Lake-Andes-Wave-Hits-Carhuaz-Near-Lima/Article/201004215600502?lpos=World_News_Second_Home_Page_Feature_Teaser_Region_0&amp;lid=ARTICLE_15600502_Peru%3A_Tsunami_After_Hualcan_Glacier_Breaks_Off_Into_513_Lake%3A_Andes_Wave_Hits_Carhuaz_Near_Lima>); [The Peruvian Times](<http://www.peruviantimes.com/state-of-emergency-declared-in-parts-of-ancash-after-ice-block-breaks-from-glacier/135719>).

#### Eruption of Eyjafjallajökull volcano

<a id="event-2010-04-16-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Travel chaos spreads across Europe as planes are grounded in the United Kingdom, Norway, Sweden, Finland and Russia as a result of the giant cloud of ash coming across from Iceland.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/uk/8623806.stm>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2010/04/201041692933434631.html>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2010/TRAVEL/04/16/iceland.flights.volcano/index.html>).

<a id="event-2010-04-16-0-1"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/skynews/Home/UK-News/Volcano-Ash-Cloud-Flight-Restrictions-Will-Continue-Until-1am-Sat-NATS-Warns-After-Iceland-Eruption/Article/201004315604129?lpos=UK_News_Top_Stories_Header_0&amp;lid=ARTICLE_15604129_Volcano_Ash_Cloud_Flight_Restrictions_Will_Continue_Until_1am_Sat%2C_NATS_Warns_After_Iceland_Eruption>).

<a id="event-2010-04-16-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ireland opens its air space and transatlantic flights resume from Dublin Airport. A small section off the south coast remains closed.

<a id="event-2010-04-16-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ryanair, Europe's largest low-cost carrier, cancels all flights to and from Ireland, Britain, Denmark, Finland, Norway, Sweden, Belgium, the Netherlands, northern France, northern Germany, Poland and the Baltic states until 12:00 GMT on Monday: CEO Michael O'Leary calls the situation "unprecedented".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSWLB270820100416?type=marketsNews>); [Barcelona Reporter](<https://web.archive.org/web/20120305205413/http://www.barcelonareporter.com/index.php?%2Fnews%2Fcomments%2Fryanair_flights_cancelled_from_17_04_2010_till_until_1300hrs_19th_april_lis%2F1704100740pm>); [Irish Independent](<http://www.independent.ie/national-news/thousands-grounded-until-next-week-2141959.html>).

Source citations (as archived): [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2010/0417/abuse.html>); [The Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/europe/Cardinal-justifies-praise-for-French-bishops-silence-over-abusive-priest/articleshow/5826601.cms>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE63G1SH20100417>).

<a id="event-2010-04-17-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Benedict flies to Malta to commemorate the 1,950th anniversary of the shipwreck of Saint Paul on the island, his first overseas visit since the latest round of child sex abuse claims.

Source citations (as archived): [The Observer](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2010/apr/18/pope-cover-up-aide-took-blame-munich>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2010/04/18/world/europe/18pope.html>).

<a id="event-2010-04-17-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** President of Malta George Abela mentions an abuse trial involving three Catholic clergy in his speech to mark Benedict's coming, saying "justice had both to be done and seen to be done". Benedict makes no direct reference.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/europe/8627429.stm>).

#### April 2010 Kohat bombings

<a id="event-2010-04-17-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Twin bombings on a centre for the displaced in the town of Kohat, Pakistan, kill at least 42 people and injure dozens of others.

Source citations (as archived): [TVNZ](<http://tvnz.co.nz/world-news/bombs-kill-20-centre-displaced-in-pakistan-3470446>); [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2010-04/17/c_13255848.htm>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE6364J320100417?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=topNews>); [The New Yorjk Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2010/04/18/world/asia/18pstan.html>).

<a id="event-2010-04-17-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Nations condemns the twin attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [Dawn](<http://www.dawn.com/wps/wcm/connect/dawn-content-library/dawn/news/pakistan/provinces/12-un+condemns+attack+on+idp+camp+in+kohat--bi-03>).

<a id="event-2010-04-17-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Twin bombs injure eight people outside M. Chinnaswamy Stadium in Bangalore ahead of an IPL-3 league game between the Royal Challengers Bangalore and the Mumbai Indians. A third device is located outside.

Source citations (as archived): [Indian Express](<http://www.indianexpress.com/news/2-blasts-outside-ipl-venue-in-bangalore-another-bomb-defused-show-goes-on/607965/>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/south_asia/8626992.stm>); [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/sport/cricket/international/india/7601529/Eight-injured-in-Bangalore-bomb-attack-before-IPL-game-featuring-Kevin-Pietersen.html>).

<a id="event-2010-04-17-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Over 100,000 mourners attend a memorial service to honour the death of the Polish president Lech Kaczyński, and 95 others who were killed in a plane crash the previous week.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2010/apr/17/lech-kaczynski-crash-memorial-warsaw>).

<a id="event-2010-04-17-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Snowfall in central Tokyo matches a record set in April 1967.

Source citations (as archived): [The Japan Times](<http://search.japantimes.co.jp/cgi-bin/nn20100418a3.html>); [MSN Malaysia](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100419004338/http://news.malaysia.msn.com/regional/article.aspx?cp-documentid=4034377>).

<a id="event-2010-04-17-3-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two oil tankers collide and burst into flames, killing at least five people and wounding several more, in southwest Nigeria. Three large freight trucks along the Lagos-Ibadan expressway also ignite.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5i4dCPwYSWglZis25EYxga625wcfg>).

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/americas/2010/04/2010416131130451197.html>).

<a id="event-2010-04-17-3-7"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [The Sydney Morning Herald](<http://www.smh.com.au/national/earthquake-hits-adelaide-hills-20100417-skw5.html>).

<a id="event-2010-04-17-3-8"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/uknews/7602026/Two-dead-as-light-aircraft-crashes-in-Hampshire.html>); [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2010/0417/uk.html>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/uk_news/england/hampshire/8627661.stm>); [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/skynews/Home/UK-News/Two-People-Die-After-A-Light-Aircraft-Crashed-Into-A-Field-Near-Andover-Hampshire-Police-Say/Article/201004315607486?lpos=UK_News_First_UK_News_Article_Teaser_Region_3&amp;lid=ARTICLE_15607486_Two_People_Die_After_A_Light_Aircraft_Crashed_Into_A_Field_Near_Andover%2C_Hampshire_Police_Say>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/uk/2010/apr/17/light-aircraft-crash-andover>).

<a id="event-2010-04-18-0-18"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mugabe also asks that politically and racially driven violence in the country cease to be, the first time he has ever done this.

#### 2010 Explosion on Deepwater Horizon drilling rig

<a id="event-2010-04-22-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Transocean oil platform Deepwater Horizon sinks into the Gulf of Mexico off the coast of Louisiana after an explosion two days earlier that injured 7, with 11 still missing.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2010/US/04/22/oil.rig.explosion/index.html?hpt=T2>).

**Archived source account.** Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk announces 2 billion złoty from budget reserves to be given to those affected.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE64O4F220100525>); [Voice of America](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100527003829/http://www1.voanews.com/english/news/europe/Polish-PM-Promises-Relief-for-Flood-Victims-94867949.html>).

<a id="event-2010-05-25-0-5"></a>

Context: May 2010 Central European floods:.

**Archived source account.** Polish Minister of the Interior, Jerzy Miller, says beavers caused the floods; local authorities up hunting quotas for the animals.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/europe/poland/7764347/Beavers-responsible-for-Polands-flooding.html>).

<a id="event-2010-05-25-0-6"></a>

Context: May 2010 Central European floods:.

**Archived source account.** A Russian Ministry of Emergency Situations plane with humanitarian aid for Poland begins its flight to Warsaw.

Source citations (as archived): [RIA Novosti](<http://en.rian.ru/world/20100525/159154709.html>).

<a id="event-2010-05-25-0-7"></a>

Context: May 2010 Central European floods:.

**Archived source account.** The Oder's water levels rise in eastern Germany as flood warnings are issued in Ratzdorf and Eisenhüttenstadt.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/skynews/Home/World-News/Poland-Floods-Germany-On-Flood-Alert-After-Severe-Polish-Flooding-Risks-Damage-On-Border/Article/201005415638174?lpos=World_News_First_Home_Article_Teaser_Region_6&amp;lid=ARTICLE_15638174_Poland_Floods%3A_Germany_On_Flood_Alert_After_Severe_Polish_Flooding_Risks_Damage_On_Border>).

<a id="event-2010-05-25-0-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** An international operation against a major drug trafficking gang deals "a major blow" as 26 people are arrested in Ireland, Spain and the United Kingdom, including a capo di tutti capi. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2010/0525/drugs.html>); [The Irish Times](<http://www.irishtimes.com/newspaper/ireland/2010/0526/1224271144329.html>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/europe/10157294.stm>); [France24](<http://www.france24.com/en/20100525-32-arrested-hit-major-european-crime-ring>); [The Sydney Morning Herald](<http://news.smh.com.au/breaking-news-world/drug-godfather-caught-in-european-swoop-20100526-wbct.html>).

<a id="event-2010-05-25-0-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva launches TV Brasil Internacional, an international television station currently broadcasting to African nations. \{\{Dead link\|date=July 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/latin_america/10152301.stm>); [France24](<http://www.france24.com/en/20100525-brazil-launches-international-tv-network>); [MercoPress](<http://en.mercopress.com/2010/05/24/brazil-launches-its-public-broadcasting-service-targeted-to-africa>).

<a id="event-2010-05-25-0-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** Increased tensions over the sinking of the South Korean warship ROKS Cheonan (PCC-772): South Korea begins broadcasting propaganda over its border with North Korea. North Korea severs all ties and communications with the South and expels Southern workers from a jointly-run factory above the border.

Source citations (as archived): [Yonhap](<http://english.yonhapnews.co.kr/national/2010/05/25/75/0301000000AEN20100525007500315F.HTML>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/asia_pacific/10156834.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-05-25-0-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** A court in Thailand issues an arrest warrant for former Prime Minister Thaksin Shinawatra on charges of terrorism, following a report by the Thai Department of Special Investigations, which concluded that he had financed Red Shirt protesters and had helped them smuggle in weapons and fighters from Cambodia, during the 2010 political crisis.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia-pacific/2010/05/201052565721987560.html>).

<a id="event-2010-05-25-0-12"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 17 people die after a tourist bus crashes in Antalya.

Source citations (as archived): [RIA Novosti](<http://en.rian.ru/russia/20100525/159149311.html>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/europe/10151869.stm>); [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/stories/2010/05/25/world/main6516654.shtml>); [Hürriyet Daily News &amp; Economic Review](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100528225442/http://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/n.php?n=visa-removal-to-boost-russian-visitor-numbers-2010-05-25>); [Today's Zaman](<https://web.archive.org/web/20121004190941/http://www.todayszaman.com/tz-web/news-211202-101-15-die-25-injured-as-bus-carrying-russian-tourists-plunges-off-bridge.html>).

<a id="event-2010-05-25-0-13"></a>

**Archived source account.** A white teacher in Dahlonega, Georgia is suspended after permitting non-black students to bring bed sheets and cone-shaped party hats to school to dress in the traditional costume of right-wing white supremacist nationalist organisation Ku Klux Klan for a film project. She refuses to apologise after the issue is raised by African-American students when one of them was asked to take part in a re-enactment of a lynching.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/us_and_canada/10157270.stm>); [Pretoria News](<http://www.pretorianews.co.za/?fSectionId=3534&amp;fArticleId=iol1274790923216D520>); [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/northamerica/usa/7764776/Teacher-let-students-dress-in-Ku-Klux-Klan-outfits.html>).

<a id="event-2010-05-25-0-14"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iran releases film director Jafar Panahi after more than two months in custody, including a hunger strike, following an international campaign led by the actress Juliette Binoche.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/middle_east/10155119.stm>); [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/middleeast/iran/7764504/Iranian-director-Jafar-Panahi-released-from-prison-on-200000-bail.html>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/film/2010/may/25/jafar-pahani-released-iran-prison>).

**Archived source account.** The Malaysian tanker MT Bunga Kelana 3 and a bulk carrier collide in the Singapore Strait, resulting in an estimated 2,000 tonnes of oil spilled.

<a id="event-2010-05-25-0-18"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sicilians react with outrage to an advert for a clothing shop in Palermo featuring Adolf Hitler dressed in pink and a heart instead of a swastika.

<a id="event-2010-05-25-0-20"></a>

**Archived source account.** A study indicates that the Pac-Man game Google put on its home page Friday led to the loss of almost five million man-hours (or 550 years) of work time.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/technology/10153286.stm>); [CBC News](<http://www.cbc.ca/technology/story/2010/05/25/pacman-google.html?ref=rss>); [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/sciencetech/article-1281317/Google-Pac-Man-game-eats-million-hours-work-time.html>).

<a id="event-2010-05-25-0-21"></a>

**Archived source account.** Bono is released from hospital in Munich following his spinal surgery as U2 confirm the postponement of the North America leg of the U2 360° Tour and cancel their headlining slot at the Glastonbury Festival 2010.

Source citations (as archived): [The Irish Times](<http://www.irishtimes.com/newspaper/breaking/2010/0525/breaking34.html?via=mr>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2010/SHOWBIZ/Music/05/25/u2.bono.tour/?hpt=T2>); [The Sydney Morning Herald](<http://www.smh.com.au/entertainment/music/u2-cancels-glastonbury-after-bono-hurt-20100526-wbmt.html>).

<a id="event-2010-05-25-0-23"></a>

**Archived source account.** South African opera star Siphiwo Ntshebe, chosen by Nelson Mandela to sing "Hope" at the opening ceremony of the 2010 FIFA World Cup next month, dies suddenly aged 34 after contracting meningitis.

Source citations (as archived): [IOL](<https://web.archive.org/web/20071005215013/http://www.iol.co.za/index.php?set_id=6>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/entertainment_and_arts/10162343.stm>); [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/arts/music/story/2010/05/26/worldcup-opera-singer.html>); [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/sport/football/world-cup-2010/7767479/South-Africas-World-Cup-tenor-dies-on-eve-of-tournament.html>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2010/may/26/siphiwo-ntshebe-dies>).

**Archived source account.** Ivor Powell, the world's oldest football coach and "one of the great footballers of his generation" retires at the age of 93.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/uk_news/england/bristol/somerset/8704103.stm>).

### 2010-05-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1320452249](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2010%20May%2026&oldid=1320452249>).

#### None

<a id="event-2010-05-26-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** More than 80 students are sickened in a girls' school in Kunduz, Afghanistan, in a poison gas attack suspected to have been carried out by Taliban assailants whose version of Islam is opposed to girls being educated.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/news/world/afghanistan/2010-05-27-afghanistan-girls_N.htm>).

<a id="event-2010-05-26-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** International Criminal Court judges tell the UN Security Council that the Sudanese government is protecting suspects wanted for war crimes in Darfur instead of arresting them to face trial.

Source citations (as archived): [The Globe and Mail](<https://www.theglobeandmail.com/news/world/africa-mideast/sudan-protecting-war-crime-suspects-icc-tells-un/article1581193/>).

<a id="event-2010-05-26-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Jamaican police arrest more than 500 people after an unsuccessful attempt to arrest a suspected drug kingpin in Kingston, the capital, results in violence that leaves at least 44 people dead.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2010/WORLD/americas/05/26/jamaica/index.html?hpt=T2>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/latin_america/10164623.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-05-26-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two of Ethiopia's main opposition leaders call for a rerun of Sunday's elections won by Western-backed Meles Zenawi. They say the elections were not free and fair and that two politicians were killed by security forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2010/05/201052695612872212.html>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/africa/10162310.stm>); [The Hindu](<http://beta.thehindu.com/news/international/article438850.ece>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE64P5IZ20100526>).

<a id="event-2010-05-26-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Brandenburg reaches level four on the disaster alert scale as water levels along the Oder and Neisse rivers continue to rise.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw-world.de/dw/article/0,,5608973,00.html>).

<a id="event-2010-05-26-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Israel launches two night-time air strikes on the Gaza Strip in response to mortar attacks and the detonation of 200 kg of explosives laden on a donkey-cart next to the border fence.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/middle_east/10160892.stm>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/MiddleEast/Article.aspx?id=176452>).

<a id="event-2010-05-26-0-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Palestinian Authority President Mahmoud Abbas condemns Iran, saying his people were “hijacked, at the hands of the Iranians”; possibly referring to Hamas's refusal to reconcile with Fatah on Iran's command by announcing on that it would boycott the Palestinian municipal elections

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/MiddleEast/Article.aspx?id=176514>).

<a id="event-2010-05-26-0-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Palestinian Authority security forces arrest scores of Hamas officials and supporters in the West Bank a day after Hamas announced that it would boycott the Palestinian municipal elections scheduled for July 17.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/MiddleEast/Article.aspx?id=176508>).

<a id="event-2010-05-26-0-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** The chief rabbi of a West Bank settlement declares that women should be prohibited from standing in a local community election.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/middle_east/10161713.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-05-26-0-10"></a>

Context: Nuclear program of Iran:.

**Archived source account.** Iranian President Mahmoud Ahmadinejad and Russian President Dmitry Medvedev disagree over Russia's support for United Nations sanctions concerning Iran's nuclear program, with some analysts describing it as the worst row between the countries for several years.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSLDE64P0VV20100526>).

<a id="event-2010-05-26-0-11"></a>

Context: Nuclear program of Iran:.

**Archived source account.** Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva questions why American President Barack Obama ignored Iran's nuclear agreement with Brazil and Turkey and presented new sanctions to the United Nations Security Council, saying this is "not the attitude that someone who won the Nobel Peace Prize has" and describing himself as "disappointed".

Source citations (as archived): [Buenos Aires Herald](<http://www.buenosairesherald.com/BreakingNews/View/34310>).

<a id="event-2010-05-26-0-12"></a>

**Archived source account.** Lori Berenson is freed on parole after serving 15 years in a Peruvian prison for aiding the Túpac Amaru Revolutionary Movement.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/latin_america/10159928.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-05-26-0-13"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iraq announces the dissolution of state-owned Iraqi Airways over the next three years and the pursuit of private options to avoid asset claims made by Kuwait over their 1990-91 war.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2010/05/2010526133236850746.html>).

<a id="event-2010-05-26-0-14"></a>

**Archived source account.** The International Criminal Court reports Sudan to the United Nations Security Council for refusing to arrest former Minister Ahmed Haroun and militia leader Ali Muhammad Al Abd-Al-Rahman.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/africa/10167800.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-05-26-0-15"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Lusaka court convicts former Zambian Finance Minister Katele Kalumba of corruption and sentences him to five years with hard labour. Six other people, including former officials in the finance ministry, are also found guilty of corruption.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/africa/10168584.stm>); [IOL](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100606022137/http://www.iol.co.za/index.php?set_id=1&amp;click_id=84&amp;art_id=nw20100526204446353C640907>).

<a id="event-2010-05-26-0-16"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two people are injured and several vehicles are destroyed during a blast in Kandahar.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia/2010/05/201052682429305825.html>).

<a id="event-2010-05-26-0-17"></a>

**Archived source account.** Charles Djou is sworn into the United States House of Representatives, representing Hawaii's 1st congressional district.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100529175707/http://congress.blogs.foxnews.com/2010/05/25/djou-sworn-in-as-us-representative/>).

<a id="event-2010-05-26-0-18"></a>

**Archived source account.** Space Shuttle Atlantis completes its final scheduled mission after landing at Kennedy Space Center, Florida.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/photo/2010-05/27/c_13318950.htm>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2010/US/05/26/atlantis.landing/?hpt=Sbin>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/science_and_environment/10163351.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-05-26-0-19"></a>

**Archived source account.** Elton John makes his Moroccan debut at the Mawazine festival in Rabat, ignoring calls for him to be banned by Islamists who feared he would offend public morals.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/africa/10161040.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-05-26-0-20"></a>

**Archived source account.** Virtual band Gorillaz are announced to replace U2 as headliners of the Glastonbury Festival 2010.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/entertainment/8706700.stm>); [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/arts/music/story/2010/05/26/gorillaz-glastonbury.html>); [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/arts/2010/0526/u2.html>); [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/idUKTRE64P46S20100526>); [The Times](<http://entertainment.timesonline.co.uk/tol/arts_and_entertainment/music/festivals/article7137140.ece>).

<a id="event-2010-05-26-0-21"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Alaotra grebe, a grebe endemic to Madagascar, is declared extinct 25 years after its last reported sighting.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/earth/hi/earth_news/newsid_8702000/8702598.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-05-26-0-22"></a>

**Archived source account.** Bret Michaels performed his song Every Rose Has Its Thorn with Casey James on the season 9 finale of American Idol against doctors orders after suffering from a emergency appendectomy, subarachnoid hemorrhage, patent foramen ovale, transient ischemic attack all within the previous 44 days.

Source citations (as archived): [Billboard](<https://www.billboard.com/music/music-news/ailing-bret-michaels-performs-on-idol-finale-958021/>).

### 2010-05-27

**Archived source account.** The Gulf of Mexico oil spill is now the worst oil spill in U.S. history, surpassing the worst previous spill, the Exxon Valdez wreck on the Alaska coast in 1989, according to scientists' latest estimates.

<a id="event-2010-05-27-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two campaigners for LGBT rights in Zimbabwe are freed after spending six days in custody on charges of possessing pornographic material and insulting President Robert Mugabe.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/africa/10178826.stm>); [IOL](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100530220546/http://www.iol.co.za/index.php?set_id=1>); [News24.com](<http://www.news24.com/Africa/Zimbabwe/Zim-frees-2-gay-group-staff-20100527>).

**Archived source account.** North Korea says it will scrap an accord aimed at preventing accidental naval clashes with South Korea after being blamed for a torpedo attack that sank a South Korean warship.

<a id="event-2010-05-27-0-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** France detains Rwandan doctor Eugene Rwamucyo, wanted by Interpol since 2006 and accused of involvement in the Rwandan Genocide.

<a id="event-2010-05-27-0-8"></a>

Context: Sudan:.

**Archived source account.** Many international leaders stay away from the inauguration of Omar al-Bashir, wanted by the International Criminal Court for war crimes in Darfur, as he is sworn in as President of Sudan but at least five African presidents attend the event along with two UN representatives.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/africa/10169735.stm>); [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/idUKTRE64Q23520100527>).

<a id="event-2010-05-27-0-9"></a>

Context: Sudan:.

**Archived source account.** The Sudanese government says it will no longer engage in peace talks with the Justice and Equality Movement (JEM), promising to prosecute its leaders instead.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2010/05/2010526203549379729.html>).

<a id="event-2010-05-27-0-11"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** Israel summons the ambassadors of Cyprus, Greece, Ireland, Sweden and Turkey to protest the expedition as an unnecessary provocation after eight ships, including four cargo vessels and a Turkish passenger ferry carrying 600 people, including a Nobel peace laureate and former U.S. congresswoman, set sail for Gaza with 10,000 tons of humanitarian aid to break a three-year Israeli blockade on the territory.

Source citations (as archived): [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2010/0527/gaza.html>); [Associated Press](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5jFki4MerB8GrGJS2hOVmY5UOJm4wD9FVBBBG1>); [Voice of America](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100528101708/http://www1.voanews.com/english/news/middle-east/Israel-Aid-Ships-are-Cheap-Political-Stunt--95023784.html>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Headlines/Article.aspx?id=176669>).

<a id="event-2010-05-27-0-12"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** Organizers of the aid flotilla refuse an offer of support by the family of kidnapped Israeli soldier Gilad Shalit if they would urge Hamas to allow the soldier to receive letters and food packages from his family and international organizations to visit him.

Source citations (as archived): [Ynetnews](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-3895077,00.html>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Israel/Article.aspx?id=176655>); [Haaretz](<http://www.haaretz.com/news/diplomacy-defense/gaza-aid-convoy-refuses-to-deliver-package-to-gilad-shalit-1.292541>).

<a id="event-2010-05-27-0-13"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** Israel invites the convoy to unload its cargo at the port of Ashdod, where the cargo will be checked for weapons and then the humanitarian goods will be distributed by land to Gaza.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<http://www.haaretz.com/news/diplomacy-defense/israel-gaza-aid-convoy-can-unload-cargo-in-ashdod-for-inspection-1.292560>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Headlines/Article.aspx?id=176669>).

<a id="event-2010-05-27-0-14"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** The Israeli Army shows journalists a detention centre in Ashdod where those on board will locked up, saying Israelis would be arrested, Palestinians would be questioned by the Israeli secret service, and foreign nationals would be sent home.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2010/05/201052791958545391.html>).

<a id="event-2010-05-27-0-15"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** Cyprus bans flotilla vessels from gathering in its territorial waters, a move described by Israel as "an ethical deed and a voice of reason".

Source citations (as archived): [Ynetnews](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-3895287,00.html>).

<a id="event-2010-05-27-0-16"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** Two Palestinians are wounded in an Israeli air strike east of Gaza City in response to Palestinians firing mortar into Israel.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5i17dhqw07M6agNb8DOBCu4B_iJ0w>).

<a id="event-2010-05-28-0-1"></a>
