<a id="event-2010-05-31-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** An undersea volcano erupts near Sarigan, Northern Mariana Islands, sending an eruption cloud 40,000 feet into the atmosphere, prompting Governor Benigno Fitial to declare a state of emergency.

Source citations (as archived): [Saipan Tribune](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100612073808/http://www.saipantribune.com/newsstory.aspx?newsID=100077&amp;cat=1>); [The Wall Street Journal](<http://online.wsj.com/article/SB10001424052748704366504575278212516510890.html>).

<a id="event-2010-05-31-0-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** French President Nicolas Sarkozy, speaking at the launch of the 25th Africa-France summit in Nice, calls for Africa to be represented on the United Nations Security Council, and promises to back changes when France chairs the G8 and G-20 major economies groups in 2011.

Source citations (as archived): [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2010/05/2010531171254212886.html>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/europe/10202964.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-05-31-0-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Sudanese army clashes with rebel groups, among them the Justice and Equality Movement, in the Um Sauna area in western Darfur.

Source citations (as archived): [Businessweek](<http://www.businessweek.com/news/2010-05-31/sudan-army-rebel-groups-clash-in-western-darfur-un-says.html>).

<a id="event-2010-05-31-0-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** In the International Atomic Energy Agency's report before the United Nations Security Council votes on sanctions against Iran, international nuclear inspectors state that Iran has now produced a stockpile of nuclear fuel that would be enough, with further enrichment, to make two nuclear weapons, and it appears to bolster the Obama administration’s case for a fourth round of economic sanctions against Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2010/06/01/world/middleeast/01nuke.html>); [Washington Times](<http://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2010/may/31/report-iran-mum-but-making-nuke-material/>).

<a id="event-2010-05-31-0-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** Wildfires burn across Quebec, sending smoke as far away as Ottawa and Cape Cod.

Source citations (as archived): [Boston Herald](<https://web.archive.org/web/20120319225115/http://bostonherald.com/news/regional/view/20100531smoke_hanging_on_cape_and_region_a_canadian_import/srvc%3Dhome%26position%3D6>); [CBC News](<http://www.cbc.ca/canada/montreal/story/2010/05/31/quebec-forest-fires.html>).

<a id="event-2010-05-31-0-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** Afghan authorities suspend two Christian foreign aid groups, Church World Service and Norwegian Church Aid, on suspicion of proselytizing in the strictly Islamic republic and said a follow-up investigation would include whether other groups were trying to convert Muslims.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/news/world/afghanistan/2010-05-31-afghan-charities-suspended_N.htm>).

<a id="event-2010-05-31-0-12"></a>

Context: Gaza flotilla clash:.

**Archived source account.** A number of Israeli warships follow the Gaza-bound international flotilla as it nears its destination and an aircraft flies overhead.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2010/05/2010530233136303508.html>); [The Press Association](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ukpress/article/ALeqM5i0_9ccUWlMZXfBYhpQNLsxLw_wbA>).

<a id="event-2010-05-31-0-13"></a>

Context: Gaza flotilla clash:.

**Archived source account.** Three Israeli navy missile boats leave the Haifa naval base in northern Israel in a planned attempt to intercept the Gaza-bound international flotilla.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2010/05/31/world/middleeast/31flotilla.html>).

<a id="event-2010-05-31-0-14"></a>

Context: Gaza flotilla clash:.

**Archived source account.** Nearly all Israeli unions announce a boycott of organized workers' trips to Turkey due to the country's support for the flotilla, with one saying that "Turkey had been wiped off the workers unions' travel maps".

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Israel/Article.aspx?id=176938>).

<a id="event-2010-05-31-0-15"></a>

Context: Gaza flotilla clash:.

**Archived source account.** Israeli forces storm the Gaza-bound international flotilla, resulting in the deaths of at least 10 activists.

Source citations (as archived): [Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Israel/Article.aspx?id=177040>); [Ynetnews](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-3896796,00.html>); [Brisbane Times](<http://news.brisbanetimes.com.au/breaking-news-world/at-least-10-killed-as-israel-storms-aid-convoy-israeli-tv-20100531-wqcf.html>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/middle_east/10195838.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-05-31-0-16"></a>

Context: Gaza flotilla clash:.

**Archived source account.** 50 injuries are reported.

Source citations (as archived): [Ynetnews](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-3896416,00.html>).

<a id="event-2010-05-31-0-17"></a>

Context: Gaza flotilla clash:.

**Archived source account.** According to Israel's Defense minister, Ehud Barak, IDF chief of staff and Navy commander, the organisers are to blame for deaths from the Israeli attacks upon the flotilla, with Barak saying that the soldiers tried to board the ship peacefully but were forced to open fire to protect themselves.

Source citations (as archived): [Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Israel/Article.aspx?id=176998>); [Ynet](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-3896685,00.html>).

<a id="event-2010-05-31-0-18"></a>

Context: Gaza flotilla clash:.

**Archived source account.** Israeli Navy ships escort boats from the Gaza protest flotilla to the port of Ashdod, hours after the clash.

Source citations (as archived): [Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Israel/Article.aspx?id=176970>).

<a id="event-2010-05-31-0-20"></a>

Context: Pope Benedict XVI and child sexual abuse in the Roman Catholic Church:.

**Archived source account.** The Vatican announces details of the Apostolic Visitation, a special inquiry into sexual abuse in the Catholic Church in Ireland.

Source citations (as archived): [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2010/0531/abuse.html>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/northern_ireland/10197774.stm>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE64U2BW20100531>); [AP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5hH-e1FTvF61v8gt0efOO4w5Kz60wD9G1TL1G0>).

<a id="event-2010-05-31-0-21"></a>

Context: Pope Benedict XVI and child sexual abuse in the Roman Catholic Church:.

**Archived source account.** Pope Benedict XVI accepts the resignation of Archbishop of Benin City in Nigeria, Richard Burke, following more allegations of child sexual abuse.

Source citations (as archived): [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2010/0531/burker.html>); [The Irish Times](<http://www.irishtimes.com/newspaper/breaking/2010/0531/breaking40.html>); [The Press Association](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ukpress/article/ALeqM5haw31hXg5pJtUxyNf0Pn0aHf1r_A>).

<a id="event-2010-05-31-0-22"></a>

**Archived source account.** The 25th EU-Russia summit begins in Rostov-on-Don with talks on industrial and trade links, human rights and a visa-free regime. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [EU Observer](<http://euobserver.com/9/30168>); [Voice of Russia](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110716090844/http://english.ruvr.ru/2010/05/31/8761013.html>); [The Hürriyet](<http://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/n.php?n=russia-and-crisis-hit-eu-to-ease-disputes-at-summit-2010-05-31>).

<a id="event-2010-05-31-0-23"></a>

**Archived source account.** Six Turkish soldiers are killed in a rocket attack on a navy base by suspected Kurdish rebels in the south of the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2010/05/201053163149531404.html>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/world/europe/10195996.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-05-31-0-24"></a>

**Archived source account.** A court in Pakistan lifts a ban on Facebook imposed two weeks ago after an "Everybody Draw Mohammed Day" group appeared on the site.

Source citations (as archived): [Press Trust of India](<http://www.ptinews.com/news/679839_Pak-court-orders-Facebook-access-to-be-restored>); [AP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5gaYX44y9hFrAImMU0qoclnK-_aMQD9G1NE9O0>); [RTT News](<http://www.rttnews.com/Content/GeneralNews.aspx?Id=1320296&amp;SM=1>).


## June

### 2010-06-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1305895309](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2010%20June%201&oldid=1305895309>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2010-06-01-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 5 people are killed in an attack on the Lahore hospital in Pakistan where many of the injured in Friday's attack on members of the Ahmadis sect, as well as one of the captured militants, are undergoing treatment.

Source citations (as archived): [Geotv](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100604053739/http://www.geo.tv/6-1-2010/65946.htm>); [The Hindu](<http://beta.thehindu.com/news/article443198.ece>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/news/world/2010-05-31-pakistan-hospital-shooting_N.htm>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2010/WORLD/asiapcf/05/31/pakistan.er.shooting/?hpt=T3>).

<a id="event-2010-06-01-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Al-Qaeda's top leader in Afghanistan, and Osama bin Laden's third in command, Mustafa Abu al-Yazid, is reported killed.

Source citations (as archived): [The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/world/al-qaidas-top-leader-in-afghanistan-mustafa-abu-al-yazid-dies/story-e6frg6so-1225873950759>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2010/WORLD/asiapcf/05/31/afghanistan.qaeda.death/?hpt=Sbin>).

<a id="event-2010-06-01-0-3"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Israeli Defense Forces kill two Palestinians terrorists in Gaza who were attempting to cross the border fence, after an exchange of gunfire. Israel closes four settlements, Route 323 and schools as a result of the incident.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Israel/Article.aspx?id=177098>).

<a id="event-2010-06-01-0-4"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Jerusalem Post reports that Israeli soldiers have engaged and killed what they describe as three "terrorists" who had fired Kassam Rockets into Israeli lands. No injuries were reported from the rocket attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/MiddleEast/Article.aspx?id=177148>).

<a id="event-2010-06-01-0-5"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** The head of Gaza emergency services confirms that these three Palestinian bodies were retrieved and brought to a morgue in Gaza City.

Source citations (as archived): [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2010/06/201061135822164378.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2010-06-01-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Nanjing Metro opens its Line 2, extending its route length from 22km to 85km, and the number of stations from 16 to 57.

Source citations (as archived): [Railway Gazette](<http://www.railwaygazette.com//news/single-view/view//nanjing-metro-expands.html>).

<a id="event-2010-06-01-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former Vice President of the United States Al Gore and his wife Tipper announce their separation.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<http://content.usatoday.com/communities/theoval/post/2010/06/al-and-tipper-gore-are-separating/1>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2010-06-01-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Poland publishes the transcript of flight data recorders from the fatal 2010 Polish Air Force Tu-154 crash which killed 96 officials and intellectuals on 10 April.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/10206841.stm>); [China Daily](<http://www.chinadaily.com.cn/world/2010-06/01/content_9919593.htm>); [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2010/06/20106115644389229.html>).

<a id="event-2010-06-01-2-2"></a>

Context: Tropical Storm Agatha.

**Archived source account.** 132 people are killed across Central America in the aftermath of the first named storm of the 2010 Pacific hurricane season.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE64S1A620100601>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/weather/storms/2010-05-30-first-tropical-storm-agatha_N.htm?loc=interstitialskip>).

<a id="event-2010-06-01-2-3"></a>

Context: Tropical Storm Agatha.

**Archived source account.** Torrential rains open a large sinkhole which swallows an intersection and part of a city block in Guatemala City.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/latin_america/10200440.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-06-01-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** America's Obama administration warns that BP's oil spill in the Gulf of Mexico could continue until August.

Source citations (as archived): [The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/world/oil-likely-to-keep-spilling-until-august-says-white-house/story-e6frg6so-1225873753073>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2010-06-01-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Iranian ambassador in Baghdad says the recent release of two Iranians from Iraqi custody is not an indication of any impeding deal to free three Americans held in Tehran on spying charges since their capture in July 2009 while hiking in northern Iraq's mountainous Kurdish region.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/news/world/2010-05-31-american-hikers-iran_N.htm>).

<a id="event-2010-06-01-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States insists any Afghan peace deal must ensure women's rights as Afghanistan prepares to open a peace conference aimed at persuading Taliban leaders to put down their weapons.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/news/world/afghanistan/2010-05-31-afghanistan-womens-rights_N.htm>).

<a id="event-2010-06-01-3-3"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Gaza flotilla raid.

**Archived source account.** Survivors of the Israeli assault on the Gaza-bound international aid flotilla return to Greece and Turkey, providing the first eyewitness accounts of the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2010/jun/01/gaza-flotilla-eyewitness-accounts-gunfire>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/middle_east/10208027.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-06-01-3-4"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Gaza flotilla raid.

**Archived source account.** Israel announces it has imprisoned an official figure of 487 of the people it captured in its commando raid on the Gaza-bound international aid flotilla, while 48 others will be officially expelled after being brought into Israel by Israeli authorities yesterday.

Source citations (as archived): [The Sydney Morning Herald](<http://news.smh.com.au/breaking-news-world/israel-holds-480-activists-from-aid-flotilla-report-20100601-wu3l.html>); [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5jTe-kR0Jet1dU0Be6oBTcJDrrT2Q>).

<a id="event-2010-06-01-3-5"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Gaza flotilla raid.

**Archived source account.** Israel's ambassador to Denmark, Arthur Avnon, announces that the Israeli military had received rumours of a report which asserted a link between the flotilla and Al-Qaida.

Source citations (as archived): [FOX News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2010/05/30/reports-israeli-ships-attack-aid-flotilla-dead/>); [News24](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100602092242/http://www.news24.com/World/News/Flotilla-had-alQaeda-links-20100531>).

<a id="event-2010-06-01-3-6"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Gaza flotilla raid.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of Israelis gather outside the Turkish embassy in Tel Aviv in protest against Turkey's involvement in the Gaza flotilla.

Source citations (as archived): [Ynetnews](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-3897091,00.html>).

<a id="event-2010-06-01-3-7"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Gaza flotilla raid.

**Archived source account.** Turks protest for a second day, marching in front of Istanbul's Israeli consulate, and several are arrested in Ankara after encountering police in front of the Israeli Embassy there.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/turks-protest-israel-gaza-flotilla-sinking/story?id=10793857>).

<a id="event-2010-06-01-3-8"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Gaza flotilla raid.

**Archived source account.** Coalition parties in the Northern Ireland Assembly clash over the Israeli commando attack on the aid convoy.

Source citations (as archived): [The Belfast Telegraph](<http://www.belfasttelegraph.co.uk/breaking-news/uk-ireland/assembly-row-over-israeli-attack-14827640.html#ixzz0pkLvyFmW>).

<a id="event-2010-06-01-3-9"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Gaza flotilla raid.

**Archived source account.** Reports are released regarding the nationalities of those captured after the flotilla raid.

Source citations (as archived): [Asia One News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100605000013/http://news.asiaone.com/News/AsiaOne+News/Malaysia/Story/A1Story20100601-219470.html>); [The Age](<http://www.theage.com.au/world/gaza-flotilla-attack-australian-injured-20100531-wrae.html?autostart=1>).

<a id="event-2010-06-01-3-10"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Gaza flotilla raid.

**Archived source account.** Reports are also released expressing concern for captured international journalists, including those from Aljazeera and Astro Awani, while media organisations are asked to act for the release of all journalists in Israeli custody and to request their freedom to practice their profession without pressure and harassment.

Source citations (as archived): [ArabNews](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100604014653/http://arabnews.com/middleeast/article59793.ece>); [NDTV](<http://www.ndtv.com/news/world/israel-attack-statement-from-astro-awani-29031.php>).

<a id="event-2010-06-01-3-11"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Gaza flotilla raid.

**Archived source account.** Egypt announces that it will temporarily open its border with Gaza for aid.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2010/06/01/government-official-says-egypt-temporarily-opening-blockaded-border-gaza-aid/>).

<a id="event-2010-06-01-3-12"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Gaza flotilla raid.

**Archived source account.** Turkey calls for sanctions against Israel. The United States, a permanent member of the UN Security Council, acts to mitigate the language of the Security Council's draft statement which condemned Israel's action "in the strongest terms", opting instead for one that requests an "impartial" investigation of the deaths and condemns the "acts" that led to it.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times](<http://www.timesonline.co.uk/tol/news/world/middle_east/article7141783.ece>).

<a id="event-2010-06-01-3-13"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Gaza flotilla raid.

**Archived source account.** Twenty Israeli trucks deliver cargo from the captured ships to the Gaza Strip via Kerem Shalom crossing.

Source citations (as archived): [YnetNews](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-3897599,00.html>); [YouTube](<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EVrhQTiAJxM>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2010-06-01-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Judith Osburn, a Binghamton attorney, discussed same-sex marriage in New York and its complexity.

Source citations (as archived): [The Ithaca Journal](<http://www.theithacajournal.com/article/20100601/NEWS01/100601009/-1/>).

<a id="event-2010-06-01-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Lee Murray, the mastermind of the Securitas depot robbery in Kent, England, is jailed for 10 years in Morocco

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/england/kent/10209285.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-06-01-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The trial of London-based multi-national oil trading firm Trafigura for illegally exporting hazardous waste to Ivory Coast in 2006 begins in Amsterdam.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/europe/10204209.stm>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2010/jun/01/trafigura-trial-toxic-waste-netherlands>).

<a id="event-2010-06-01-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three judges are shot dead at a court in Hunan, China; the gunman later kills himself.

Source citations (as archived): [China Daily](<http://www.chinadaily.com.cn/china/2010-06/01/content_9917460.htm>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/world/asia_pacific/10201292.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-06-01-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three Namibian women sue the state after they are sterilised without their informed consent after being diagnosed as HIV positive.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/africa/10202429.stm>); [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/International/2010/06/01/HIV-women-sue-over-forced-sterilization/UPI-76661275392988/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2010-06-01-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Five opposition candidates, including Burundi's ex-rebel leader Agathon Rwasa, withdraw from forthcoming presidential polls.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/africa/10209175.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-06-01-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Another UK minister, the new Chief Secretary to the Treasury, Danny Alexander, who was appointed after the resignation of fellow Liberal Democrat David Laws, is embroiled in the ongoing expenses scandal after admitting to having avoided paying capital gains tax when he sold his taxpayer-funded second home at a profit.

Source citations (as archived): [The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/world/second-uk-minister-in-hot-water/story-e6frg6so-1225873746578>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2010-06-01-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Flying in an orbit 100 kilometers above the moon, the CE-2 is tasked to collect data for a soft-landing designed for its successor, the Chang'e-3. China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation (CASC), said at the Global Lunar Conference held in Beijing.

Source citations (as archived): [Global Times](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100604074423/http://www.globaltimes.cn/www/english/sci-edu/china/2010-06/537211.html>).

<a id="event-2010-06-01-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** As climate talks get under way in Bonn, Thomas Hale and Scott Moore call for a radical new approach to cutting emissions that sidesteps intergovernmental deadlock and unites eager players, from Wal-Mart to city halls.

Source citations (as archived): [China Dialogue](<http://www.chinadialogue.net/article/show/single/en/3646-A-coalition-of-the-willing>).

### 2010-06-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1358827983](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2010%20June%202&oldid=1358827983>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2010-06-02-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The crew of the Libyan M/V Rim takes back the ship from Somali pirates in the Gulf of Aden. Another ship, the Panamanian M/V QSM Dubai, is captured.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/africa/10121976.stm>); [Daily Nation](<http://www.nation.co.ke/News/africa/Somali%20pirates%20seize%20Panama-flagged%20vessel/-/1066/930972/-/15hlfyuz/-/index.html>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2010/WORLD/africa/06/02/indian.ocean.pirates/>).

<a id="event-2010-06-02-0-2"></a>

Context: Gaza flotilla raid:.

**Archived source account.** The Israel Defense Forces claims that the 10 tonnes of aid delivered in the Free Gaza flotilla was turned back by Hamas when delivered to the border at Rafah, with Hamas stating that it will only accept the aid if all flotilla activists imprisoned in Israel are freed, and that the aid be delivered by the flotilla organizers.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2010/WORLD/meast/06/02/israel.palestinians.aid/>).

<a id="event-2010-06-02-0-3"></a>

Context: Gaza flotilla raid:.

**Archived source account.** Turkey announces its intention to cut all ties with Israel unless the dead and captured flotilla activists are returned by the end of the day, and sends doctors to Israel to supervise the treatment of wounded Turkish activists in Israeli hospitals.

Source citations (as archived): [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2010/06/20106293939694105.html>).

<a id="event-2010-06-02-0-4"></a>

Context: Gaza flotilla raid:.

**Archived source account.** Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu rejects the "hypocrisy" of critics of Israel's raid against the Gaza-bound international aid shipment during a nationally televised address in Jerusalem.

Source citations (as archived): [BusinessWeek](<http://www.businessweek.com/news/2010-06-02/netanyahu-rejects-gaza-criticism-as-un-calls-for-investigation.html>); [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/idUKTRE6512VU20100602?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=worldNews>); [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2010-06/03/c_13330246.htm>).

<a id="event-2010-06-02-0-5"></a>

Context: Gaza flotilla raid:.

**Archived source account.** Israeli-Arab MP Haneen Zoubi, who accompanied the flotilla and was arrested but released before the other activists due to parliamentary immunity, tells a press conference in Nazareth that Israel intended to kill peace activists as a way to deter future aid convoys and says she witnessed two passengers slowly bleed to death, while Hebrew messages requesting medical assistance for them were ignored.

Source citations (as archived): [The National](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160303220509/http://www.thenational.ae/apps/pbcs.dll/article?AID=%2F20100602%2FFOREIGN%2F706019813%2F1002%2FFOREIGN>).

<a id="event-2010-06-02-0-6"></a>

Context: Gaza flotilla raid:.

**Archived source account.** Arab League foreign ministers meet in Cairo and reach an agreement to ask the United Nations Security Council to force Israel to end the blockade of Gaza.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/idINIndia-49005320100603>).

<a id="event-2010-06-02-0-7"></a>

Context: Gaza flotilla raid:.

**Archived source account.** UK Prime Minister David Cameron calls the Israeli raid on an unarmed aid convoy "completely unacceptable".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/uk/10218450.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-06-02-0-8"></a>

Context: Gaza flotilla raid:.

**Archived source account.** Irish Taoiseach Brian Cowen asks that the Israeli government exercise "absolute restraint" in relation to its dealings with Irish citizens captured in the raid.

Source citations (as archived): [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2010/0602/mideast.html>).

<a id="event-2010-06-02-0-9"></a>

Context: Gaza flotilla raid:.

**Archived source account.** Israel releases all activists captured during the Gaza flotilla raid and sends them for deportation as the Attorney General states "keeping them here would do more damage to the country's vital interests than good".

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2010/06/20106215402956944.html>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/middle_east/10210949.stm>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2010/jun/02/israel-deport-gaza-flotilla-activists>).

<a id="event-2010-06-02-0-11"></a>

Context: Cumbria shootings:.

**Archived source account.** At least 12 people are killed and 25 injured during shootings carried out by a taxi driver in the Whitehaven, Egremont and Seascale areas of west Cumbria, England. He is found dead, an apparent suicide, in Boot.

Source citations (as archived): [Cumbria Police](<https://www.webcitation.org/5qC03byJm?url=http://www.cumbria.police.uk/news/latest-news/urgent-public-message-shots-fired-in-whitehaven>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/england/10214661.stm>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/uk/2010/jun/02/gunman-sought-person-shot-dead-whitehaven>); [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2010/0602/cumbria.html>); [The Times](<http://www.timesonline.co.uk/tol/news/uk/crime/article7142413.ece#cid=OTC-RSS&amp;attr=797084>); [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/news/nationworld/world/la-fg-britain-rampage-20100603,0,5060185.story>).

<a id="event-2010-06-02-0-12"></a>

Context: Cumbria shootings:.

**Archived source account.** It is confirmed as the worst incident of this kind in the UK since the 1996 Dunblane massacre.

Source citations (as archived): [TIME](<http://newsfeed.time.com/2010/06/02/body-found-as-12-dead-in-u-k-shooting-massacre/>); [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2010/06/20106214389905844.html>); [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2010-06/03/c_13330977.htm>).

<a id="event-2010-06-02-0-13"></a>

Context: Cumbria shootings:.

**Archived source account.** ITV's scheduled broadcast of the television series Coronation Street, which was to mirror events in Cumbria, is cancelled and replaced with TV Burp.

Source citations (as archived): [STV](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100607042238/http://news.stv.tv/scotland/180893-coronation-street-taken-off-air-following-cumbria-shooting/>); [Digital Spy](<http://www.digitalspy.co.uk/soaps/s3/coronation-street/news/a223177/tonights-corrie-pulled-from-schedules.html>); [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-1283465/Lake-District-shooting-TWELVE-people-gunned-rampaging-Derrick-Bird-turned-weapon-himself.html?ito=feeds-newsxml>).

#### Art, culture and entertainment

<a id="event-2010-06-02-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Stage and screen actor Sir Patrick Stewart, known for his role in Star Trek, is knighted by the Queen at Buckingham Palace in England.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/entertainment_and_arts/10217872.stm>); [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/newsvideo/7798521/Patrick-Stewart-knighted.html>); [The Boston Globe](<http://www.boston.com/ae/movies/articles/2010/06/02/go_boldly_to_the_palace____and_arise_sir_patrick/>).

<a id="event-2010-06-02-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The BBC announces that Last of the Summer Wine, the world's longest-running sitcom, is to be axed after 37 years.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/entertainment_and_arts/10218448.stm>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/media/2010/jun/02/last-of-the-summer-wine>); [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/arts/2010/0602/lastofthesummerwine.html>); [The Scotsman](<http://news.scotsman.com/latest-national-news/Last-of-the-Summer-Wine.6336683.jp>); [The Press Association](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ukpress/article/ALeqM5i2wtgtsP0SpAjchpa6ErDk0libZg>).

#### Disasters

<a id="event-2010-06-02-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Government of Kenya announces that 2.3 million bags of maize are unfit for human consumption due to contamination with high levels of aflatoxins, which have killed at least one child.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/africa/10219505.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-06-02-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** 15 people die after a minibus drives off a cliff in the Philippines.

Source citations (as archived): [Hindustan Times](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5gRgBy0UJ5MVcA2bYj6HNRMrWo56w>).

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/south_asia/10211561.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-06-02-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** 3 people are killed and 6 wounded when a leftover bomb from World War II explodes while being defused in Göttingen, Lower Saxony.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5gRgBy0UJ5MVcA2bYj6HNRMrWo56w>); [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2010/06/20106213138298153.html>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/europe/10212890.stm>); [The Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/World/Europe/3-killed-trying-to-disarm-WWII-era-bomb-in-Germany/articleshow/6004520.cms>).

<a id="event-2010-06-02-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A heatwave strikes India and South Asia, reaching 53C (127F) and killing many hundreds of people.

Source citations (as archived): [Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2010/jun/01/pakistan-record-temperatures-heatwave>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2010-06-02-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** President of South Africa Jacob Zuma goes to India on his first state visit to Asia, launching a bilateral trade forum in Mumbai.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/south_asia/10216071.stm>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2010-06-02-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Amnesty International condemns Sunday's execution, in Tripoli and Benghazi, Libya, of 18 people, some of whom were from Chad, Egypt and Nigeria.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5i_DWD6W8NFYH9MRyS6LZ5tburNog>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/africa/10214416.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-06-02-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Archbishop of Freiburg (Germany) Robert Zollitsch is charged with "aiding and abetting child sex abuse", though the archdiocese rejects the charges and coverage of them as "absolutely weak" and "sensationalist".

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw-world.de/dw/article/0,,5643029,00.html?maca=en-rss-en-top-1022-rdf>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/europe/10219002.stm>); [France24](<http://www.france24.com/en/20100602-robert-zollitsch-head-german-catholic-probed-suspicion-abetting-child-abuse>); [Houston Chronicle](<http://www.chron.com/disp/story.mpl/ap/top/all/7032894.html>).

<a id="event-2010-06-02-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police in Saudi Arabia investigate three young Saudis, two men and one woman, who spoke critically of the country's laws on the MTV documentary, Resist the Power\! Saudi Arabia.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/middle_east/10216116.stm>); [National Post](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100603221136/http://arts.nationalpost.com/2010/06/01/i-want-my-%E2%80%98openly-declaring-sin%E2%80%99-mtv/>); [The New Yotik Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2010/06/02/arts/television/02arts-002.html>); [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/idUKTRE65027A20100601?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=entertainmentNews>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2010-06-02-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Japanese Prime Minister Yukio Hatoyama resigns after breaking his campaign promise to remove a United States military base from Okinawa.

Source citations (as archived): [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia-pacific/2010/06/20106205314278472.html>); [AP](<https://news.yahoo.com/s/nm/20100602/ts_nm/us_japan_politics>); [Wall Street Journal](<http://online.wsj.com/article/SB10001424052748704875604575281292285208862.html?mod=googlenews_wsj>).

Source citations (as archived): [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2010/06/20106212303284291.html>).

**Archived source account.** New Caledonia President Philippe Gomès is indicted over alleged misuse of business contracts.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZI](<http://www.rnzi.com/pages/news.php?op=read&amp;id=53933>).

<a id="event-2010-06-02-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** President of Lombardy, Roberto Formigoni, offers pregnant women €4,500 if they do not have abortions: anti-abortion campaigners welcome the move and critics call it "propaganda".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/europe/10214872.stm>); [The Times](<http://www.timesonline.co.uk/tol/news/world/europe/article7142150.ece>).

<a id="event-2010-06-02-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hamid Karzai, the President of Afghanistan, opens a national peace conference to discuss negotiating with the Taliban. A rocket lands near the venue of the conference in Kabul and a suicide bomber sets off explosives outside the conference.,

Source citations (as archived): [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia/2010/06/20106244135950477.html>); [AP](<http://www.palmbeachpost.com/news/world/gunfire-heard-near-afghan-peace-conference-721777.html>); [AP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5hvWEqwq3CrRvaQCmt21MfoYhjZJQD9G2VAGG0>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2010-06-02-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Armando Galarraga of the Detroit Tigers had his perfect game bid broken up by an incorrect call made by the first base umpire Jim Joyce that would have been his final out.

Source citations (as archived): [MLB News](<http://mlb.mlb.com/news/article.jsp?ymd=20100602&amp;content_id=10727590>).

<a id="event-2010-06-02-7-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Brazil and Zimbabwe play a football game in front of a sell-out crowd in Harare ahead of the 2010 FIFA World Cup in South Africa, the first time since independence that a non-African team has performed in the country. President Robert Mugabe and Prime Minister Morgan Tsvangirai both attend and civil servants are given time off work.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/africa/10218163.stm>); [Times Live](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100604094406/http://www.timeslive.co.za/sport/soccer/article483407.ece/Zim-civil-servants-get-time-off-for-Brazil-match>); [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/sports/soccer/fifaworldcup/brazil/story/2010/06/02/sp-brazil-zimbabwe.html?ref=rss>); [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/sports/2010/06/02/brazil-bring-rare-good-news-zimbabwe-2102133529/>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/football/2010/jun/02/zimbabwe-brazil-international-friendly>).

### 2010-06-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1305895340](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2010%20June%203&oldid=1305895340>).

#### General News

<a id="event-2010-06-03-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** British Airways issues an apology for a photograph in a staff magazine which implied Osama Bin Laden had a frequent flyer boarding pass for first class.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/uk_news/8720942.stm>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2010-06-03-1-1"></a>

Context: Gaza flotilla raid:.

**Archived source account.** United Nations Human Rights Council passed a resolution calling for an independent fact-finding mission into Israel's interception of a Gaza-bound flotilla.

Source citations (as archived): [Jewish Telegraphic Agency](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100605024901/http://www.jta.org/news/article/2010/06/02/2739403/human-rights-council-members-condemn-israel>).

<a id="event-2010-06-03-1-2"></a>

Context: Gaza flotilla raid:.

**Archived source account.** Turkey buries its citizens killed in the raid. Israel states there is "no need" for an international inquiry because it expects its own inquiry to meet the "highest international standards." President of Turkey Abdullah Gül states relations between the two countries would "never be the same".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/middle_east/10226151.stm>); [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2010/06/20106312530449379.html>).

<a id="event-2010-06-03-1-3"></a>

Context: Gaza flotilla raid:.

**Archived source account.** A United States Department of State official says a 19-year-old with dual American-Turkish citizenship was among those shot dead, four times in the head at close range and five times overall, during the raid.

Source citations (as archived): [The Associated Press](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5isAKh8QC0tqYG5gzrDQpY8PFZnmwD9G3S4AG0>).

<a id="event-2010-06-03-1-4"></a>

Context: Gaza flotilla raid:.

**Archived source account.** South Africa recalls its ambassador to Israel to show what it describes as its "strongest condemnation of the attack".

Source citations (as archived): [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2010/06/201063132526897233.html>).

<a id="event-2010-06-03-1-5"></a>

Context: Gaza flotilla raid:.

**Archived source account.** An Irish citizen captured and taken to Beersheba detention camp by Israel during their raid on the Gaza-bound international aid flotilla is hospitalised after becoming ill in Tel Aviv. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [The Press Association](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ukpress/article/ALeqM5gdeklhjrrytWdrY_YdbwilcW26yw>); [Lynnnews](<http://www.lynnnews.co.uk/news/national/gaza_flotilla_activist_in_hospital_1_644857>).

<a id="event-2010-06-03-1-6"></a>

Context: Gaza flotilla raid:.

**Archived source account.** The Israeli Foreign Ministry says 527 of the captured activists, as well as the bodies of those killed, have been placed on flights bound for Turkey and Greece: seven more are still in hospital: three other captured activists — one man and two women from Australia, Ireland and Italy — remain in Israel "for technical reasons".

Source citations (as archived): [New Straits Times](<http://www.nst.com.my/nst/articles/527flotillaactivistshaveleftIsrael/Article/#ixzz0pkY73eLA>).

<a id="event-2010-06-03-1-7"></a>

Context: Gaza flotilla raid:.

**Archived source account.** The Sydney Morning Herald's chief correspondent Paul McGeough and photographer Kate Geraghty are among the captives to have been released.

Source citations (as archived): [The Sydney Morning Herald](<http://www.smh.com.au/national/freed-journos-tell-of-israeli-commandos-like-hyenas-hunting-20100603-x1mr.html?autostart=1>).

<a id="event-2010-06-03-1-8"></a>

Context: Gaza flotilla raid:.

**Archived source account.** 37 British nationals captured by Israel during the raid begin returning home.

Source citations (as archived): [Channel 4 News](<http://www.channel4.com/news/articles/politics/international_politics/gaza+flotilla+activists+return+from+israel/3667727>).

<a id="event-2010-06-03-1-9"></a>

Context: Gaza flotilla raid:.

**Archived source account.** Israeli protesters wave Armenian and Kurdish flags in front of the Turkish embassy in Tel Aviv, during a violent demonstration in which Turkish Prime Minister Recep Erdoğan is called "a fascist".

Source citations (as archived): [YnetNews](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-3898826,00.html>); [VideoPedia](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100605040704/http://reshet.ynet.co.il/%D7%97%D7%93%D7%A9%D7%95%D7%AA/News/Domestic/internal/Article,44895.aspx>).

<a id="event-2010-06-03-1-11"></a>

Context: Somalia:.

**Archived source account.** At least 20 people are killed and 60 injured in heavy fighting between government forces and Islamist militants in the capital Mogadishu.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2010/WORLD/africa/06/03/somalia.fighting.toll/>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/world/africa/10233602.stm>); [Sify](<http://sify.com/news/23-killed-dozens-injured-in-somalia-fighting-news-international-kgduEdgadbj.html>).

Context: Somalia:.

**Archived source account.** Somali forces from the semi-autonomous region of Puntland storm a hijacked Panamanian-flagged cargo ship, capturing the pirates and freeing the crew.

Source citations (as archived): [AfricaNews](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100605081604/http://www.africanews.com/site/Somali_forces_free_ship_pirates_kill_captain/list_messages/32434>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/world/africa/10224293.stm>); [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2010-06/03/c_13331907.htm>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2010-06-03-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** 3 people are arrested after a man wrongly jailed for 11 years in central China Shangqiu City.

Source citations (as archived): [Sina](<http://english.sina.com/china/2010/0602/322824.html>); [CRI](<http://english.cri.cn/6909/2010/06/03/2321s574283.htm>).

<a id="event-2010-06-03-6-4"></a>

#### 2010 Kyrgyzstan crisis

<a id="event-2010-06-11-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Riots erupt in the southern city of Osh killing at least 45, and injuring over a hundred others. The violence comes just over two months after violent riots in Bishkek toppled Kurmanbek Bakiyev's government, and only days ahead of a critical constitutional referendum.

Source citations (as archived): [News Daily](<http://www.newsdaily.com/stories/tre65a02b-us-kyrgyzstan-violence/>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2010/WORLD/asiapcf/06/11/kyrgyzstan.violence/index.html?hpt=T2>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/asia_pacific/10290717.stm>); [The Wall Street Journal](<http://online.wsj.com/article/BT-CO-20100611-700136.html?mod=WSJ_latestheadlines>).

**Archived source account.** A curfew is imposed and a state of emergency declared in Osh by the interim government.

Source citations (as archived): [RIA Novosti](<http://rianovosti.com/world/20100611/159383156.html>); [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia/2010/06/20106113533945972.html>).

<a id="event-2010-06-14-0-33"></a>

Context: NCAA (U.S. college) conference realignment:.

**Archived source account.** The University of Texas at Austin, seen as the key to the survival of a 10-team Big 12 Conference in the wake of the loss of Colorado to the Pacific-10 Conference and Nebraska to the Big Ten Conference, announces it will turn down an invitation from the Pac-10 and remain in the Big 12. ### 2010-06-15

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1305895422](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2010%20June%2015&oldid=1305895422>).

#### Human rights in Iran

<a id="event-2010-06-15-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A leader of the Iranian opposition, Mir Hussein Moussavi, demands the prosecution of those he accuses of fraud in the disputed presidential election of 2009 and of human rights abuses against opposition demonstrators over the past year in Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2010/06/16/world/middleeast/16iran.html>).

<a id="event-2010-06-15-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** 56 nations rebuke Iran for its human rights record, expressing concern over the violent suppression of dissent, detention and executions without due process of law, severe discrimination against women and minorities including people of Baháʼí faith, and restrictions of expression and religion.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5iRyVZSMPwGsilj8NqqATa9t8h6dwD9GBRF1O0>).

<a id="event-2010-06-15-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A US marine convicted in the Hamdania incident, one of the worst war crimes from the Iraq War, and sentenced to eleven years in prison in 2006 is released from prison after a military appeals court in Washington decides he did not receive a fair trial. The Navy is appealing that court's decision.

Source citations (as archived): [PA](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ukpress/article/ALeqM5gqW6xZ1CWrBadq7QVaAvIK-olp5w>); [AP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5hAKPf49Q9s7SaG_xk_hZ15Du-xUgD9GBDP887>); [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/americas/2010/2010/06/20106155511376820.html>); [Gulf News](<http://gulfnews.com/news/world/usa/us-marine-released-in-iraqi-war-crimes-case-1.641373>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2010/06/14/AR2010061405048.html>).

<a id="event-2010-06-15-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Militants kill 12 police officers in a string of attacks and six civilians die in bombings in Afghanistan, and a U.S. soldier is killed in a gun battle in eastern Afghanistan in the latest fighting in the war in Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/news/world/afghanistan/2010-06-15-militant-attacks_N.htm>).

<a id="event-2010-06-15-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Heavy rain triggers landslides that leave at least 24 people dead in Sichuan province's Kangding county. In one incident, part of a mountain fell on a construction site in Sichuan province, crushing workers who were sleeping in tents. \{\{Dead link\|date=July 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [news.com.pk](<http://thenews.com.pk/updates.asp?id=106672>); [China Dialy](<http://www.chinadaily.com.cn/china/2010-06/15/content_9978919.htm>).

<a id="event-2010-06-15-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** The trial begins of 33 alleged members of Ergenekon over alleged plans to topple the Turkish government, while groups hold small protests outside the courthouse in their favour.

Source citations (as archived): [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2010/06/2010615125135547948.html>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/europe/10320736.stm>); [euronews](<http://www.euronews.net/2010/06/15/turkish-coup-plot-trial-opens/>).

<a id="event-2010-06-15-0-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two trains collide in the northern Mexican state of Sinaloa resulting in the death of at least 13 people.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.usatoday.com/news/world/2010-06-15-Mexico-train_N.htm>).

#### Saville Inquiry

<a id="event-2010-06-15-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Saville Inquiry into the events of Bloody Sunday (1972) in Northern Ireland is published, as a result of the longest-running public inquiry in British legal history.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/skynews/Home/UK-News/Bloody-Sunday-Inquiry-Report-Published-12-Years-And-200m/Article/201006215649234?lpos=UK_News_Top_Stories_Header_0&amp;lid=ARTICLE_15649234_Bloody_Sunday_Inquiry_Report_Published%3A_12_Years_And_%3F200m>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/politics/12year-5000page-report-aiming-to-unlock-the-truth-2000511.html>).

<a id="event-2010-06-15-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The report concludes that British paratroopers "lost control", fired the first shot without warning, shot fleeing civilians, and concocted lies to cover up their acts, while the civilians did not throw stones or petrol bombs as a previous inquiry had claimed.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/northern_ireland/10320609.stm>); [The Irish Times](<http://www.irishtimes.com/newspaper/breaking/2010/0615/breaking56.html>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2010/WORLD/europe/06/15/uk.bloody.sunday.inquiry/?hpt=Sbin>); [The Wall Street Journal](<http://online.wsj.com/article/SB10001424052748704009804575308243952146652.html?mod=WSJ_hpp_MIDDLETopStories>).

<a id="event-2010-06-15-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Relatives of those shot by the British Army gather to hear the results and applaud the findings.

Source citations (as archived): [euronews](<http://www.euronews.net/2010/06/15/relatives-cheer-bloody-sunday-findings/>).

<a id="event-2010-06-15-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** British Prime Minister David Cameron calls the events "unjustified and unjustifiable" in a statement in the House of Commons and issues an apology on behalf of the British government.

Source citations (as archived): [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2010/0615/bloodysunday.html>); [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2010/06/2010615144034428377.html>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2010/06/16/world/europe/16nireland.html?src=mv>); [euronews](<http://www.euronews.net/2010/06/15/uk-pm-says-sorry-for-northern-irish-bloody-sunday/>).

<a id="event-2010-06-15-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** North Korea threatens a military response if the United Nations Security Council questions or condemns it for the ROKS Cheonan sinking. North Korean UN Permanent Representative Sin Son Ho demands that a North Korean investigation team be allowed to travel to the site of the sinking.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! News](<https://news.yahoo.com/s/ap/on_re_us/un_un_koreas_ship_sinking>).

Irish Taoiseach Brian Cowen faces a motion of no confidence in Dáil Éireann, his second in just over a year. Leader of the Opposition, Enda Kenny, who sacked his deputy leader yesterday to prevent a potential coup, faces further revolt from his party as nine more members of his frontbench call on him to resign.

#### None

<a id="event-2010-06-16-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Jamaican Government orders civilians to keep off the streets for two days in several slums in Kingston because authorities are still hunting for Christopher Coke, alleged by the United States to be a drug lord.

<a id="event-2010-06-16-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** American police in Seattle say they will "review training procedured" following the surfacing of a video which attrated international attention. The video shows a white officer from the Seattle department punching a black teenaged girl in the face when she tried intervene while the officer was confronting another girl about crossing the road at a legally forbidden area. Seattle police deny any wrongdoing. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://us.cnn.com/2010/CRIME/06/16/police.jaywalker/index.html?hpt=Sbin>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/us_and_canada/10336500.stm>); [IOL](<http://www.iol.co.za/index.php?from=rss_North%20America&amp;set_id=1&amp;click_id=22&amp;art_id=iol127669613486D515>); [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/skynews/Home/World-News/Cop-Caught-Hitting-Girl-In-The-Face-Seattle-Police-Officer-Punches-17-Year-Old-Female/Article/201006315650356?f=rss>).

<a id="event-2010-06-16-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Human Rights Council says Britain is arranging its third enforced removal of Iraqi asylum applicants to Baghdad despite appeals for it to stop amid safety fears for the individuals concerned.

Source citations (as archived): [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2010/06/20106169113764364.html>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2010/jun/16/iraqi-asylum-risk-deported-unhcr>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/middle_east/10325096.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-06-16-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iran's atomic energy chief says Iran will begin building a new nuclear reactor, and Iran will keep enriching uranium, despite UN nuclear sanctions.

<a id="event-2010-06-16-0-5"></a>

Context: Iranian nuclear program sanctions:.

**Archived source account.** The United States announces new sanctions against Iran’s financial sector, shipping industry and Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps, aimed at implementing the recent United Nations Security Council Resolution 1929 and targeted at the country's nuclear and missile programs.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2010/WORLD/meast/06/16/us.iran.sanctions/index.html?iref=NS1>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/us_and_canada/10336289.stm>); [Ynet](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-3906435,00.html>).

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Barack Obama announces that BP will finance a $20 billion fund to compensate people whose livelihoods have been damaged by the devastating oil spill in the Gulf of Mexico, and the company's chairman apologized for the worst spill in U.S. history.

<a id="event-2010-06-28-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Democratic Robert Byrd of West Virginia, President pro tempore of the United States Senate and the longest serving member its history, dies at age 92 in Washington, D.C.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2010/POLITICS/06/28/obit.byrd/index.html?hpt=T1>); [BBC News](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/us_and_canada/10431856.stm>).

### 2010-06-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1309381960](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2010%20June%2029&oldid=1309381960>).

#### Current events

<a id="event-2010-06-29-0-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Gaza flotilla clash.

**Archived source account.** Turkey says it will return an ambassador to Israel if the Israeli government formally apologizes for the killing of nine Turkish citizens during the Gaza flotilla raid, compensates their families and when an independent commission is established into the matter.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2010/06/30/world/europe/30briefs-TURKEY.html>).

<a id="event-2010-06-29-0-3"></a>

Context: Israel.

**Archived source account.** Egyptian border guards fatally shoot an Eritrean woman in the stomach and leg as she tries to cross the border illegally into Israel.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/africa/10455944.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-06-29-0-4"></a>

Context: Israel.

**Archived source account.** Israeli Foreign Minister Avigdor Lieberman promises no Palestinian state before 2012 after meeting Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/idINIndia-49743520100629?loomia_ow=t0:s0:a49:g43:r1:c0.500000:b35292758:z0>).

<a id="event-2010-06-29-0-5"></a>

Context: Israel.

**Archived source account.** United Nations special rapporteur on human rights in Palestinian territories occupied by Israel since 1967, Richard A. Falk, issues a statement calling Israel's plan to demolish 20 Palestinian homes in East Jerusalem illegal and states the forceful transfer of four Palestinians in another incident could be a "war crime".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/idINIndia-49747120100629>); [The Vancouver Sun](<https://vancouversun.com/news/Israel+plan+raze+homes+illegal+rights+envoy+says/3215190/story.html>).

<a id="event-2010-06-29-0-6"></a>

Context: Israel.

**Archived source account.** Lebanese authorities arrest a man accused of spying for Israel for more than 15 years.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/middle_east/10444459.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-06-29-0-7"></a>

Context: Israel.

**Archived source account.** An international youth charity finds that children in the West Bank live in significantly worse conditions than children in Gaza.

Source citations (as archived): [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2010/06/201062916845576597.html>).

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court rules that Nigerian families can sue drug company Pfizer for using a deadly antibiotic on their children.

<a id="event-2010-06-29-0-10"></a>

Context: United States.

Context: United States.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2010-07-01-0-1"></a>

Context: Israeli-Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** In response to a rocket attack on southern Israel, Israeli airforce jets strike several targets in Gaza overnight, including Yasser Arafat International Airport, a weapons manufacturing facility and an infiltration tunnel into Israel.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2010-07/01/c_13378118.htm>); [Arab News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100704004452/http://arabnews.com/middleeast/article76940.ece>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Headlines/Article.aspx?id=180050>).

<a id="event-2010-07-01-0-2"></a>

#### Armed conflicts and incidents

<a id="event-2010-07-06-1-1"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War.

**Archived source account.** East African leaders call for 20,000 troops to be deployed across Somalia to support the United Nations-backed Transitional Federal Government and for the United Nations to replace the African Union Mission to Somalia.

Source citations (as archived): [AllAfrica.com](<http://allafrica.com/stories/201007060463.html>); [BBC News](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/world/africa/10505311.stm>).

Context: Somali Civil War.

**Archived source account.** 16 people are killed in clashes between rival factions in the capital Mogadishu.

<a id="event-2010-07-06-1-4"></a>

Context: Asia.

**Archived source account.** Ameer Ullah Mehsud, a Taliban commander and one of the founders of the Tehrik-e-Taliban Pakistan, is killed by the Pakistani army.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2010/WORLD/asiapcf/07/06/pakistan.militant.slain/index.html?eref=edition&amp;fbid=4I1tbJn2BPy>).

<a id="event-2010-07-06-1-5"></a>

Context: Asia.

**Archived source account.** Protesters try to enter the United Nations compound in Colombo, Sri Lanka, calling for the United Nations to abandon an inquiry into alleged human rights abuses in the final stages of the civil war between the government and Tamil rebels that ended last year. Staff are unable to leave until being assisted by Sri Lankan police.

Source citations (as archived): [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia/2010/07/20107674337668209.html>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2010/WORLD/asiapcf/07/06/sri.lanka.un.siege/index.html?eref=edition&amp;fbid=4I1tbJn2BPy>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2010-07-13-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Washington, D.C.-based global lender International Monetary Fund halts funds to the Bank of Central African States (BEAC) used by oil-producing nations in Central Africa, impacting on the Republic of the Congo and the Central African Republic.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters Africa](<http://af.reuters.com/article/topNews/idAFJOE66C0I120100713>).

<a id="event-2010-07-13-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The EU announces that Estonia is to become the seventeenth member of the euro on 1 January 2011.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/business/10611399.stm>); [The Irish Times](<http://www.irishtimes.com/newspaper/breaking/2010/0713/breaking35.html>); [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2010/0713/euro.html>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2010/07/13/AR2010071302079.html>).

<a id="event-2010-07-13-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 4 groups of Chinese private investors are interested in acquiring American International Assurance (AIA), the Asian division of insurance giant American International Group (AIG).

Source citations (as archived): [Channel NewsAsia](<http://www.channelnewsasia.com/stories/afp_asiapacific_business/view/1069094/1/.html>).

<a id="event-2010-07-13-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Data collected by the United States Federal Reserve System suggests that the country's financial market, while still fragile, is showing signs of improvement.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE66C55Y20100713>).

<a id="event-2010-07-13-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Nigerian Minister of Finance announces that the Nigerian National Petroleum Corporation is insolvent, and is asking the government for funds to help pay off debts and continue operations.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/10624427>).

#### Health

<a id="event-2010-07-13-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Joint United Nations Programme on HIV/AIDS figures demonstrate a fall by up to 25 per cent in the prevalence of HIV among young people aged between 15 and 24 in Africa.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/africa/10616274.stm>); [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/topNews/idAFJOE66C0O520100713>).

<a id="event-2010-07-13-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** President of the United States Barack Obama unveils his country's first national strategy to cut HIV/AIDS infections and improve care for those with the disease.

Source citations (as archived): [The Sydney Morning Herald](<http://news.smh.com.au/breaking-news-world/obama-vows-to-cut-hiv-infections-20100714-10abs.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2010-07-13-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Six more New Orleans police officers are charged with: shooting dead two civilians, injuries caused to four other civilians, and conspiracy to cover up the incidents on a bridge in the aftermath of the deadly Hurricane Katrina in 2005.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/us_and_canada/10623960.stm>); [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/idINIndia-50102020100713>); [CBC News](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/more-police-charged-in-post-katrina-shootings-1.953253>).

<a id="event-2010-07-13-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Zimbabwe court frees human rights activist Farai Maguwu on bail after five weeks in detention, accused of providing false information about the diamond trade, charges he denies. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/africa/10610976.stm>); [IOL](<http://www.iol.co.za/index.php?from=rss_Southern&amp;set_id=1&amp;click_id=84&amp;art_id=nw20100712221931440C720338>); [The Irish Times](<http://www.irishtimes.com/newspaper/world/2010/0714/1224274659739.html>); [Mail &amp; Guardian](<http://www.mg.co.za/article/2010-07-13-zim-diamondcrime-whistleblower-freed>); [South Africa Mercury](<http://www.themercury.co.za/index.php?fArticleId=5552287>).

<a id="event-2010-07-13-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Human rights groups express concern that some of the soldiers due to march down the Champs Elysées in Paris tomorrow as part of the Bastille Day celebrations may be war criminals and write an open letter to President of France Nicolas Sarkozy.

Source citations (as archived): [France24](<http://www.france24.com/en/20100713-human-rights-groups-question-african-involvement-july-14-parade-bastille-day>).

<a id="event-2010-07-13-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom strips Russian spy Anna Chapman of her citizenship after the United States deports her.

Source citations (as archived): [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2010/07/201071318583361891.html>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/uk/10620352.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-07-13-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Colton Harris-Moore, otherwise known as the "Barefoot Bandit", pleads guilty to illegally landing a plane in The Bahamas, and currently faces jail or deportation.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2010/CRIME/07/13/bahamas.barefoot.bandit/?hpt=Sbin>).

**Archived source account.** A four-year-old boy dies during an exorcism ritual carried out by a traditional healer in the Russian Far East.

Source citations (as archived): [The Sydney Morning Herald](<http://news.smh.com.au/breaking-news-world/russian-boy-dies-during-exorcism-ritual-20100713-109ja.html>).

#### Politics and elections

**Archived source account.** Cuban ex-President Fidel Castro makes his first televised appearance in nearly a year, predicting possible nuclear war in the Middle East.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/latin_america/10606890.stm>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2010/jul/13/fidel-castro-on-cuban-tv-middle-east-iran-us>).

**Archived source account.** Spain receives a group of seven dissidents freed by Cuba for human rights reasons.

Source citations (as archived): [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/americas/2010/07/20107131135543452.html>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/latin_america/10595296.stm>).

**Archived source account.** A strike in Kashmir in protest at lack of independence from India leads to the closure of shops and businesses on Martyrs' Day, for a third successive day.

**Archived source account.** Senior Rwandan opposition official André Kagwa Rwisereka disappears after his car is found abandoned by the Mukula River near Butare.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/topNews/idAFJOE66C0QV20100713>).

**Archived source account.** Fiji expels Australia's acting High Commissioner as part of a long-running dispute.

<a id="event-2010-07-13-5-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** France's lower house of parliament approves a bill that bans wearing burqa and niqāb in public.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/europe/10611398.stm>); [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2010/07/2010713144852665644.html>); [France24](<http://www.france24.com/en/20100713-french-lawmakers-pass-bill-ban-burqa-public-spaces>); [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2010/0713/burqa.html>).

<a id="event-2010-07-13-5-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tens of thousands of surviving Africans in 12 former colonies who served France in two world wars and Algeria's war of independence are to have their war pensions raised to the same level as those of their French comrades, according to Nicolas Sarkozy.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/europe/10617955.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-07-13-5-8"></a>

<a id="event-2010-07-13-5-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** The French government approves a draft law that would raise the retirement age to 62 from the age of 60 that has been enshrined since 1982.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/europe/10612788.stm>); [France24](<http://www.france24.com/en/20100713-france-pension-reform-raise-retirement-age-government-sarkozy-woerth-62>); [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2010/0713/france.html>).

<a id="event-2010-07-13-5-10"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [samaylive](<https://web.archive.org/web/20120308123017/http://english.samaylive.com/nation/676468252.html>).

<a id="event-2010-07-13-5-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** Israeli authorities use bulldozers to demolish three Palestinian buildings in East Jerusalem.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/world/middle_east/10619903.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-07-13-5-12"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States 2nd Circuit Court of Appeals in New York City strikes down the Federal Communications Commission's "fleeting expletives" policy that gave it power to fine broadcasters who air a single expletive on air.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2010/07/13/AR2010071303385.html?hpid=moreheadlines>).

<a id="event-2010-07-13-5-13"></a>

### 2010-07-14

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1309382004](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2010%20July%2014&oldid=1309382004>).

#### Armed conflicts &amp; attacks

<a id="event-2010-07-14-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The corpse of senior Rwandan opposition politician Andre Kagwa Rwisereka, who was recently reported missing, is found near his car with the head almost entirely severed off.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/10633500>).

<a id="event-2010-07-14-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Israeli warships force the Gaza-bound aid ship Amalthea to change course to El Arish port in Egypt.

Source citations (as archived): [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2010/07/201071419010766579.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/10615479>).

<a id="event-2010-07-14-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** More than 60 people are hospitalised after a suspected chlorine gas leak in Mumbai.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/10626042>); [Arab News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20120307205447/http://arabnews.com/world/article84282.ece>); [News24.com](<http://www.news24.com/World/News/60-hospitalised-after-gas-leak-20100714>); [The Age](<http://www.theage.com.au/world/mumbai-in-damage-control-as-chlorine-gas-leak-wreaks-havoc-20100714-10b1o.html>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/asia/92-in-india-taken-to-hospital-after-chlorine-leak-2026209.html>).

<a id="event-2010-07-14-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States discusses the arrest of Bradley Manning, accused of providing secret information about US military corruption to Wikileaks.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/10596057>).

<a id="event-2010-07-14-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** India's Home Secretary G. K. Pillai states Pakistan's intelligence agency Inter-Services Intelligence (ISI) co-ordinated the 2008 Mumbai attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia/2010/07/20107141382061866.html>); [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw-world.de/dw/article/0,,5793846,00.html>).

<a id="event-2010-07-14-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former Balochistan senator Habib Jalib is shot dead outside his home in Quetta, leading to riots and widespread mourning. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/10630993>); [The News International](<http://thenews.jang.com.pk/top_story_detail.asp?Id=30050>); [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2010-07/15/c_111954632.htm>).

<a id="event-2010-07-14-0-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Senior Indian Army officer Major A. K. Thinge is killed in battle in Kashmir.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/10625633>); [The Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/India/Major-killed-Colonel-injured-in-gunbattle/articleshow/6169556.cms>); [Indian Express](<http://www.indianexpress.com/news/army-major-killed-in-encounter-with-let/646423/>); [People's Daily](<http://english.people.com.cn/90001/90777/90851/7066268.html>).

<a id="event-2010-07-14-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A group of more than 30 journalists from such countries as Turkey, Spain, Germany, Lebanon, Egypt, the United Kingdom and the United States announces it is to take legal action against Israel for equipment lost and money stolen due to the Gaza flotilla raid.
