**Archived source account.** A bus falls off a cliff in the Garzê Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture in southwestern China resulting in the death of 23 people.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5jP_Xer2aiSWQj4teMfeHGd_FdaHwD9H19FBO0>).

<a id="event-2010-07-18-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** United Nations figures indicate around 225 families remain homeless in Gaza since Israel's three-week military offensive was launched in December 2008.

Source citations (as archived): [Taiwan News](<http://www.etaiwannews.com/etn/news_content.php?id=1322210&amp;lang=eng_news>).

<a id="event-2010-07-18-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A series of two earthquakes, the second quake measuring magnitude 7.3, hit New Britain in Papua New Guinea. A tsunami warning is issued but later retracted.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/stories/2010/07/19/2957159.htm?section=justin>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2010-07-18-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iranian scientist Shahram Amiri, who says he was abducted by the United States Central Intelligence Agency, says the United States wanted him to confess to being a spy as part of a plan to force the release of three Americans spies caught by Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2010/07/20107184120526389.html>).

<a id="event-2010-07-18-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Arab League, speaking in Cairo, states written guarantees are required if Palestine is to enter into direct negotiations with Israel as Egyptian, Israeli, Palestinian and American representatives meet to talk.

Source citations (as archived): [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2010/07/201071814158908126.html>).

<a id="event-2010-07-18-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Colombia takes Venezuela to the Organisation of American States over claims that the latter tolerates training camps for left-wing guerrillas, particularly FARC and ELN within its borders.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-10674859>).

<a id="event-2010-07-18-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** EU commissioner Chris Patten, Baron Patten of Barnes, speaking during his first visit to Gaza since 2002, calls the Israeli blockade of Gaza an "immoral failure", expresses shock at the "huge new settlements" in the West Bank, and states the United States dominance of the Quartet on the Middle East - US, EU, UN and Russia - is wrong.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2010/jul/18/chris-patten-eu-middle-east>).

<a id="event-2010-07-18-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 2001 film, depicting Prime Minister of Israel Benjamin Netanyahu discussing methods of undermining the Oslo Accords and saying the United States is "easy" to manipulate, is aired on Israel's Channel 10.

Source citations (as archived): [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2010/07/201071834019513292.html>).

<a id="event-2010-07-18-3-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom plans to reduce or eliminate international aid to countries such as the "powerhouses" of Russia and China, as well as South American and eastern European countries. The government plans aid increases to some poorer nations including a 40% increase to Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [The Observer](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/society/2010/jul/18/international-aid-under-threat-cuts>).

<a id="event-2010-07-18-3-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** European Union foreign policy chief Catherine Ashton says that Israel must go beyond easing its blockade of Gaza and throw open its long-closed border.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-10675713>); [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2010-07/18/c_13403458.htm>).

<a id="event-2010-07-18-3-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Israeli religious group plans to build flats in Ajami, Jaffa.

Source citations (as archived): [The Observer](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2010/jul/18/jaffa-arab-tel-aviv-settlers>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2010-07-18-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Omar Deghayes, a former Guantánamo Bay detainee and one of six suing the British government, says notes taken during his interrogation by British security service officers have been censored to hide the fact that he was tortured by agents and to avoid potentially embarrassing questions.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2010/jul/18/guantanamo-bay-interrogation-detainee>).

<a id="event-2010-07-18-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Saddam Hussein's former foreign minister Tariq Aziz and other senior members are summoned and appear in an Iraqi court charged with "squandering the public wealth".

Source citations (as archived): [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2010/07/2010718194535925679.html>).

<a id="event-2010-07-18-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** President of Zimbabwe Robert Mugabe, speaking in Marange, says he will ignore anyone who desires mention of LGBT rights in a draft of the next constitution of Zimbabwe.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5giVWswVTzJxcH8bsrK5UdZzkuKKQ>); [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2010/0718/zimbabwe.html>).

<a id="event-2010-07-18-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A decade-long manhunt orchestrated by the United States Federal Bureau of Investigation ends with the capture of José Figueroa Agosto in San Juan, Puerto Rico.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-10675333>); [The Sydney Morning Herald](<http://news.smh.com.au/breaking-news-world/cocaine-kingpin-nabbed-after-10-years-20100718-10fly.html>).

<a id="event-2010-07-18-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Women rights groups in Pakistan say the life of a woman convicted of adultery is now in grave danger; she faces death by stoning as her man has abandoned her to the courts.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2010/jul/18/couple-sentenced-pakistan>).

<a id="event-2010-07-18-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Health experts condemn tobacco companies for openly flouting European Union laws against advertising by using glitzy sales teams and techniques to promote cigarette brands at young people on Facebook and at music festivals.

Source citations (as archived): [The Observer](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/uk/2010/jul/18/tobacco-giants-target-music-festivals>).

<a id="event-2010-07-18-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Customs officers at Kuala Lumpur International Airport discover 400 rare tortoises, more than 40 rare tomato frogs and an unidentified number of chameleons bound with masking tape and stuffed into socks allegedly smuggled from Madagascar in the luggage of two women.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-pacific-10674741>); [ABC News](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/stories/2010/07/18/2956939.htm?section=world>).

<a id="event-2010-07-18-4-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police in Grenoble, France arrest four people for attempted murder whom they claim protested the fatal shooting of a man by police.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-10676526>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2010-07-18-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu announces that he will oppose a conversion bill that would give the Chief Rabbinate of Israel the legal power to decide whether any conversion is legitimate and could cause immigrants who converted to Judaism abroad to be denied Israeli citizenship.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5jM6aBRPdyhkPppg6lryZftNL2wzQD9H1FDV01>).

#### Science and weather

<a id="event-2010-07-18-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Rhinoceros experts worry after the last female in the Krugersdorp game reserve near Johannesburg is attacked by helicopter, shot with tranquiliser guns, and has her horn hacked off by poachers, slowly bleeding to death.

Source citations (as archived): [The Observer](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/environment/2010/jul/18/poachers-kill-last-female-rhino>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2010-07-18-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Golfer Louis Oosthuizen of South Africa wins the 139th Open Championship, played at the Old Course at St Andrews, Scotland.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/sport/2010/jul/18/the-open-2010-louis-oosthuizen>); [BBC Sport](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/golf/8832469.stm>).

### 2010-07-19

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1322726575](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2010%20July%2019&oldid=1322726575>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2010-07-19-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Greek investigative journalist, blogger and broadcaster Sokratis Giolias is killed after being shot more than 15 times outside his home in Ilioupoli, Athens ahead of the publication of his report into corruption.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-10684185>); [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2010/07/2010719142238331789.html>); [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/idUKTRE66I1TV20100719>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2010/07/19/AR2010071901135.html>).

<a id="event-2010-07-19-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Amnesty International releases its "Agents of Fear" report, accusing Khartoum's National Intelligence and Security Service (NISS) of torturing and abusing political dissidents, including journalists, human rights activists and students, in an attempt to silence them.

Source citations (as archived): [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2010/07/201071913112863816.html>).

<a id="event-2010-07-19-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Several people are killed in a clash between Somali fighters and government forces in the capital Mogadishu.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Netherlands Worldwide](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100722201851/http://www.rnw.nl/africa/article/dozens-killed-artillery-battle-somalia>); [Press TV](<http://www.presstv.ir/detail.aspx?id=135388&amp;sectionid=351020501>); [AP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5g7OaI4_kjeHA-o4UhlmP7vlWmrrwD9H20FQ80>).

#### Arts, culture and entertainment

<a id="event-2010-07-19-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** 75-year-old author Alan Shadrake is arrested in Singapore while promoting his book about the use of the death penalty. He is charged with criminal defamation and faces two years imprisonment.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-pacific-10680143>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/asia/singapore-arrests-author-who-criticised-death-penalty-2030347.html>).

<a id="event-2010-07-19-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Tel Aviv judge orders the opening of safe deposit boxes believed to contain manuscripts and drawings by Bohemian writer Franz Kafka at a bank in Zürich.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-10682482>).

<a id="event-2010-07-19-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A collection of posters is released to mark the 31st anniversary of the Sandinista revolution in Nicaragua.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-10689502>).

<a id="event-2010-07-19-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** An undiscovered painting by Caravaggio is discovered in Rome, according to l'Osservatore Romano.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/entertainment-arts-10682743>); [Christian Science Monitor](<http://www.csmonitor.com/From-the-news-wires/2010/0719/Caravaggio-painting-of-man-being-barbecued-possibly-found-in-Rome>).

<a id="event-2010-07-19-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Russian pianist Mikhail Pletnev appears in court in Thailand, accused of the rape of a 14-year-old male, though he denies this.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-pacific-10680920>).

<a id="event-2010-07-19-1-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Fromelles Military Cemetery is opened in Fromelles in northern France containing the graves of 250 Australian and British soldiers who died in the Battle of Fromelles in World War I and had previously been buried in a mass grave.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-10661923>).

<a id="event-2010-07-19-1-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom's oldest person, a Gateshead great-great grandmother, dies at the age of 111. She would have been 112 next month.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-tyne-10687910>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2010-07-19-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** China surpasses the United States to become world's biggest energy consumer, consuming about 4% more than the U.S.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<http://voices.washingtonpost.com/political-economy/2010/07/morning_briefing_china_becomes.html?hpid=moreheadlines>).

#### Disasters

<a id="event-2010-07-19-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two trains collide in the Birbhum district of West Bengal, India with at least 50 people feared dead.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/India/60-dead-90-injured-as-trains-collide-in-West-Bengal/articleshow/6185725.cms>); [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5gvNPUEKOTTOI9AumfFfjiEGSlZsQ>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-south-asia-10679933>); [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia/2010/07/20107191185349401.html>).

<a id="event-2010-07-19-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Chinese authorities launch a clean-up operation to tackle a 50 sq km slick following an explosion of two crude oil pipelines in Dalian.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-pacific-10680630>); [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/china/2010-07/19/c_13404870.htm>); [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5hmbbqtW_wP_pjgzJuHY0orw0bPkQ>).

<a id="event-2010-07-19-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Retired United States Coast Guard Admiral Thad Allen, the person in charge of cleaning up the Deepwater Horizon oil spill in the Gulf of Mexico states that the cap is leaking but it is not a major concern so far.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5gIXWYBTpLtSayJtg41LKXpxSxVPAD9H2BG3O3>).

#### International Relations

<a id="event-2010-07-19-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** President of Iran Mahmoud Ahmadinejad asks that the United States stop using what he describes as "cowboy logic" if it wants to engage in dialogue with Iran over its nuclear programme, adding that he would support negotiations.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-10683549>).

<a id="event-2010-07-19-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Scores of checkpoints appear overnight as 70 countries prepare to attend a conference in Kabul on the future of Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-south-asia-10687527>).

<a id="event-2010-07-19-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States issues a warning to US citizens visiting or living in Uganda about the risk of terrorism as an African Union summit on maternal and child health summit starts.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2010/WORLD/africa/07/19/uganda.travel.alert/#fbid=Zi63FEAlScD>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2010-07-19-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A two-year "Top Secret America" investigation by The Washington Post concludes that United States intelligence gathering has grown so much since the September 11 attacks that neither its true cost, size nor effectiveness in keeping the country safe is actually known.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-10681861>); [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/americas/2010/07/2010719147325889.html>).

<a id="event-2010-07-19-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A former British Army commanding officer is accused of lying to a public inquiry into the death of Baha Mousa, an Iraqi civilian in his soldiers' custody.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-10686417>).

<a id="event-2010-07-19-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Kenyan pastor John Kamau Mbugua pleads not guilty to two charges over an alleged plot to bomb a campaign rally for next month's constitutional referendum.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-10683129>).

<a id="event-2010-07-19-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Taysir Hayb, the Israeli soldier who shot and killed British volunteer Tom Hurndall, is to be released next month after an Army committee headed by Advocate General Avichai Mandelblit decides to shorten his sentence.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<http://www.haaretz.com/news/diplomacy-defense/idf-soldier-who-shot-british-peace-activist-to-be-released-from-jail-1.302839>).

<a id="event-2010-07-19-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** 196 people are indicted in Istanbul for plotting to overthrow the government.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-10690431>); [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/idUKTRE66I4J020100719?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=worldNews>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2010/jul/19/turkey-coup-plot-196-indicted>); [The News international](<http://www.thenews.com.pk/daily_detail.asp?id=251771>); [People's Daily](<http://english.people.com.cn/90001/90777/90853/7072750.html>); [The Sydney Morning Herald](<http://news.smh.com.au/breaking-news-world/court-indictes-196-in-turkish-coup-plot-20100720-10i3o.html>).

<a id="event-2010-07-19-5-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of Italians commemorate anti-Mafia judge Paolo Borsellino in Palermo, 18 years after he was killed by a car bomb.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-10692732>).

<a id="event-2010-07-19-5-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Syria bans the full face veil from being worn in its universities.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-10684359>); [Oneindia](<http://news.oneindia.in/2010/07/19/syria-bans-burqas-in-universities.html>).

<a id="event-2010-07-19-5-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Authorities at Mexico City International Airport arrest a man who had flown from Lima and was attempting to smuggle 18 little monkeys into the country inside items of clothing.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-10692772>); [The Sydney Morning Herald](<http://news.smh.com.au/breaking-news-world/customs-hold-man-with-18-hidden-monkeys-20100720-10i4c.html>).

#### Politics

<a id="event-2010-07-19-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A report states that U.S. and European intelligence agencies believe Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak is dying of stomach and pancreatic cancer, and has one year left to live. The report states that Mubarak will likely die before the country's next presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<http://www.haaretz.com/news/international/report-western-officials-believe-mubarak-is-terminally-ill-1.302787>).

<a id="event-2010-07-19-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Dési Bouterse is elected President of Suriname by parliament.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-10690930>).

<a id="event-2010-07-19-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Economic and Social Council grants the International Gay and Lesbian Human Rights Commission consultative status after a vote of 23 for, 13 against, 13 abstentions, and 5 absent.

Source citations (as archived): [San Diego Gay &amp; Lesbian News](<http://sdgln.com/news/2010/07/19/united-nations-grants-official-status-us-based-international-lgbt-rights-group>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2010/07/19/world/AP-UN-UN-Gay-Rights.html?hp>).

<a id="event-2010-07-19-6-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister David Cameron launches his "Big Society" scheme.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-10680062>); [Channel 4](<http://www.channel4.com/news/articles/politics/domestic_politics/david+cameron+launches+big+society+scheme/3715737>).

<a id="event-2010-07-19-6-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** David Cameron opts not to meet four United States senators to discuss allegations BP lobbied for the release of the terminally ill Abdelbaset al-Megrahi, though they may meet the ambassador instead.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-10691609>).

<a id="event-2010-07-19-6-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Papua New Guinea Deputy Prime Minister Puka Temu joins with opposition MPs in an attempt to bring down the government of Prime Minister Michael Somare.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/stories/2010/07/19/2958161.htm?section=justin>).

#### Science and weather

<a id="event-2010-07-19-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Queensland fossil hunters discover a cave of 15-million-year-old prehistoric marsupials.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-10686515>).

<a id="event-2010-07-19-7-2"></a>

Context: Farnborough Airshow, Hampshire, England:.

**Archived source account.** An anti-aircraft laser is unveiled, a first for naval warfare.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/technology-10682693>); [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/northamerica/usa/7898710/Laser-used-to-shoots-down-planes.html>).

<a id="event-2010-07-19-7-3"></a>

Context: Farnborough Airshow, Hampshire, England:.

**Archived source account.** A supersonic Bloodhound model is unveiled.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-10679543>).

### 2010-07-20

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076446329](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2010%20July%2020&oldid=1076446329>).

#### Armed conflicts and incidents

<a id="event-2010-07-20-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Navi Pillay states that Kyrgyzstan is detaining hundreds of people and using torture on some of them during the ongoing crisis. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-pacific-10699893>); [Arab News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100722001503/http://arabnews.com/world/article87463.ece>); [France24](<http://www.france24.com/en/20100720-kyrgyzstan-forces-may-have-used-torture-un-rights>); [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/idUKLDE66J0RF._CH_.2420>).

<a id="event-2010-07-20-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thailand's government lifts a state of emergency in 3 provinces; it remains in 16 others, including Bangkok.

Source citations (as archived): [Arab News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110826052204/http://arabnews.com/world/article87362.ece>); [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia-pacific/2010/07/2010720162949305525.html>).

<a id="event-2010-07-20-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** William Hague, the United Kingdom Foreign Secretary, says that British soldiers should be out of Afghanistan by 2014.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2010-07/21/c_13407001.htm>).

<a id="event-2010-07-20-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Uganda's government defends the forced repatriation of 1,700 Rwandan refugees, deemed "heavy-handed" by the United Nations; two people are killed in a group alleged to be a security risk following the July 2010 Kampala attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [Arab News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20120320114457/http://arabnews.com/world/article87361.ece>).

<a id="event-2010-07-20-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Turkey says six of its soldiers were killed and fifteen wounded in an attack by Kurdish rebels near the Iraqi border. Turkey also says that one rebel was killed during the attack, and that others were being pursued by the military.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-10696410>).

#### Arts and entertainment

<a id="event-2010-07-20-1-0"></a>

<a id="event-2010-07-20-4-3"></a>

### 2010-07-21

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076446287](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2010%20July%2021&oldid=1076446287>).

#### Armed conflicts and incidents

<a id="event-2010-07-21-0-1"></a>

Context: Turkey – Kurdistan Workers' Party conflict:.

**Archived source account.** Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK) leader Murat Karayilan says the group would disarm under the supervision of the United Nations in return for an end to attacks on Kurdish civilians and arrests of Kurdish politicians in eastern Turkey, as well as additional linguistic and cultural rights.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-10707935>).

<a id="event-2010-07-21-0-2"></a>

Context: Turkey – Kurdistan Workers' Party conflict:.

**Archived source account.** Suspected PKK militants blow up an oil pipeline carrying oil from Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [Hurriyet](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100723194251/http://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/n.php?n=suspected-kurd-rebels-blow-up-iran-turkey-gas-pipeline-2010-07-21>); [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Science_News/Resource-Wars/2010/07/21/PKK-blamed-for-Turkish-pipeline-attack/UPI-22211279719857/>); [Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/middle-east/Suspected-Kurd-rebels-blow-up-Iran-Turkey-gas-pipeline/articleshow/6195815.cms>).

<a id="event-2010-07-21-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Unidentified gunmen on motorcycles fatally shoot Indian civil rights campaigner and environmentalist Amit Jethwa in Ahmedabad, Gujarat.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-south-asia-10720104>).

<a id="event-2010-07-21-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 30 people are killed and 46 others are wounded, including women and children, as a car bomb explodes near a Shia mosque in Abu Sayeeda, Baqubah, Diyala in Iraq.

Source citations (as archived): [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2010/07/2010721174057881802.html>).

<a id="event-2010-07-21-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 34 people are killed in clashes in northern Yemen between Houthi rebels and pro-government tribes.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2010/07/201072134622962696.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-10713713>).

<a id="event-2010-07-21-0-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States threatens to impose new sanctions on North Korea as part of its attempt to halt perceived nuclear weapons ambitions; North Korea describes United States military exercises in the Sea of Japan as "very dangerous sabre-rattling".

Source citations (as archived): [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia-pacific/2010/07/201072182522763513.html>).

<a id="event-2010-07-21-0-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Assailants launch an attack on a hydroelectric plant in Kabardino-Balkaria in southern Russia killing two guards and letting off bombs.

Source citations (as archived): [Canadian Press](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/canadianpress/article/ALeqM5hYLT9WHY38xWhGXcpLD6qT762uoQ>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2010/07/201072152627545668.html>); [RIA Novosti](<http://en.rian.ru/trend/baksan_attack/>).

<a id="event-2010-07-21-0-9"></a>

<a id="event-2010-07-26-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States government condemns the release of the files, calling it a "risk" and a threat to their security.

Source citations (as archived): [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/americas/2010/07/201072612817513609.html>); [The Sydney Morning Herald](<http://news.smh.com.au/breaking-news-world/us-condemns-massive-leak-of-afghan-war-files-20100726-10r8h.html>).

<a id="event-2010-07-26-3-3"></a>

Context: Release of The War Logs:.

**Archived source account.** Julian Assange defends the release, saying the publication was in the public interest, and saying that Wikileaks had withheld the documents from release until it could redact the names of individuals whose safety might be at risk. US Senator John Kerry says the documents "raise serious questions about the reality of America's policy toward Pakistan and Afghanistan".

#### Armed conflicts and incidents

<a id="event-2010-08-06-0-1"></a>

The Bundeswehr does not admit guilt and families say they may sue.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/International/Article.aspx?id=183973>); [Haaretz](<http://www.haaretz.com/print-edition/news/ciechanover-tapped-for-un-flotilla-probe-1.306624>).

His prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu yesterday testified that he had left Barak to "co-ordinate" the raid and response "in all of its aspects" while he visited North America.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2010-08-12-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan:.

**Archived source account.** The International Assistance Mission says it now believes that the Taliban was responsible for the 2010 Badakhshan massacre of its medical team in Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5jx7oUThJqq-m_xV9hmKY3OUw8hsgD9HHRROG1>).

<a id="event-2010-08-12-0-2"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan:.

**Archived source account.** NATO forces kill three civilians in a raid on a house in Wardak Province, prompting hundreds of angry people to block a main road to express their frustration with the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia/2010/08/201081214759771683.html>).

<a id="event-2010-08-12-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan:.

**Archived source account.** NATO says that it is investigating whether its troops killed or wounded up to seven Afghans in operations in southern Helmand Province.

<a id="event-2010-08-12-0-4"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5gKu1DQoewmBy2do5ctRqUX5efGBAD9HI4E2G0>).

<a id="event-2010-08-12-0-5"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-10947791>); [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2010/08/2010812111759991440.html>).

<a id="event-2010-08-12-0-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 50 people are injured in Dhaka as police use batons and tear gas to beat back civilians protesting against frequent power outage.

<a id="event-2010-08-12-0-8"></a>

<a id="event-2010-08-12-0-9"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Colombia Reports](<http://colombiareports.com/colombia-news/news/11302-bomb-blast-rattles-bogota-radio-station.html>); [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/americas/2010/08/2010812125348956495.html>); [AP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5hB4P7UUGsLNmFp0oUyksHevzz02wD9HI6CDG0>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2010/aug/12/colombia-car-bomb-bogota>).

<a id="event-2010-08-12-0-10"></a>

#### Disasters

<a id="event-2010-08-16-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Politicians and intellectuals including Étienne Balibar, Noam Chomsky, Daniel Cohn-Bendit and Eva Joly appeal to Nicolas Sarkozy that France repay €17 billion it took from Haiti in 1825 after the Haitian Revolution (1791–1804); they say the money is "morally, economically, and legally unassailable" in the aftermath of the January 2010 earthquake.

**Archived source account.** The French Football Federation bans Nicolas Anelka for 18 France games, Patrice Evra for 5, Franck Ribéry for 3, and Jérémy Toulalan for 1, while Éric Abidal escapes punishment, for their roles as the key players behind the 2010 FIFA World Cup player strike.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC Sport](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport1/hi/football/8893705.stm>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/football/2010/aug/17/nicolas-anelka-banned-for-18-matches-france>).

<a id="event-2010-08-17-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Zimbabwe Football Association (Zifa) chief executive Henrietta Rushwaya is charged in relation to allegations of match-fixing.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC Sport](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/africa/8922447.stm>).

<a id="event-2010-08-17-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Chess champion Bobby Fischer is, as a result of a DNA test, deemed not to have fathered a 9-year-old girl in the Philippines.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-11006166>).

### 2010-08-18

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2010-08-18-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The corpse of mayor Edelmiro Cavazos of the Mexican town of Santiago, Nuevo León, is found handcuffed and blindfolded after his abduction on Sunday night. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-11016902>); [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/americas/2010/08/20108181813527666.html>); [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/news/nationworld/world/la-fg-mexico-mayor-20100819,0,3681639.story?track=rss>); [AP](<http://www.miamiherald.com/2010/08/18/1781941/mexican-mayor-found-dead-3-days.html>); [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/idUKTRE67H2ZX20100818>).

<a id="event-2010-08-18-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** 18 countries, including the United States, deploy naval troops in joint exercises which they say are an attempt to defend the Panama Canal against terrorism.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Business_News/Security-Industry/2010/08/18/18-nation-military-maneuvers-focus-on-Panama-Canal-security/UPI-45921282166076/>); [Dominican Today](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100820103025/http://www2.dominicantoday.com/dr/local/2010/8/18/36687/Dominican-troops-join-exercise-to-protect-Panama-Canal>); [MercoPress](<http://en.mercopress.com/2010/08/18/military-exercise-to-defend-the-panama-canal-brings-together-18-countries>); [United States Department of Defense](<http://www.defense.gov/news/newsarticle.aspx?id=60492>).

<a id="event-2010-08-18-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Julian Assange of Wikileaks says the United States has approached the website to try to negotiate the release of a further 15,000 Afghanistan war documents which the military desires to keep secret; the United States denies this.

Source citations (as archived): [Aljazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/americas/2010/08/201081817315332737.html>).

<a id="event-2010-08-18-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States ends combat operations in Iraq as its last combat brigade departs for Kuwait.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2010/08/201081818840122963.html>); [MSNBC](<http://www.msnbc.msn.com/id/38744453/ns/world_news-mideastn_africa>).

<a id="event-2010-08-18-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** 3 Indian peacekeepers serving in a United Nations peacekeeping operation in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are killed by rebels in an apparent ambush.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-11010206>); [Hindustan Times](<http://www.hindustantimes.com/Three-Indian-soldiers-killed-in-rebels-attack-in-Congo/Article1-588538.aspx>).

<a id="event-2010-08-18-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States deploys troops along its border with Mexico by the order of President Barack Obama.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-11020174>).

American tourists are still banned by their government from travelling to Cuba. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2010-08-18-5-0"></a>

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2010-08-19-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Human rights groups express dismay at Kenya for the secret sending to Uganda of four suspects after the 2010 FIFA World Cup attacks in Kampala. Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) agents are also said to have engaged in illegal interrogation of three of them.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-11029767>); [News24](<http://www.news24.com/Africa/News/Uganda-blasts-Group-accuses-Kenya-20100819>); [The Star](<http://www.thestar.co.za/index.php?fArticleId=5608482>).

<a id="event-2010-08-19-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Seven people are killed and fourteen injured in a bomb attack in China's Xinjiang province. Although the region has recently been embroiled in violence including Muslim separatists and majority Han Chinese, the attack is being investigated as a criminal case.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://news.yahoo.com/s/ap/20100819/ap_on_re_as/as_china_xinjiang_explosion>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia-pacific/2010/08/2010819102454243887.html>).

Evol. Biol.'')\}\}

#### Armed conflict and incidents

<a id="event-2010-09-05-0-1"></a>

Context: Israel.

**Archived source account.** Israeli F-16 warplanes launch airstrikes on Gaza smuggling tunnels, with one Palestinian dead and several injured, in retaliation for recent Palestinian attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/MiddleEast/Article.aspx?id=187102>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2010/09/20109505237711605.html>); [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2010-09/05/c_13478728.htm>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-11191266>).

<a id="event-2010-09-05-0-2"></a>

Context: Israel.

**Archived source account.** Yoav Gallant is chosen as the Chief of General Staff of the Israel Defense Forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Features/FrontLines/Article.aspx?id=186124>).

<a id="event-2010-09-05-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least five people are killed and 35 injured as a suicide bomber attacks a Russian Army firing range at Buynaksk, Dagestan.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSLDE68400Q20100905>); [RIA Novosti](<http://en.rian.ru/crime/20100905/160470803.html>).

<a id="event-2010-09-05-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** More than 40 people are killed and dozens of others are injured in a clash in Darfur.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2010/09/20109423526990216.html>).

<a id="event-2010-09-05-0-6"></a>

Context: Iraq.

**Archived source account.** A large explosion hits an Iraqi Ministry of Defence complex in Baghdad.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://news.theage.com.au/breaking-news-world/big-explosion-rocks-central-baghdad-20100905-14vx4.html>).

<a id="event-2010-09-05-0-7"></a>

Context: Iraq.

**Archived source account.** At least 12 people are killed and dozens injured as insurgents attack one of the main military command centres in Baghdad.,

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2010/09/06/world/middleeast/06iraq.html>); [AP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5hwK_CSpBxsNuVUEaDuOwmSSCiqGwD9I206400>).

<a id="event-2010-09-05-0-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Basque nationalist group ETA announces a ceasefire in its struggle for Basque independence from France and Spain.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-11192246>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2010-09-05-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The winners of the 2010 Hugo Awards are announced at Worldcon in Melbourne, Australia.

Source citations (as archived): [Hugo Awards](<http://www.thehugoawards.com>).

<a id="event-2010-09-05-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** British academic Peter Gumbel causes controversy in France by alleging in his book that their education system lowers the self-esteem of pupils.

Source citations (as archived): [The Observer](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2010/sep/05/french-schools-pupils-feel-worthless>).

#### Disasters

<a id="event-2010-09-05-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A state of emergency is declared in Guatemala after heavy rains and landslides kill at least 18 people.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-11189918>); [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2010/0905/guatemala.html>).

<a id="event-2010-09-05-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Australian Army is called in to assist with flood relief in the state of Victoria.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/stories/2010/09/05/3002955.htm>).

#### International Relations

<a id="event-2010-09-05-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Palestinian Authority spokesman says that Iran has no standing to criticize them for relaunching direct talks with Israel while Iran "represses their people," after the Iranian foreign minister says those negotiating with Israel are "betraying their nations."

Source citations (as archived): [Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Home/Article.aspx?id=187107>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2010-09-05-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police in El Salvador discover barrels containing US$9 million in suspected drug money.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-11193687>); [AP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5hAVZ0K7PYVZ8n6Vq8MrsMDIvIsrwD9I1E2DG1>).

#### Politics

<a id="event-2010-09-05-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Voters in Moldova go to the polls in a referendum on whether the country's President should be directly elected.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE6840F620100905>); [RIA Novosti](<http://en.rian.ru/exsoviet/20100905/160475491.html>).

<a id="event-2010-09-05-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The five contenders to be leader of the United Kingdom Labour Party hold a debate in Norwich, England.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/skynews/Home/Politics/Sky-News-Labour-Leadership-Debate-Liveblog-Of-Milibands-Balls-Burnham-Abbott-Head-To-Head/Article/201009115714748?lpos=Politics_First_Poilitics_Article_Teaser_Regi_0&amp;lid=ARTICLE_15714748_Sky_News_Labour_Leadership_Debate:_Liveblog_Of_Milibands,_Balls,_Burnham,_Abbott_Head-To-Head>).

#### Science

<a id="event-2010-09-05-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A group of Danish rocketeers postpone launch when a valve on their rocket jammed.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-11178034>).

### 2010-09-06

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1308896632](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2010%20September%206&oldid=1308896632>).

#### Armed conflicts and incidents

<a id="event-2010-09-06-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least seventeen people are killed and forty others injured after a suicide bomber attacks a Pakistan police station in the town of Lakki Marwat in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<http://www.alarabiya.net/articles/2010/09/06/118594.html>).

<a id="event-2010-09-06-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The number of deaths for members of the International Security Assistance Force in the War in Afghanistan reaches 500 for the first 9 months of 2010 as opposed to 521 for all of 2009.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE6850LL20100906>).

<a id="event-2010-09-06-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Alfredo Pérez Rubalcaba, Spain's Interior Minister, dismisses ETA's ceasefire offer as insufficient for a peace process.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2010/WORLD/europe/09/06/spain.eta.ceasefire.reaction/?hpt=T1#fbid=Zi63FEAlScD&amp;wom=false>).

#### Disasters

<a id="event-2010-09-06-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** New Zealand Army soldiers begin providing security at the centre of Christchurch following the 2010 Canterbury earthquake as a state of emergency is extended until Wednesday.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://news.yahoo.com/s/ap/20100906/ap_on_re_as/as_new_zealand_earthquake>); [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/s/afp/20100906/wl_asia_afp/nzealandquake>).

<a id="event-2010-09-06-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Over fifty-thousand Australians have been placed on evacuation alert in the Australian state of Victoria in eleven towns since Saturday due to the 2010 Victorian floods.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://au.news.yahoo.com/thewest/a/-/world/7891741/53-000-on-flood-alert-in-australia-officials/>).

<a id="event-2010-09-06-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Emergency teams in Guatemala resume rescue efforts after mudslides bury dozens of people.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-11208807>).

<a id="event-2010-09-06-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** 2010 Atlantic hurricane season: Tropical Storm Hermine slams into northern Mexico near the border with Texas.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://web.archive.org/web/20120930101544/http://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/news/international/Storm_Hermine_slams_into_far_northeastern_Mexico.html?cid=28282360>).

<a id="event-2010-09-06-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A wind-driven wildfire in the United States state of Colorado leads to the evacuation of 1,000 houses.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://news.yahoo.com/s/ap/20100907/ap_on_re_us/us_colorado_wildfires>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2010-09-06-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** North Korea announces it will release seven detained Chinese and South Korean fishermen.

Source citations (as archived): [Yonhap](<http://english.yonhapnews.co.kr/northkorea/2010/09/06/10/0401000000AEN20100906007000315F.HTML>); [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2010-09/06/c_13480958.htm>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia-pacific/2010/2010/2010/09/20109693422413913.html>).

<a id="event-2010-09-06-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Bernard Kouchner, the French Minister of Foreign Affairs, and the Vatican offer to assist Sakineh Mohammadi Ashtiani sentenced to death by stoning for adultery in Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-11203939>).

<a id="event-2010-09-06-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Avigdor Lieberman, the Israeli Foreign Affairs Minister and leader of the Yisrael Beitenu Party says that it will block any proposal to extend a freeze on settlements on the West Bank.

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100909135312/http://www.voanews.com/english/news/middle-east/Israels-Foreign-Minister-Vows-to-Block-Settlement-Slowdown-102295934.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2010-09-06-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** China investigates the qualifications of all its commercial pilots after 200 of them had falsified their résumés.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-11200188>); [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5h-hza9H6_RDo0OuPcs9rhUOaRCPg>); [China Daily](<http://www.chinadaily.com.cn/china/2010-09/06/content_11264286.htm>).

<a id="event-2010-09-06-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two Greenpeace activists are given suspended sentences in Japan for stealing whale meat.

Source citations (as archived): [The Japan Times](<http://search.japantimes.co.jp/cgi-bin/nn20100906x2.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE68512920100906>); [AP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5jMSHVlx1X9yF0eKxbBz_2omUdx4wD9I2AHSO0>).

<a id="event-2010-09-06-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Bahrain charges 23 Shia Muslim activists with terrorism and attempting to overthrow the government. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2010/09/201095201748804676.html>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/2010-09-06/bahrain-charges-23-activists-with-terrorism-tied-to-anti-monarchy-group.html>); [Bahrain News Agency](<http://english.bna.bh/?ID=89484>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2010-09-06-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Vlad Filat, the Prime Minister of Moldova, concedes defeat on a referendum proposal for direct election of the President of Moldova.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-11195922>).

<a id="event-2010-09-06-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** France prepares for a general strike over reform to pensions with two million people expected to participate.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/europe/france/7985033/Two-million-French-people-to-strike-over-Sarkozys-pensions-reform.html>).

<a id="event-2010-09-06-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former Prime Minister of the United Kingdom Tony Blair cancels a London book signing for his memoir, A Journey, because of protests by the British National Party and anti-Iraq War demonstrators.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/politics/2010/sep/06/tony-blair-cancels-london-book-signing>).

### 2010-09-07

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1359130983](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2010%20September%207&oldid=1359130983>).

#### Armed conflicts and incidents

<a id="event-2010-09-07-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Israel begins military preparations in order to intercept a 20-ship flotilla due to set sail towards the Gaza Strip and break the Israeli blockade. A wide range of plans are being considered, including the possibility of stopping the flotilla far out at sea due to its sheer size.

Source citations (as archived): [Hurriyet](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100908233359/http://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/n.php?n=israel-bracing-for-8216mother-of-all-flotillas8217-2010-09-07>).

<a id="event-2010-09-07-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A car bomb attack on a Pakistan police headquarters in the city of Kohat kills at least 20 people and injures 50.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5gAq0KnCLioDxDvDNDpm17BVYIvGQ>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2010-09-07-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The shortlist for the Man Booker Prize is released with Peter Carey, Emma Donoghue, Andrea Levy, Howard Jacobson and Tom McCarthy in the running.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/books/2010/sep/07/peter-carey-booker-prize-shortlist>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2010-09-07-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mozambique announces it will reverse a rise in the price of bread that led to riots last week.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-11216009>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2010/09/201097131921161458.html>).

<a id="event-2010-09-07-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Current Barclays Capital chief Robert Diamond, one of the world's highest paid bankers, is to become chief executive of Barclays Bank plc succeeding the present incumbent John Varley next year.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-11209416>).

#### Disasters

<a id="event-2010-09-07-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Some 3,500 people are evacuated in Boulder County, Colorado due to wildfires concerns.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5hsaJqY8fXaOjAtYz8a68BYJBqW1A>).

<a id="event-2010-09-07-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Japan experiences its record-hottest summer.

Source citations (as archived): [Mercury News](<http://www.mercurynews.com/nation-world/ci_15971316?nclick_check=1>); [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2010/09/02/AR2010090200859.html>).

<a id="event-2010-09-07-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Around 85 fires break out in the U.S. city of Detroit, Michigan, with at least 20 homes destroyed. Winds of 40 to 50 mph cause 113,000 customers to lose electricity.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News America](<http://abcnews.go.com/US/fires-engulf-detroit-neighborhoods/story?id=11579438>); [WISN](<http://www.wisn.com/r/24918109/detail.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2010-09-07-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mark David Chapman, John Lennon's killer, is denied parole by the New York State Division of Parole in the U.S..

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2010/CRIME/09/07/new.york.chapman.parole.hearing/index.html#fbid=YIYm6U-LlVS&amp;wom=false>).

<a id="event-2010-09-07-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A curfew is imposed in parts of Srinagar following clashes.

Source citations (as archived): [samaylive](<https://web.archive.org/web/20100908234829/http://english.samaylive.com/nation/676473014.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2010-09-07-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 50 people are arrested during pro-democracy protests in Swaziland.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/2010-09-07/swaziland-pro-democracy-protesters-rally-in-manzini-amid-police-arrests.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-11210849>).

<a id="event-2010-09-07-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** United States Army General David Petraeus, the Commander of the International Security Assistance Force in Afghanistan, condemns plans by a small Florida church to burn copies of the Quran on the anniversary of the September 11 attacks as inflammatory.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<http://atwar.blogs.nytimes.com/2010/09/08/a-bonfire-in-danger-of-spreading/?scp=2&amp;sq=koran%20burning%20petraus&amp;st=cse>).

<a id="event-2010-09-07-5-3"></a>

Context: 2010 Australian federal election.

**Archived source account.** Independent members of parliament Tony Windsor and Rob Oakeshott agree to support a Julia Gillard Australian Labor Party Government ensuring that Labor will be able to form a Government.

Source citations (as archived): [Sydney Morning Herald](<http://www.smh.com.au/federal-election/windsor-and-oakeshott-hand-power-to-gillard-20100907-14you.html?from=smh_sb>).

<a id="event-2010-09-07-5-4"></a>

Context: 2010 Australian federal election.

**Archived source account.** Bob Katter, an independent member of the Australian House of Representatives for Division of Kennedy, indicates that he will support the Liberal/National coalition in Parliament.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/stories/2010/09/07/3004931.htm?section=justin>).

<a id="event-2010-09-07-5-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Trade unions in India declare a bandh or general strike to protest a hike in fuel prices. India is crippled.,

Source citations (as archived): [samaylive](<https://web.archive.org/web/20120308123358/http://english.samaylive.com/nation/676473013.html>); [NDTV](<http://www.ndtv.com/article/india/all-india-bandh-call-by-trade-unions-bengal-kerala-worst-hit-50088>).

<a id="event-2010-09-07-5-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Public transport workers in France and London go on strike over French and UK government austerity measures. The French actions are part of a general strike.,

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://abcnews.go.com/Business/wireStory?id=11572151>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-11204528>).

<a id="event-2010-09-07-5-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Richard M. Daley announces that he will not seek reelection as Mayor of Chicago, Illinois in 2011. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [Chicago Tribune](<http://www.chicagotribune.com/news/nationworld/sns-chicago-mayor,0,3316276.story?track=rss>).

### 2010-09-09

#### Armed conflicts and incidents

<a id="event-2010-09-09-4-8"></a>

According to various estimates ranging from 60,000 to more than 1 million people march from Freedom Plaza to the United States Capitol. **Archived source account.** Astronomers discover the first Earth analog extrasolar planet that may be capable of supporting life, Gliese 581 g, located within the habitable zone and orbiting Gliese 581, a red dwarf star twenty light years from the Solar System.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2010/09/29/AR2010092907492.html>).

### 2010-09-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076443224](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2010%20September%2030&oldid=1076443224>).

#### Armed conflicts and incidents

<a id="event-2010-09-30-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three paramilitary soldiers of the Pakistani Armed Forces are killed and three wounded when NATO helicopters strike a border checkpoint in the Kurram Agency tribal area. Pakistan responds by closing an important supply route that runs through its territory. Interior Minister Rehman Malik announces a high-level meeting to discuss NATO violations of Pakistani sovereignty.

Source citations (as archived): [Bernama](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110714024629/http://www.malaysiandigest.com/world/37-world/9280-three-security-personnel-killed-by-nato-helicopters-in-northwest-pakistan.html>).

<a id="event-2010-09-30-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** An explosion rocks Taliban birthplace Kandahar in southern Afghanistan on Thursday, wounding eight people.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2010-09/30/c_13537365.htm>).

<a id="event-2010-09-30-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two policemen and a civilian are killed and four others wounded in a failed bank robbery in southern Baghdad.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2010-09/30/c_13537649.htm>).

<a id="event-2010-09-30-0-4"></a>

Context: 2010 Ecuador crisis.

**Archived source account.** A state of emergency is declared in Ecuador after troops storm the international airport and police storm the Congress, in which the government declared was an attempted coup d'état.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/southamerica/ecuador/8035745/Ecuador-President-injured-in-coup.html>).

<a id="event-2010-09-30-0-5"></a>

Context: 2010 Ecuador crisis.

**Archived source account.** President Rafael Correa is injured and Peru and Colombia close their border with the country.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5jrnvjhcqgCKRGkE7xwszbiQS-mqA?docId=CNG.eca89f5bc88800f85f46c6df5cbe0017.61>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-11447519>); [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/southamerica/ecuador/8035745/Ecuador-President-injured-in-coup.html>); [Euronews](<http://www.euronews.net/2010/09/30/president-attacked-as-unrest-rocks-ecuador/>).

<a id="event-2010-09-30-0-6"></a>

Context: 2010 Ecuador crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Ecuadorian Army rescues President Correa from hospital where he was being held by rebel troops.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2010/WORLD/americas/09/30/ecuador.unrest/>).

<a id="event-2010-09-30-0-7"></a>

<a id="event-2010-09-30-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The International Monetary Fund calls for tighter regulation of credit rating agencies.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-11440482>).

#### Disasters

<a id="event-2010-09-30-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two earthquakes occur off the coast of West Papua in Indonesia of 6.2 and 7.2 in magnitude.

**Archived source account.** China and the United States officially resume military ties after a 10-month break following US arms sales to Taiwan, with the two countries emphasizing the importance of a close military dialogue. The two countries will also confer on maritime issues next month.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2010/WORLD/asiapcf/09/28/india.ayodhya.backgrounder/index.html?hpt=Mid>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-south-asia-11433481>); [The Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/Ayodhya-verdict-Disputed-land-to-be-divided/articleshow/6658400.cms>).

#### Politics

## October

### 2010-10-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1270596041](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2010%20October%201&oldid=1270596041>).

#### Armed conflicts and incidents

<a id="event-2010-10-01-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In Abuja, two car bombs explode during Nigeria's 50th anniversary celebrations of its Independence from the British Empire, killing 12 and injuring 17. Militant rebel group MEND claims responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-11458674>).

<a id="event-2010-10-01-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Prominent video journalist Merajuddin is hospitalised in Srinagar after being severely beaten with a baton in his neck by Kashmir police. They also beat up his son and colleague in the latest police attack on the media there.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-south-asia-11454942>).

<a id="event-2010-10-01-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Following the killing of 3 Pakistani soldiers by NATO, tankers carrying supplies for NATO troops based in Afghanistan are set alight in Shikarpur, Sindh, injuring no one.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia/2010/10/20101014133433742.html>).

<a id="event-2010-10-01-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** 6 sailors taken hostage off the coast of Cameroon on September 12 by the Africa Marine Commando are released.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-11449082>).

<a id="event-2010-10-01-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** An airstrike launched by the NATO-led International Security Assistance Force (ISAF) kills 15 insurgents in the Tsowkey district of Afghanistan's eastern Kunar province.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2010-10/01/c_13539130.htm>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2010-10-01-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** American author Jonathan Franzen advises British fans to cease reading his latest novel Freedom as a printing error has led to the publication of an old draft of his text, with thousands of copies set to be pulped.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/books/2010/oct/01/jonathan-franzen-book-pulped>).

<a id="event-2010-10-01-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sky 3D, the first dedicated 3D TV channel in Europe, launches in the UK.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://www.bbc.co.uk/newsbeat/11446978>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/tv-and-radio/tvandradioblog/2010/oct/01/sky-3d-channel>); [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/technology/news/8033247/Sky-launches-Europes-first-3D-TV-channel.html>); [The Independent](<https://web.archive.org/web/20101002164331/http://blogs.independent.co.uk/2010/09/30/3d-tv-further-into-your-living-room-than-ever/>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2010-10-01-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** BMW announces the international recall of hundreds of thousands of luxury cars.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-11452486>).

<a id="event-2010-10-01-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** American Bob Dudley succeeds Tony Hayward as the new CEO of BP after the recent controversies over the Oil Spill crisis in the Deepwater Horizon.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5gIXWYBTpLtSayJtg41LKXpxSxVPAD9IJ3ABG0?docId=D9IJ3ABG0>).

#### Disasters

**Archived source account.** A massive rainstorm, formed from the combination of the remnants of Tropical Storm Nicole and a second extratropical low, drenches the East Coast of the United States from North Carolina to Maine. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [AOL](<http://www.aolnews.com/story/storms-drench-much-of-the-east-coast-5/1303729?cid=10>); [AP](<http://www.wmbfnews.com/story/13243500/rain-pounds-nc-as-storm-moves-up-the-east-coast>).

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2010/10/2010101129611907.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-11450093>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/law/2010/oct/01/uganda-un-war-crimes-congo>); [AFP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20101004020626/http://www.straitstimes.com/BreakingNews/World/Story/STIStory_585483.html>).

#### Politics

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

**Archived source account.** 3 people killed in Pibor county of Jonglei state of Sudan.

Source citations (as archived): [Sudan Tribune](<http://sudantribune.com/spip.php?article36505>).

<a id="event-2010-10-04-0-2"></a>

Context: Afghanistan and Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** Three soldiers with the NATO-led International Security Assistance Force (ISAF) were killed in separate attacks in Afghanistan's restive southern and eastern regions.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2010-10/04/c_13542535.htm>).

<a id="event-2010-10-04-0-3"></a>

Context: Afghanistan and Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** 12 people die and 7 others receive wounds during a torch attack in Rawalpindi, Pakistan, on a convoy of more than a dozen oil tankers intended for NATO forces in Afghanistan. This follows a dispute over a NATO helicopter strike that killed 3 soldiers in Pakistan territory.,

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://news.theage.com.au/breaking-news-world/three-dead-as-20-nato-tankers-set-ablaze-in-pakistan-20101004-1635a.html>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2010/10/05/world/asia/05pstan.html?_r=1>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-south-asia-11463490>).

<a id="event-2010-10-04-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 8 people are killed by a CIA drone strike in Pakistan, with three to five of those killed being citizens of Germany.

<a id="event-2010-10-04-0-5"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2010-10/04/c_13542250.htm>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2010/10/2010104142450285342.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-11464621>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2010-10-04-1-1"></a>

Context: TVNZ Breakfast race row:.

**Archived source account.** TVNZ Breakfast broadcaster Paul Henry questions Prime Minister John Key about whether New Zealand's ethnic minority Governor-General Anand Satyanand, representative of Queen Elizabeth II, is a proper New Zealander. Henry has previously described singer Susan Boyle as "retarded" and homosexuality as "unnatural", though the state-owned broadcaster defends him, furthering the controversy.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://news.theage.com.au/breaking-news-world/broadcaster-stirs-race-row-new-zealand-20101004-163yn.html>).

**Archived source account.** Al Jazeera calls on Jordan for a full investigation into why its signal was jammed during live coverage of the 2010 FIFA World Cup.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2010/10/2010104134951296843.html>).

<a id="event-2010-10-04-8-4"></a>

Context: Football:.

**Archived source account.** The corpse of David Le Cluse, the chairman of Croydon Athletic football club, is located with a bullet wound to the head. The team's owner was recently arrested in connection with the recent Pakistan cricket spot-fixing scandal.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-london-11464234>); [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/skynews/Home/UK-News/Croydon-Athletic-Chairman-David-Le-Cluse-Found-Dead-Club-Emroiled-In-Cricket-Match-Fixing-Scandal/Article/201010115751011?lpos=UK_News_News_Your_Way_Region_5&amp;lid=NewsYourWay_ARTICLE_15751011_Croydon_Athletic_Chairman_David_Le_Cluse_Found_Dead%3A_Club_Emroiled_In_Cricket_Match-Fixing_Scandal>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2010-10-16-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The \#18-ranked Wisconsin Badgers defeated the previously unbeaten \#1-ranked Ohio State Buckeyes by a score of 31-18 in Madison, Wisconsin. The victory provided a spark for the Badgers' season, which culminated in a 2010 Big Ten Conference championship, ending a decade-long championship drought, and a Rose Bowl appearance on January 1, 2011 in Pasadena, California. The victory would go on to become a defining transition moment for Wisconsin football, as the program again established itself as a perennial Big Ten powerhouse. The Badgers would go on to win three consecutive Big Ten Championships, extend its postseason bowl streak, and produce many nationally-recognized players (including multiple Heisman Trophy finalists) in the coming years. The 2010 team featured many future NFL players, including future NFL MVP runner-up and Defensive Player of the Year J. J. Watt, 2010 Outland Trophy winner Gabe Carimi, Lance Kendricks, Kevin Zeitler, Rick Wagner, and Brad "B52" Nortman, among others.

Source citations (as archived): [Source](<http://espn.go.com/college-football/recap?gameId=302890275>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2010-10-23-3-1"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-11611658>).

<a id="event-2010-10-23-3-2"></a>

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2010-10-30-0-0"></a>

#### International relations

<a id="event-2010-10-30-4-0"></a>

<a id="event-2010-10-30-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Turkey's national security council adds Israeli activity in the Middle East, "online terror" and global warming to a document listing potential threats, while removing Armenia, Bulgaria, Georgia, Iran and Syria from the same list. The document also calls for a Middle East without nuclear weapons.

Source citations (as archived): [Ynetnews](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-3976899,00.html>).

<a id="event-2010-10-30-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The prime ministers of China and Japan meet in Vietnam amid a diplomatic disagreement, with Hillary Clinton of the United States wading into the dispute during a speech.

**Archived source account.** Abdullah of Saudi Arabia invites Iraqi political leaders for a meeting in Riyadh as part of an attempt to sort out the deadlock over the formation of a new government.

<a id="event-2010-10-30-6-2"></a>

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

**Archived source account.** The US, UK, France and Germany ban all air freight from Yemen at their respective countries' airports following the discovery of two explosive packages.

<a id="event-2010-10-31-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nigeria intercepts a weapons shipment including artillery rockets, originating in Iran, after Israeli officials accused Iran of trying to smuggle the weapons into the Hamas-controlled Gaza Strip.

<a id="event-2010-10-31-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bomb blast occurs in Istanbul's Taksim Square, injuring at least fifteen people.,,

<a id="event-2010-10-31-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iraqi police raid the Sayidat al-Nejat Catholic Church in the Karrada district of Baghdad where gunmen were holding a hundred hostages resulting in seven hostages being killed and twenty injured.,,

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-11463544>); [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/s/afp/20101031/wl_afp/iraqunrestushostagereleasetoll>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2010/10/20101031155653449733.html>).

**Archived source account.** The Shanghai World Expo in China ends.

Source citations (as archived): [China Daily](<http://www.chinadaily.com.cn/china/2010-10/31/content_11481447.htm>); [euronews](<http://www.euronews.net/2010/10/31/china-closes-successful-world-expo/>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-pacific-11660298>).

<a id="event-2010-10-31-2-1"></a>

Context: 2010 Atlantic hurricane season:.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the 2010 Haitian cholera outbreak reaches 330 with the impact of Hurricane Tomas later in the week expected to make things worse.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2010/WORLD/americas/10/30/haiti.cholera/index.html?eref=edition>).

<a id="event-2010-10-31-3-0"></a>

## November

### 2010-11-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076441820](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2010%20November%201&oldid=1076441820>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2010-11-01-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two Afghan women charity workers are shot dead. They were travelling between Lashkar Gah and Garmser, a volatile area in the Helmand River valley, when they were attacked.

Source citations (as archived): [dawn](<https://web.archive.org/web/20101103200302/http://news.dawn.com/wps/wcm/connect/dawn-content-library/dawn/news/world/04-afghan-women-shot-dead-qs-01>).

<a id="event-2010-11-01-0-2"></a>

Context: Battle of Mogadishu (2010):.

**Archived source account.** At least 12 people are killed in fighting in Mogadishu, Somalia, between pro-government forces, African Union troops and the Islamist militant al-Shabaab group.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5g7Slk7NocIlUUFzIZklnZeJ6r1iw?docId=CNG.809df977b92d0cf07c212de2205b6b72.e31>); [Ennahar](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110726023517/http://www.ennaharonline.com/en/international/5092.html>).

<a id="event-2010-11-01-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Photographs, diaries and footage of Gyles Mackrell's rescue of refugees from the Japanese invasion of Burma in World War II are made available.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/asia/wwii-elephant-man-rescue-revealed-on-film-2122153.html>).

<a id="event-2010-11-01-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The rebel Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK) in Turkey announces it will extend a truce until elections next year.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5iaGvo6BbyQPjdH5xnk8b2Q6PS0lA?docId=CNG.af5a1cb25e03ecc70924e5a7787c7aa3.611>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2010-11-23-0-1"></a>

Context: Shelling of Yeonpyeong:.

**Archived source account.** North Korea shells Yeonpyeong island, South Korea at 14:34 local time in response to South Korean shelling close to the North Korean border during military drills. The North's shelling kills two marines and prompts a military response by the South in one of the most serious clashes since the 1953 armistice of the Korean War.

Source citations (as archived): [YTN Television](<http://www.stuff.co.nz/world/asia/4378199/North-Korea-shells-South-Korean-island>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-pacific-11818005>); [Yonhap](<http://english.yonhapnews.co.kr/national/2010/11/23/95/0301000000AEN20101123011500315F.HTML>); [China Daily](<http://www.chinadaily.com.cn/world/2010-11/23/content_11597881.htm>); [The Sun UK](<http://www.thesun.co.uk/sol/homepage/news/3241739/North-Korea-fire-sparks-outrage.html>).
