### 2010-11-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1115445355](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2010%20November%2028&oldid=1115445355>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2010-11-28-0-1"></a>

Context: United States diplomatic cables leak and attack on WikiLeaks:.

**Archived source account.** The WikiLeaks website is attacked by a computer-hacking operation and undergoes "a mass distributed denial of service attack" as it prepares to release more secret U.S. documents. Julian Assange says U.S. authorities are afraid of being held accountable for their actions.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-11858637>).

<a id="event-2010-11-28-0-2"></a>

Context: United States diplomatic cables leak and attack on WikiLeaks:.

**Archived source account.** The United States Department of State says the planned release of a new batch of classified documents would place its military operations at risk, and warns of possible legal action if they were found to have been provided in violation of U.S. law.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2010/US/11/28/wikileaks.response/?hpt=T2>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE6AP06Z20101128>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2010/11/28/AR2010112800401.html>).

<a id="event-2010-11-28-0-3"></a>

Context: United States diplomatic cables leak and attack on WikiLeaks:.

**Archived source account.** Wikileaks releases 250,000 messages sent by U.S. embassies, including messages discussing corruption, criticisms of the UK, Guantánamo Bay prison camp, a Chinese cyber attack, the relationship between Vladimir Putin and Silvio Berlusconi, and a possible unified Korea.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/americas/2010/11/20101128184116255899.html>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2010/nov/28/how-us-embassy-cables-leaked>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE6AR2Y520101128>); [The New Zealand Herald](<http://www.nzherald.co.nz/technology/news/article.cfm?c_id=5&amp;objectid=10690807>); [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/skynews/Home/World-News/WikiLeaks-Saudi-Arabia-Urged-Iran-Attack-Is-Among-Secret-US-Files-Released-By-Website/Article/201011415837304?lpos=World_News_Right_Promo_Region_0&amp;lid=ARTICLE_15837304_WikiLeaks%3A_Saudi_Arabia_Urged_Iran_Attack_Is_Among_Secret_US_Files_Released_By_Website>).

<a id="event-2010-11-28-0-4"></a>

Context: United States diplomatic cables leak and attack on WikiLeaks:.

**Archived source account.** The White House issues a statement of condemnation "in the strongest terms \[of\] the unauthorised disclosure of classified documents and sensitive national security information".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-11859198>).

Source citations (as archived): [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2010/1128/economy.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-11855990>).

### 2010-12-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076440223](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2010%20December%203&oldid=1076440223>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2010-12-03-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two Lebanese labourers are injured after the Israeli army detonates two of its espionage devices by remote control in the southern Lebanese city of Tyre.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5jShH9pADHmOdOfHvTAG5qXppxj1g?docId=CNG.3023d7fcdeb5553eb95b62891d9d84d2.a11>); [Daily Star - Lebanon](<http://www.dailystar.com.lb/article.asp?edition_id=1&amp;categ_id=2&amp;article_id=122191>).

<a id="event-2010-12-03-0-2"></a>

Context: Attacks against WikiLeaks, Julian Assange and The Guardian website:.

**Archived source account.** As "massive" cyberwarfare against the WikiLeaks website continue, the website is forced to change its web address after EveryDNS kills its domain due to the disruption caused to its other customers by the attacks. United States authorities are accused of carrying out the cyber attacks against the website.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/media/blog/2010/dec/03/wikileaks-knocked-off-net-dns-everydns>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-11907641>).

<a id="event-2010-12-03-0-3"></a>

Context: Attacks against WikiLeaks, Julian Assange and The Guardian website:.

**Archived source account.** Spokesperson Julian Assange calls for Canadian prime minister Stephen Harper's former chief of staff Tom Flanagan to be charged with "incitement to commit murder" after Flanagan urged Barack Obama to "put out a contract" and "assassinate" Assange. Assange speaks of the precautions he has to take against such threats of death, with American politician Mike Huckabee also calling for executions to be carried out.

Source citations (as archived): [Toronto Star](<https://www.thestar.com/news/world/article/901031--wikileaks-julian-assange-lashes-out-at-former-stephen-harper-aide?bn=1>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2010/12/2010123144744513729.html>).

<a id="event-2010-12-03-0-4"></a>

Context: Attacks against WikiLeaks, Julian Assange and The Guardian website:.

**Archived source account.** Julian Assange gives a live question and answer session on the website of The Guardian newspaper.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/blog/2010/dec/03/julian-assange-wikileaks>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2010/12/2010123144744513729.html>).

<a id="event-2010-12-03-0-5"></a>

Context: Attacks against WikiLeaks, Julian Assange and The Guardian website:.

**Archived source account.** The Guardian's web servers are "crippled" as the session is going live.

Source citations (as archived): [The Wall Street Journal](<http://blogs.wsj.com/tech-europe/2010/12/03/guardians-assange-live-qa-cripples-server/>).

<a id="event-2010-12-03-0-6"></a>

Context: Attacks against WikiLeaks, Julian Assange and The Guardian website:.

**Archived source account.** The French Government places political pressure on its internet use governing body, warning of "consequences" for anyone assisting WikiLeaks in the country. OVH responds, saying "it's not up to politicians or OVH to decide the site's closure" and seeks legal advice from a judge.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/media/2010/dec/03/wikileaks-france-ban-website>); [AFP](<http://www.france24.com/en/20101203-wikileaks-besson-france-banned-servers-cyber-attacks-ovh-swiss-address-assange>).

<a id="event-2010-12-03-0-7"></a>

Context: Attacks against WikiLeaks, Julian Assange and The Guardian website:.

**Archived source account.** A court in Lahore dismisses a petition seeking a ban on the WikiLeaks website, with the judge ruling such a ban to be "unmaintainable" and that "We must bear the truth, no matter how harmful it is".

Source citations (as archived): [DAWN](<http://www.dawn.com/2010/12/03/lhc-dismisses-petition-seeking-wikileaks-ban.html>).

<a id="event-2010-12-03-0-8"></a>

Context: Attacks against WikiLeaks, Julian Assange and The Guardian website:.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Congressman Ron Paul of Texas calls for WikiLeaks to receive similar protections to mainstream media, saying when "truth becomes treason, then we're in big trouble".

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/8301-503544_162-20024605-503544.html>).

<a id="event-2010-12-03-0-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** President Barack Obama makes a surprise visit to United States armed forces based in Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSN0314170320101203>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2010-12-08-3-1"></a>

Context: United States diplomatic cables leak:.

**Archived source account.** Newly released cables report that the British government feared Libya might reduce political relations if Abdelbaset al-Megrahi were to die in jail in Scotland.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.heraldsun.com.au/news/world/wikileaks-cables-show-libya-threatened-uk-over-lockerbie-bomber/story-e6frf7lf-1225967538763>).

<a id="event-2010-12-08-3-2"></a>

Context: United States diplomatic cables leak:.

**Archived source account.** Newly released cables reveal America lobbied Russia in an attempt to ensure Visa and MasterCard were not "adversely affected" by new legislation earlier this year. Both companies recently suspended all payments to the WikiLeaks website, reportedly after coming under intense pressure from the U.S. government.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2010/dec/08/wikileaks-us-russia-visa-mastercard>).

<a id="event-2010-12-08-3-3"></a>

Context: United States diplomatic cables leak:.

**Archived source account.** Online group Anonymous announces the success of Operation Payback, bringing the website of American multinational corporation MasterCard into a state of paralysis after it shuts off donations to the WikiLeaks website.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/media/2010/dec/08/mastercard-hackers-wikileaks-revenge>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2010/12/2010128133639866230.html>).

<a id="event-2010-12-08-3-4"></a>

Context: United States diplomatic cables leak:.

**Archived source account.** Former Australian prime minister and current foreign minister Kevin Rudd questions U.S. security and holds America responsible for documents made public by the WikiLeaks website. These comments by Rudd, a "control freak" according to U.S. diplomats, are a departure from current prime minister Julia Gillard, who has previously blamed Julian Assange.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/wikileaks/8188800/Wikileaks-Kevin-Rudd-blames-US-for-release-of-diplomatic-cables.html>).

<a id="event-2010-12-08-3-5"></a>

Context: United States diplomatic cables leak:.

**Archived source account.** An open letter is sent to Gillard requesting that she make a"strong statement" supporting Assange: signatories include renowned American scholar Noam Chomsky, Australian Greens Senator Bob Brown, army whistleblower Lance Collins and numerous Australian authors including Raimond Gaita, Christos Tsiolkas and Helen Garner.

Source citations (as archived): [Herald Sun](<http://www.heraldsun.com.au/news/world/julia-gillard-should-support-julian-assange-say-wikileaks-supporters/story-e6frf7lf-1225967621833>).

<a id="event-2010-12-08-3-6"></a>

Context: United States diplomatic cables leak:.

**Archived source account.** The Washington Post reports that the WikiLeaks website is stronger than ever and has increased support among netizens despite widespread attempts to shut it down.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2010/12/08/AR2010120804038.html>).

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** Palestinian leader Mahmoud Abbas says Middle East peace talks are in crisis following Israel's refusal to stop building in settlements.

<a id="event-2010-12-09-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The African Union suspends Côte d'Ivoire following the disputed presidential election. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

<a id="event-2010-12-09-3-4"></a>

Context: United States diplomatic cables leak:.

**Archived source account.** Newly released cables report that oil giant Royal Dutch Shell had "access to everything" inside "all relevant ministries" of the Nigerian government.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2010/12/201012902541205186.html>); [The Hindu](<http://www.thehindu.com/news/international/article941267.ece>); [IOL](<http://www.iol.co.za/news/africa/cable-shell-infiltrated-nigerian-ministries-1.999380>); [Brisbane Times](<http://www.brisbanetimes.com.au/national/we-know-everything-shell-executive-boasted-20101209-18rf8.html>); [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/wikileaks/8190406/WikiLeaks-Shell-knows-everything-about-the-Nigerian-government.html>).

<a id="event-2010-12-09-3-5"></a>

Context: United States diplomatic cables leak:.

**Archived source account.** Newly released cables reveal close U.S. monitoring of Chinese ties with Africa and the American belief that the Chinese are "a very aggressive and pernicious economic competitor with no morals" in their dealings with the Africans.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2010/12/201012981346664660.html>); [AFP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110720090200/http://news.iafrica.com/worldnews/693099.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-11955516>); [Times LIVE](<https://web.archive.org/web/20101211005358/http://www.timeslive.co.za/scitech/article806742.ece/US--China-has-no-morals-in-Africa>).

<a id="event-2010-12-09-3-7"></a>

Context: United States diplomatic cables leak: / Australia–United States relations:.

**Archived source account.** Australian Sports Minister Mark Arbib is named as a confidential source for the U.S. embassy, passing on information on the Australian Government. Melbourne Ports MP Michael Danby and former MP Bob McMullan have also contacted the embassy.

Source citations (as archived): [Herald Sun](<http://www.heraldsun.com.au/news/national/minister-outed-as-secret-us-source/story-e6frf7l6-1225967975918>); [The Age](<http://www.theage.com.au/national/arbib-revealed-as-secret-us-source-20101208-18prg.html>); [The Sydney Morning Herald](<http://www.smh.com.au/technology/technology-news/mark-arbib-aka-cia-agent-007-20101209-18q50.html>).

<a id="event-2010-12-09-3-8"></a>

Context: United States diplomatic cables leak: / Australia–United States relations:.

**Archived source account.** Arbib warned the United States about a possible challenge to Kevin Rudd's prime ministership as early as last year.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/stories/2010/12/09/3088550.htm>).

<a id="event-2010-12-09-3-9"></a>

Context: United States diplomatic cables leak: / Australia–United States relations:.

<a id="event-2010-12-09-3-12"></a>

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2010-12-09-4-1"></a>

<a id="event-2010-12-20-0-1"></a>

### 2010-12-21

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1352728287](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2010%20December%2021&oldid=1352728287>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2010-12-21-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Palestinian militant group "Army of Islam" fires rockets from Gaza into southern Israel in response to the killing of three of its members by Israel last month, with one rocket landing close to a kindergarten near Ashkelon, injuring a 14-year-old girl; Israeli jets respond with air strikes in the Gaza Strip, injuring at least two Palestinian militants, Palestinian sources say.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-12047908>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2010/12/2010122142226408227.html>); [Arutz Sheva](<http://www.israelnationalnews.com/News/news.aspx/141268>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Defense/Article.aspx?id=200370>).

<a id="event-2010-12-21-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** North Korea silences its guns to prevent confrontation with South Korea as the South's "reckless" and ""childish play with fire" military drills continue. North Korea also invites International Atomic Energy Agency inspectors into the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia-pacific/2010/12/201012210236682346.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2010-12-21-1-1"></a>

Context: Pope Benedict XVI comments on condoms and pedophilia:.

**Archived source account.** Survivors of child sexual abuse carried out by priests react with fury after Pope Benedict XVI's claims that pedophilia wasn't considered an "absolute evil" as recently as the 1970s and that society considers child pornography "normal".

Source citations (as archived): [Irish Independent](<http://www.independent.ie/national-news/pope-stirs-up-victim-fury-with-child-sex-comments-2468163.html>).

<a id="event-2010-12-21-1-2"></a>

Context: Pope Benedict XVI comments on condoms and pedophilia:.

**Archived source account.** The Vatican claims recent comments by Pope Benedict XVI concerning the use of condoms by male sex workers to reduce HIV infection do not mean the contraceptive devices can be used to fight against pregnancy in females.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-12053610>).

<a id="event-2010-12-21-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Buckingham Palace announces the engagement of the Queen's granddaughter Zara Phillips and Rugby Union player Mike Tindall.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-12050165>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2010-12-21-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Toyota agrees to pay the US government $32.4 million over its handling of car recalls in 2010 where over 10 million cars were recalled worldwide, over 14 separate recalls.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-12047360>).

<a id="event-2010-12-21-2-2"></a>

Context: BSKYB takeover.

**Archived source account.** The European Commission approves News Corporation's bid to take full control of British satellite broadcaster BSkyB. However, the deal will be reviewed by Ofcom before a final decision is made.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-12050296>).

<a id="event-2010-12-21-2-3"></a>

Context: BSKYB takeover.

**Archived source account.** UK Business Secretary Vince Cable is stripped of his powers to rule on the proposal after telling undercover journalists from the Daily Telegraph that he intended to block the deal and had "declared war" on Rupert Murdoch. Culture Secretary Jeremy Hunt will now have that responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-12053656>).

#### Disasters

<a id="event-2010-12-21-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 39 people are killed and hundreds injured in a 6.5 magnitude earthquake in southeastern Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/middle-east/Seven-dead-hundreds-injured-in-Iran-quake/articleshow/7136626.cms>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2010-12-21-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Top Fatah members aligned with Palestinian Authority President Mahmoud Abbas asked Israel to attack Hamas ahead of Hamas’ violent takeover of the Gaza Strip in 2007, according to a US diplomatic cable published by Wikileaks.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/NationalNews/Article.aspx?id=200306>).

<a id="event-2010-12-21-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Turkish government warns US President Barack Obama that a congressional vote on a resolution recognizing the Armenian genocide during World War I will severely damage Turkey–United States relations.

Source citations (as archived): [Sify](<http://www.sify.com/news/turkey-warns-us-over-armenia-genocide-resolution-news-international-kmvuOmajhfh.html>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2010/12/20/AR2010122002028.html>).

<a id="event-2010-12-21-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Australian government pays damages to Indian doctor Muhamed Haneef whom the country wrongly charged and deported over an unsuccessful 2007 bomb plot in the United Kingdom.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-pacific-12049120>).

<a id="event-2010-12-21-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** India and Russia sign a range of treaties including on development of a fifth-generation stealth fighter and provision of nuclear reactors from Russia to India.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hindu](<http://www.thehindu.com/news/national/article967916.ece>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-south-asia-12046974>); [RIA Novosti](<http://en.rian.ru/mlitary_news/20101221/161867153.html>).

<a id="event-2010-12-21-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Britain sends a Russian diplomat home because of what it claims is "clear evidence of activities by the Russian intelligence services against UK interests".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-12054798>).

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2010/WORLD/asiapcf/12/21/thailand.emergency/?hpt=T2>); [Thai News Agency](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110629195039/http://www.mcot.net/cfcustom/cache_page/145701.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2010-12-21-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tuvalu Prime Minister Maatia Toafa is ousted in a vote of no confidence, necessitating nominations for a new Prime Minister.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZI](<http://www.rnzi.com/pages/news.php?op=read&amp;id=57819>); [RNZI](<http://www.rnzi.com/pages/news.php?op=read&amp;id=57833>).

<a id="event-2010-12-21-6-4"></a>

Context: 2010 United States Census.

**Archived source account.** The United States Census Bureau releases the first data from the 2010 Census, revealing the United States to have a population of 308,745,538 on April 1, 2010.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN.com](<http://money.cnn.com/2010/12/21/pf/Census_2010/index.htm?hpt=T1>).

<a id="event-2010-12-21-6-5"></a>

Context: 2010 United States Census.

**Archived source account.** Nevada was once more the fastest growing state, growing 35.1% over 2000. Michigan was the only state to lose population. The District of Columbia broke a five-census streak of population loss. Puerto Rico also lost population.

Source citations (as archived): [U.S. Census Bureau](<http://2010.census.gov/2010census/data/apportionment-pop-text.php>).

<a id="event-2010-12-21-6-6"></a>

Context: 2010 United States Census.

**Archived source account.** Eight states will gain seats in reapportionment for the 113th United States Congress, with Texas receiving four new seats and Florida receiving two. California fails to gain seats for the first time since 1920. Ten states will lose seats, with New York and Ohio each losing two.

Source citations (as archived): [U.S. Census Bureau](<http://2010.census.gov/news/pdf/apport2010_table1.pdf>).

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076439237](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2010%20December%2022&oldid=1076439237>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

**Archived source account.** South Korea announces it is to hold its biggest ever live fire drill near the North Korea border.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia-pacific/2010/12/2010122234351687271.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-pacific-12056875>).

**Archived source account.** A senior Israeli army officer tells the BBC that another Gaza War is "a question of when, not if" should Hamas continue to control the Gaza Strip.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-12064775>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2010-12-22-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pope Benedict XVI announces a BBC Radio 4 Christmas Eve message, the first such message for one of the countries he visited last year.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-12063684>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2010-12-22-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thousands of students march peacefully through Rome as part of nationwide demonstrations in Italy prior to a Senate vote which threatens education funds.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2010/12/201012221686817399.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-12058434>).

#### Disasters

<a id="event-2010-12-22-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A UN Development Programme report concludes that Aceh's recovery from the 2004 Indian Ocean earthquake and tsunami is "beyond anything imaginable six years ago" but that more needs to be done concerning poverty and natural disaster impact.

<a id="event-2010-12-22-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States approves more than $4 billion assistance for rescuers and residents whose health was affected after the September 11 attacks in New York City in 2001.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/americas/2010/12/2010122302740414232.html>).

<a id="event-2010-12-22-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ongoing flooding in California kills at least three people.

Source citations (as archived): [Hereald Sun](<http://www.heraldsun.com.au/news/breaking-news/womans-body-pulled-from-california-flood-waters-as-rain-subsides/story-e6frf7jx-1225975748528>); [New York Daily News](<http://www.nydailynews.com/news/galleries/california_rain_storms_state_of_emergency/california_rain_storms_state_of_emergency.html>); [MSNBC](<http://www.msnbc.msn.com/id/40770785/ns/weather/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2010-12-22-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States House of Representatives decides not to take up a resolution declaring the mass killings of Armenians early last century a genocide, helping the administration to avoid a diplomatic clash with Turkey.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2010/12/22/AR2010122205131.html>).

<a id="event-2010-12-22-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Senate votes to ratify the New START Treaty with the Russia, which halves the number of deployed strategic nuclear missile launchers maintained by each nation.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2010/12/21/AR2010122104371.html>).

<a id="event-2010-12-22-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Nations votes in favour of restoring a reference to sexual orientation in a resolution banning the unjustified killing of minority groups.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-12056608>).

<a id="event-2010-12-22-4-4"></a>

Context: United States diplomatic cables leak:.

**Archived source account.** New cables show that the British government was involved in the training of the Bangladeshi Rapid Action Battalion, a paramilitary force widely criticised for human rights violations, including torture and over 1,000 extra-judicial killings since its 2004 inception.

Source citations (as archived): [MSNBC](<http://www.msnbc.msn.com/id/40773855/ns/us_news-wikileaks_in_security/>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2010/dec/21/wikileaks-cables-british-police-bangladesh-death-squad>); [Bangladesh News 24 hours](<https://web.archive.org/web/20120305093531/http://www.bdnews24.com/details.php?id=182286&amp;cid=2>).

<a id="event-2010-12-22-4-5"></a>

Context: United States diplomatic cables leak:.

**Archived source account.** Hillary Clinton, U.S. Secretary of State, is documented ordering all U.S. ambassadors to pressure their respective nations' media into not being critical of the U.S. aid program in Haiti, days after the 2010 Haiti earthquake.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2010/dec/21/wikileaks-you-ask-december-22?intcmp=239>).

<a id="event-2010-12-22-4-6"></a>

Context: United States diplomatic cables leak:.

**Archived source account.** Documents are released outlining pressure the U.S. used in an attempt to stop Italy from indicting the CIA agents who kidnapped Abu Omar in Milan, then flew him to Egypt to be tortured. The documents show Italian PM Silvio Berlusconi to be on the American side and recorded him "vent\[ing\] his rage at his own country's judicial system."

Source citations (as archived): [Der Spiegel](<http://www.spiegel.de/international/europe/0,1518,735268,00.html>).

<a id="event-2010-12-22-4-7"></a>

Context: United States diplomatic cables leak:.

**Archived source account.** McDonald's attempted to pressure the U.S. government to stall the implementation of the Dominican Republic – Central America Free Trade Agreement until El Salvador appointed "neutral judges" in a $24million lawsuit against the company in 2006.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/business/2010/dec/21/wikileaks-cables-mcdonalds-us-el-salvador?intcmp=239>).

<a id="event-2010-12-22-4-8"></a>

Context: United States diplomatic cables leak:.

**Archived source account.** U.S. diplomats applied pressure on Bangladesh to allow the London-based Global Coal Management company to reopen a large open-cast coal mine in the Phulbari area that was closed due to violent protests over foreign ownership of Bangladeshi resources succeeded in closing the mine.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2010/dec/21/wikileaks-cables-us-bangladesh-coal-mine>).

<a id="event-2010-12-22-4-9"></a>

Context: United States diplomatic cables leak:.

**Archived source account.** Newly released cables reveal that New Zealand threatened Fiji's military chief Frank Bainimarama and his wife.

Source citations (as archived): [Stuff](<http://www.stuff.co.nz/world/south-pacific/4484467/WikiLeaks-Family-access-threat-over-Fiji-coup/>).

<a id="event-2010-12-22-4-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Russian government is "forced to take an adequate corresponding measure" following Britain's expulsion of one of its diplomats.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2010/12/20101222114049900950.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2010-12-22-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three Tibetan Buddhist monks are unaccounted for after being sentenced to long prison terms by Chinese authorities earlier this year for participating in a peaceful protest march by Drepung monastery monks in 2008.

Source citations (as archived): [RFA](<http://www.rfa.org/english/news/tibet/monks-12222010163931.html>).

<a id="event-2010-12-22-5-2"></a>

Context: WikiLeaks:.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations office for torture issues in Geneva investigates an abuse complaint concerning United States Army private Bradley Manning, suspected by the United States government of passing classified documents to the WikiLeaks website.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hindu](<http://www.thehindu.com/news/international/article970744.ece>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2010/dec/23/un-treatment-leaks-bradley-manning>); [AP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5gBQWfPZYMA6BP8FwtMyZUch6HCFw?docId=89f11e21495146a581d093f1266a3dd4>); [The Irish Times](<http://www.irishtimes.com/newspaper/world/2010/1221/1224285991888.html>).

<a id="event-2010-12-22-5-3"></a>

Context: WikiLeaks:.

**Archived source account.** Julian Assange discusses the time he spent locked up in Wandsworth Prison in an interview with the El País newspaper.

Source citations (as archived): [El País](<http://www.elpais.com/articulo/english/I/get/death/threats/constantly/do/my/lawyer/and/my/children/elpepueng/20101220elpeng_4/Ten>).

<a id="event-2010-12-22-5-4"></a>

Context: WikiLeaks:.

**Archived source account.** The Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) launches WikiLeaks Task Force or WTF, a taskforce intended to examine the impact caused by the released cables.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2010/dec/22/cia-wikileaks-taskforce-wtf>).

<a id="event-2010-12-22-5-5"></a>

Context: WikiLeaks:.

**Archived source account.** Mauritius sues the United Kingdom due to prevention of the return of 2,000 residents forced out of the Chagos Islands during a 1960s lease to a U.S. air base.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-12058923>).

<a id="event-2010-12-22-5-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** The European Commission rejects efforts by several ex-Soviet bloc countries for the European Union to legislate against the condoning or denial of totalitarian crimes.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-12059475>).

<a id="event-2010-12-22-5-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** 7 out of 9 presidential candidates, charged with organizing mass disturbances, may receive 15-year sentences in Belarus, according to human rights groups.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2010/12/20101222171735966368.html>).

<a id="event-2010-12-22-5-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** The chair of the Metropolitan Police Authority's civil liberties panel describes as "appalling" and "ghastly" a kettling video and encourages students subjected to this procedure to make official complaints against the British police.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/uk/2010/dec/22/kettling-video-appalling-police-watchdog>).

<a id="event-2010-12-22-5-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** Jorge Rafael Videla, the former de facto President of Argentina, is sentenced to life imprisonment after being convicted of crimes against humanity.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-12064831>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/americas/2010/12/2010122221316602539.html>).

<a id="event-2010-12-22-5-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** President of the United States Barack Obama signs into law the Don't Ask, Don't Tell Repeal Act of 2010, which will bring an end the "don't ask, don't tell" policy of discriminating against the presence of openly gay people in the country's military. More than 13,000 people were sacked by the United States under this policy.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-12059954>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2010-12-22-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The fears of British Liberal Democrat government ministers over policies relating to welfare and tuition fees are secretly recorded by The Daily Telegraph newspaper.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-12056554>).

<a id="event-2010-12-22-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** British millionaire Tory MP Zac Goldsmith is not to be reported to police over his election spending allegations but some other concerns are expressed by the Electoral Commission.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-london-12062582>).

<a id="event-2010-12-22-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Montenegrin Prime Minister Milo Đukanović resigns, citing a need for new leadership, and his intentions to turn to business.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2010-12/22/c_13658955.htm>).

#### Science

<a id="event-2010-12-22-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two eight-year-olds publish a significant peer-reviewed study in the Biology Letters journal of the Royal Society, examining the spatial memory of bumblebees.

Source citations (as archived): [Agence Presse-France](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5iT4S9cVytbmVuKn61FsMErM1W_ow>); [The Hindu](<http://www.hindu.com/seta/2010/12/23/stories/2010122350091600.htm>); [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/news/science/wire/sns-ap-eu-britain-child-scientists,0,3436003.story>).

### 2010-12-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076439190](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2010%20December%2023&oldid=1076439190>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2010-12-23-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of South Korean troops, tanks, helicopters and jet fighters gather 12 miles from the border with North Korea to stage one of South Korea's largest ever live fire military drills in a "show of force" before its neighbour. North Korea describes the exercises as "warmongering", and threatens a "sacred war".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-pacific-12065267>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2010/WORLD/asiapcf/12/23/south.korea.drills/?hpt=T2>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia-pacific/2010/12/201012233479157770.html>).

<a id="event-2010-12-23-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Nations says 173 people have been killed during post-election violence in the Ivory Coast.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-12067318>).

<a id="event-2010-12-23-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two parcel bombs explode at the Swiss and Chilean embassies in central Rome, Italy. One person is seriously injured. Officials suspect that the perpetrators are from an Italian anarchist group.

Source citations (as archived): [The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/world/parcel-bomb-attacks-hit-rome-embassies/story-e6frg6so-1225975697316>); [swissinfo.ch](<http://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/politics/Blast_at_Swiss_embassy_in_Rome_injures_one.html?cid=29098584>); [The Christian Science Monitor](<http://www.csmonitor.com/World/Europe/2010/1223/Rome-explosions-at-embassies-linked-to-Italian-anarchists>).

**Archived source account.** A survey indicates that almost one third of Britons believe they have a guardian angel.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/1-in-3-believes-in-guardian-angels-2167517.html>); [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-1340944/How-believe-guardian-angel-looking-us.html?ito=feeds-newsxml>); [Press Association](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ukpress/article/ALeqM5ib9svocn-ZAefY9j3ZXlFWpMJ5fw?docId=N0281461293015839054A>).

<a id="event-2010-12-23-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Daily Telegraph publishes further details of taped conversations with Liberal Democrat MPs, which include comments that British Prime Minister David Cameron cannot be trusted and Chancellor George Osborne has "a capacity to get up one's nose".

<a id="event-2010-12-23-6-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Citizenship and Immigration Canada cuts funding for settlement centres across the country, leading to the Ontario Liberals protesting the decision that will affect many new immigrants in the province. Immigration minister Jason Kenney also affirms that Santa Claus is Canadian, referring to his characteristic red and white colours.

Source citations (as archived): [Globe and Mail](<https://www.theglobeandmail.com/news/politics/ontario-hit-hard-by-federal-cuts-to-immigrant-settlement-centres/article1848219/>); [CTV](<http://www.ctv.ca/CTVNews/TopStories/20101223/immigrant-services-funding-cut-reaction-101223/>); [Toronto Star](<https://www.thestar.com/news/article/911205--funding-axed-for-toronto-immigrant-agencies>); [National Post](<http://news.nationalpost.com/2010/12/22/santa-claus-a-canadian-immigration-minister-reaffirms/>); [Calgary Herald](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110101014652/http://www.calgaryherald.com/Saint+Nick+pops+citizenship+event/4017898/story.html>).

<a id="event-2010-12-23-6-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former MSP Tommy Sheridan is convicted of perjury following a 12-week trial at the High Court in Glasgow. He was found guilty of lying during his successful defamation case against the News of the World which had printed details of his private life.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-scotland-glasgow-west-12059037>).

**Archived source account.** One person is killed after security forces open fire on protesters in Bouziane, Tunisia.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/worldNews/idAFTRE6BN2K920101224?sp=true>); [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5ho0lZCwZNe5xBDe4Zi0PDG7VWL3g?docId=CNG.66d6de1802a8cf2712e2068cee292844.301>).

<a id="event-2010-12-24-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Roman Catholic Church in Cuba announces that the government will release two more political prisoners to exile in Spain.

<a id="event-2010-12-24-6-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** State television in Côte d'Ivoire goes off the air outside the capital Abidjan amid a political crisis. The Economic Community of West African States threatens to remove incumbent President Laurent Gbagbo by "legitimate force".

Source citations (as archived): [IOL](<http://www.iol.co.za/news/africa/ivory-coast-state-tv-off-the-air-1.1005014>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-12074006>).

### 2010-12-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1328578485](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2010%20December%2025&oldid=1328578485>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2010-12-25-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 45 people are killed and at least 50 others are injured in Khar, Bajaur, Pakistan when a woman throws two hand grenades and detonates her vest at a World Food Programme (WFP) distribution centre in the early morning.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-south-asia-12078248>); [Voice of America](<https://web.archive.org/web/20101226072330/http://www.voanews.com/english/news/Suspected-Suicide-Bomber-Kills-40-in-Pakistan-112448854.html>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/International/Article.aspx?id=200936>).

<a id="event-2010-12-25-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Sudanese army says it has killed at least 40 rebels and wounded many more in a new offensive in the Darfur region, when army forces attacked joint positions of the Justice and Equality Movement and the Sudan Liberation Movement.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5gDFL9lIWr_D1RIphm7z5eps1ThYw?docId=CNG.81282d483c9208446f7bbcd961623561.2b1>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2010/12/25/AR2010122500216.html>).

<a id="event-2010-12-25-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 6 people are wounded as a bomb detonates in a church during Christmas Mass in the southern Philippines island of Jolo.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia-pacific/2010/12/201012254184365530.html>).

<a id="event-2010-12-25-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** UN: Approximately 14,000 people have fled Côte d'Ivoire and headed to Liberia due to the recent presidential election dispute.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-12079552>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2010/12/2010122419027283570.html>).

<a id="event-2010-12-25-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mohammed Deif, the commander of the Izz ad-Din al-Qassam Brigades, Hamas' military wing in the Gaza Strip, says that the Palestinians will not give up until Israel “ceases to exist”.

Source citations (as archived): [Ynet](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-4004173,00.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2010-12-25-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Aurela Gaçe wins Albania's national selection for the Eurovision Song Contest 2011 with the entry "Kënga ime".

Source citations (as archived): [Eurovision.TV](<http://www.eurovision.tv/page/news?id=22763&amp;_t=Aurela+Ga%C3%A7e+wins+Albanian+ticket+to+Germany>).

<a id="event-2010-12-25-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Leading writers criticise the British government for what they describe as its "repugnant, foolish and pointlessly destructive" decision to axe all funding for a free children's book scheme.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/books/2010/dec/26/booktrust-funding-cut-pullman-motion>).

<a id="event-2010-12-25-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Vietnam’s credit rating is downgraded by credit rating agencies amid rising inflation, and a shrinking currency and widening trade deficit crisis; state owned shipbuilder Vinashin defaults on a loan to a group of international lenders.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Asia](<http://www.rfa.org/english/east-asia-beat/economy-12252010183354.html>).

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2010/WORLD/asiapcf/12/25/pacific.earthquake/?hpt=Sbin>); [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2010-12/25/c_13664598.htm>); [Agence France-Presse](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5jf58vFcZ-zbTkdJR9TH6DK2Ugw9A>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2010-12-25-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Turkey's foreign minister Ahmet Davutoğlu reiterates his request for an apology from Israel for killing 9 Turks during May's Gaza flotilla raid

Source citations (as archived): [Ynet](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-4004237,00.html>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/International/Article.aspx?id=200957>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2010/WORLD/meast/12/25/turkey.israel.relations/>).

<a id="event-2010-12-25-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three fishermen from the People's Republic of China are released from South Korean custody after their vessel collided with a Coast Guard vessel last week.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN.com](<http://edition.cnn.com/2010/WORLD/asiapcf/12/25/south.korea.china.fishermen/index.html?hpt=T2>).

**Archived source account.** Ecuador recognises Palestine as an independent state within its 1967 borders.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2010/12/25/AR2010122500724.html>).

<a id="event-2010-12-25-4-4"></a>

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2010-12-25-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The director of an aid group working in Darfur is sentenced to one year in prison and fined on embezzlement charges after having been acquitted on the same charges earlier, in what as seen as an effort by the Sudanese government to silence Darfur human rights defenders and activists.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2010/12/25/AR2010122501157.html>).

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/skynews/Home/UK-News/Joanna-Yeates-Police-Searching-For-Missing-Architect-In-Bristol-Find-A-Body/Article/201012415870738?lpos=UK_News_Carousel_Region_0&amp;lid=ARTICLE_15870738_Joanna_Yeates%3A_Police_Searching_For_Missing_Architect_In_Bristol_Find_A_Body>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2010-12-26-1-0"></a>

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2010-12-26-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Protests against unemployment grow more violent as Tunisian security forces crack down on the residents in Sidi Bou Zid Governorate and a teenager is killed when police open fire.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2010/12/2010122682433751904.html>); [Ahram Online](<http://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/2/8/2639/World/Region/Clashes-continue-across-Tunisia.aspx>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2010-12-26-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eight people are killed and 21 injured after a bus crash in Egypt.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/egypt-bus-crash-kills-8-americans-injures-21-1.913791>); [Hindustan Times](<http://www.hindustantimes.com/Eight-US-tourists-killed-in-Egypt-accident/Article1-643027.aspx>).

<a id="event-2010-12-26-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A collision between a bus and a mini-truck kills 34 people and leaves 30 injured, near the town of Badaun in Uttar Pradesh state, in northern India.

Source citations (as archived): [The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/world/mourners-killed-in-indian-road-accident/story-fn3dxix6-1225976276663>); [Oneindia](<http://news.oneindia.in/2010/12/26/massive-road-mishap-in-up-death-toll-mounts-to-36.html>); [AP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5jkw0kbSBMUGAx0xBxU84ULlCTxAA?docId=01b584b3901a4b73bcc7e3bfcf4777ad>).

<a id="event-2010-12-26-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Waves of cold in Jammu and Kashmir show no signs of relenting, though the minimum temperature improves.

<a id="event-2010-12-26-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The eastern United States is struck by more snow, with South Carolina receiving its first ever snow on Christmas Day.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-12080925>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2010-12-26-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** China and South Korea are to hold defence talks following tension on the Korean Peninsula.

Source citations (as archived): [China Daily](<http://www.chinadaily.com.cn/world/2010-12/26/content_11756216.htm>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-pacific-12079866>).

<a id="event-2010-12-26-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Israel) announces that it will boycott Durban III (World Conference against Racism), the 2011 United Nations summit commemorating the tenth anniversary of the World Conference against Racism 2001, due to the conference's "anti-Semitic undertones and displays of hatred for Israel and the Jewish world," a day after the UN General Assembly approved a resolution, by a vote of 104 to 22, with 33 abstentions, to hold the summit in September 2011; Canada has already announced that it will also not attend, calling it a "charade".

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5iu_SM71wkVHl0N5coVNbbGYGVAHw?docId=CNG.78e0d6ea454a7aaf3314a8dbd2c58027.c91>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2010/12/26/AR2010122600875.html>); [JTA](<http://www.jta.org/news/article/2010/12/26/2742313/israel-to-boycott-durban-iii>).

<a id="event-2010-12-26-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The first humanitarian Asian flotilla, Asia to Gaza Solidarity Caravan of Asia 1, which left New Delhi with people of 15 differing nationalities aboard, leaves Damascus for Latakia, its final stop before it reaches its destination.

Source citations (as archived): [Tehran Times](<http://www.tehrantimes.com/index_View.asp?code=232850>).

<a id="event-2010-12-26-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thousands of people shouting "death to Israel" gather at Sarayburnu port in Istanbul to welcome back the MV Mavi Marmara, draped with a banner containing faces of the 9 people killed during the Gaza flotilla raid.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2010/12/2010122614733785109.html>); [Arutz Sheva](<http://www.israelnationalnews.com/News/news.aspx/141344>).

<a id="event-2010-12-26-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Industry, Trade and Labour Minister of Israel Binyamin Ben-Eliezer responds to Ecuador's formal recognition of Palestine as an independent state by saying that the "entire world" could recognise a Palestinian state in the next year.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5jALNGy163NHr71YyEy3-yZ2mjzKw?docId=CNG.78e0d6ea454a7aaf3314a8dbd2c58027.841>).

<a id="event-2010-12-26-4-6"></a>

Context: United States diplomatic cables leak:.

**Archived source account.** Newly released cables from July 2004 reveal that American diplomats panicked about a screening of the film Fahrenheit 9/11, which is critical of the U.S. government's response to the September 11 attacks. Diplomats stopped what they called a "potential fiasco" by intervening and contacting the offices of the New Zealand prime minister and Marian Hobbs, a government minister referred to as "Boo Boo" Hobbs by America.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio New Zealand International](<http://www.radionz.co.nz/news/political/64968/us-upset-at-hobbs&#x27;-role-in-film-screening>).

<a id="event-2010-12-26-4-7"></a>

Context: United States diplomatic cables leak:.

**Archived source account.** Newly released cables allege that world governments have sought assistance from the United States with wiretapping criminal and political adversaries, leading to denials and claims of "misunderstanding".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-12079794>).

<a id="event-2010-12-26-4-8"></a>

Context: United States diplomatic cables leak:.

**Archived source account.** Foreign Minister of Israel Avigdor Liberman states at a meeting with Israeli ambassadors that "classic diplomacy" is "not helpful" and that the right diplomacy is to say things "as is" due to the WikiLeaks website. Lieberman also attacks comments by the Foreign Minister of Turkey.

Source citations (as archived): [Ynetnews](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-4004641,00.html>).

**Archived source account.** Malaysia wins 2010 AFF Suzuki Cup with a total of 4-2 over Indonesia in the final matches.

Source citations (as archived): [ABS-CBN](<http://www.abs-cbnnews.com/sports/12/29/10/malaysia-wins-2010-aff-suzuki-cup-aggregate>).

### 2010-12-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1352725051](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2010%20December%2030&oldid=1352725051>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2010-12-30-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Côte d'Ivoire's ambassador to the United Nations, Youssoufou Bamba, says the country is on the "brink of genocide".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/topNews/idAFJOE6BT00320101230>).

<a id="event-2010-12-30-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sudanese President Omar al-Bashir says the government will withdraw from peace talks with rebels from Darfur unless a deal is reached this week.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2010/12/201012307480550532.html>).

<a id="event-2010-12-30-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** 2 people are killed and 18 others are wounded during bomb attacks on minority Christian homes in various parts of Baghdad.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2010/12/2010123019144787472.html>).

<a id="event-2010-12-30-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** An early morning bomb explodes before two courthouses in Athens; there are no injuries.

Source citations (as archived): [Der Spiegel](<http://www.spiegel.de/international/europe/0,1518,737115,00.html>); [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2010-12/30/c_13670845.htm>); [France24](<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6weiP7_3zRU>); [The New York Times](<http://www.indianexpress.com/news/Another-Greek-tragedy--Blast-damages-Athens-court-building/731385>).

<a id="event-2010-12-30-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bomb explodes at the Greek Embassy in Buenos Aires; there are no injuries. Some windows are broken.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2010/WORLD/americas/12/30/argentina.greek.embassy.explosion/>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2010-12-30-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** North Korea's state-run television broadcasts its first Western film, Bend It Like Beckham.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-pacific-12095775>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2010/dec/31/north-korea-david-beckham-film>).

<a id="event-2010-12-30-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Newly released papers show Gwynfor Evans, former Plaid Cymru MP for Carmarthen, said he would fast to death if the British government did not provide a Welsh language television service. S4C resulted.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-wales-12062288>).

<a id="event-2010-12-30-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Buckingham Palace announces the birth of Queen Elizabeth II's first great-grandchild, born to Peter Phillips and his wife Autumn.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-12093479>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2010-12-30-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A diplomatic cable newly released from the British National Archives, dated 1980, claims that Israel would be "ready to use their atomic weapon" in any further war against its adversaries.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5j_8Hd9bETEgyGU262HdVZ-6P7Mmw?docId=CNG.9205da04450c60fdfee82a0a332188cf.51>); [Ynetnews](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-4007061,00.html>); [Morning Star](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110106201906/http://www.morningstaronline.co.uk/index.php/news/content/view/full/99316>); [ABC News](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/stories/2010/12/30/3103960.htm?section=justin>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/International/Article.aspx?id=201251>).

<a id="event-2010-12-30-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** An international aid convoy from Asia enters Gaza, though Iranian and Jordanian members of the flotilla are denied entry and generators donated by Iran are banned too.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Headlines/Article.aspx?id=201601>).

<a id="event-2010-12-30-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Israeli forces arrest Hamas MP Khalil Ar-Rabai after surrounding his home in the early morning in the southern West Bank town of Yatta. The destruction of family property is also reported.

Source citations (as archived): [Ma'an](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110107034120/http://www.maannews.net/eng/ViewDetails.aspx?ID=346669>); [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5giK5BukgYmqg7MktsezdzhQbQaKA?docId=CNG.a69773e48a0970301352054d0054365c.8d1>); [Press TV](<http://www.presstv.ir/detail/157878.html>).

<a id="event-2010-12-30-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Yemeni government releases at least 428 Houthi northern rebels as part of a ceasefire mediated by Qatar in return for 10 military vehicles.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2010/12/20101230183224974178.html>).

<a id="event-2010-12-30-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thailand urges Cambodia to release seven of its citizens–including an MP–arrested after crossing their mutual border.

Source citations (as archived): [The Straits Times](<https://web.archive.org/web/20101231213654/http://www.straitstimes.com/BreakingNews/SEAsia/Story/STIStory_619006.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2010-12-30-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 19-year-old Uyghur woman, Pezilet Ekber, is sentenced to death following a secret trial, the second Uyghur woman to receive the death penalty on charges of participating in ethnic riots last year.

Source citations (as archived): [RFA](<http://www.rfa.org/english/news/uyghur/death-12302010153000.html>).

<a id="event-2010-12-30-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former Russian oligarch Mikhail Khodorkovsky has his prison sentence extended to a total of 14 years after a second conviction.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2010/12/2010123012597475433.html>).

<a id="event-2010-12-30-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former Israeli President Moshe Katsav is convicted of two counts of rape and other sexual offences by a court in Tel Aviv.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-12091982>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2010/12/2010123083812287264.html>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2010/dec/30/israeli-court-convicts-former-president-rape>).

<a id="event-2010-12-30-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A major Indian separatist leader, Arabinda Rajkhowa of the United Liberation Front of Asom, is released on bail.

Source citations (as archived): [The Straits Times](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110103215042/http://www.straitstimes.com/BreakingNews/Asia/Story/STIStory_619014.html>); [NDTV](<http://www.ndtv.com/article/india/ulfa-chief-arabinda-rajkhowa-gets-bail-75879>).

<a id="event-2010-12-30-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A court in Thailand jails 79 pro-government "yellow shirt" protesters for storming a state television station two years ago.

Source citations (as archived): [Bangkok Post](<http://www.bangkokpost.com/breakingnews/213814/yellow-shirts-get-jail-terms-for-nbt-raid>); [CTV](<http://www.ctv.ca/CTVNews/World/20101230/thai-court-convicts-yellow-shirt-protesters-101230/>); [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/worldNews/idAFTRE6BT13120101230>).

<a id="event-2010-12-30-3-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four opposition figures in Belarus are charged with organizing riots after demonstrations against the re-election of president Alexander Lukashenko.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-12092708>).

<a id="event-2010-12-30-3-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Anders Hogstrom, a Swedish man, is sentenced to two years and eight months imprisonment after being convicted of orchestrating the theft of Arbeit macht frei from the Auschwitz entry gate last December.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2010/12/2010123123957580601.html>).

<a id="event-2010-12-30-3-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Minnesota sues 3M claiming they pumped PFCs, a very toxic chemical according to the United States Environmental Protection Agency, into local waterways.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE6BT31L20101230>).

<a id="event-2010-12-30-3-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mississippi Governor Haley Barbour frees two sisters 16 years into double life terms received for armed robbery of two men for $11, citing one of the sister's "medical condition creates a substantial cost to the state of Mississippi."

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE6BT1WB20101230?loomia_ow=t0:s0:a49:g43:r2:c0.074776:b40635668:z0>).

#### Politics

<a id="event-2010-12-30-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Bertie Ahern, the former taoiseach who led the stricken Fianna Fáil political party from 1994 until 2008, announces he is to resign from Dáil Éireann at the forthcoming general election.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2010/dec/30/bertie-ahern-not-stand-irish-elections>); [Irish Examiner](<http://www.irishexaminer.com/breakingnews/ireland/ahern-to-retire-from-politics-487471.html>); [Reuters Africa](<http://af.reuters.com/article/worldNews/idAFTRE6BT4IK20101230>).

<a id="event-2010-12-30-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Burmese opposition leader Aung San Suu Kyi meets with opposition leaders who broke away from the National League for Democracy party.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/stories/2010/12/30/3104024.htm>).

<a id="event-2010-12-30-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Newly released papers show more than €130,000 of public money was used to wine and dine visiting dignitaries to Ireland while then Irish Prime Minister Charles Haughey warned on television that the country was "living away beyond our means".

Source citations (as archived): [Irish Independent](<http://www.independent.ie/national-news/state-papers-1980-lavish-lunches-for-dignitaries-as-nation-lived-beyond-means-2478368.html>).

### 2010-12-31

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076438780](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2010%20December%2031&oldid=1076438780>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2010-12-31-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A pre-dawn bomb explodes outside a closed night club in Athens; there are no injuries.

Source citations (as archived): [Press Association](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ukpress/article/ALeqM5iXEURLciM0NFe77Op_83f528fwww?docId=N0395511293771937108A>).

<a id="event-2010-12-31-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bomb explodes in the Nigerian capital Abuja, killing four people.

Source citations (as archived): [Times Live South Africa](<http://www.timeslive.co.za/sundaytimes/article832114.ece/Barracks-bomb-claims-4-on-New-Years-Eve>).

<a id="event-2010-12-31-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A protestor dies of his injuries in Tunisia as protests continue across the country over unemployment and poor living conditions.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2010/12/201012317536678834.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2010-12-31-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Arts and cultural people Annie Lennox, Herbert Kretzmer, Sheila Hancock, David Suchet, Harriet Walter, Katharine Hamnett, Alice Temperley, Sandy Powell, John Lloyd, Steve McQueen and Trevor Horn are among those to receive a New Year Honour from the Queen of the United Kingdom.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-12090365>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2010-12-31-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Estonia, one of the Baltic republics of the former Soviet Union, adopts the euro as its official currency, becoming the 17th country to do so.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE6BU0S720101231>).

#### Disasters

<a id="event-2010-12-31-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tornadoes touch down in midwestern and southern United States, including Washington County, Arkansas; Greater St. Louis, Sunset Hills, Missouri, Illinois and Oklahoma, with a few tornadoes in the early hours of January 1, 2011. A total 36 tornadoes touched down, resulting in the deaths of 9 people.

No attached source citation. This assertion is unverified; see its disclosure and research status above.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2010-12-31-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three Tibetan writers, detained earlier this year by Chinese authorities, are sentenced to jail terms of three to four years for "inciting activities to split the nation”

Source citations (as archived): [RFA](<http://www.rfa.org/english/news/tibet/writers-12312010111557.html>).

#### Politics

<a id="event-2010-12-31-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ikililou Dhoinine is elected President of the Comoros, defeating rival Mohamed Said Fazul with 61% of the vote.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/topNews/idAFJOE6BT09F20101230>).

<a id="event-2010-12-31-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** After an official protest by German Foreign Minister, Guido Westerwelle, Iran allows access to two journalists arrested in mid-October for interviewing family members of Sakineh Mohammadi Ashtiani, sentenced to death by stoning for alleged adultery.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/International/Article.aspx?id=201662>).

<a id="event-2010-12-31-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Officials in the Chinese Ministry of Industry and Information Technology warn of a crackdown on "illegal" voice-over-Internet(VoIP) telephony services that are not licensed or approved by the country's telecoms regulator.

Source citations (as archived): [RFA](<http://www.rfa.org/english/news/china/telephone-12312010143756.html>).

<a id="event-2010-12-31-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Italy bans plastic bags.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-12097605>).

<a id="event-2010-12-31-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sunni Muslim clerics organize strikes across Pakistan to protest against possible changes to the country’s blasphemy laws.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-south-asia-12101356>).
